units.slavonic_text: 12.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν Θεοφανείων ἐν Σαββάτῳ, τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωὶ μετὰ τὴν τοῦ Ὄρθρου ἐνδιάτακτον Ἀκολουθίαν, ψάλλονται αἱ Μ. Ὧραι κατὰ τὴν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 1, διάταξιν τῆς Παραμονῆς τῶν Χριστουγέννων. Ὁ δὲ Μ. Ἑσπερινός, ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου καὶ ὁ ἐν τῷ τέλει τῆς Λειτουργίας Ἁγιασμός, ψάλλονται ὡς εἴρηται ἀνωτέρω ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2 τῆς παρούσης ἑορτῆς. 13.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Μ. Ἁγιασμοῦ καὶ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου ψάλλονται κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῇ περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3 διάταξιν.
units.english_text: 14.    Τῷ αὐτῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τῆς ἑορτῆς *Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν* γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου *Πανεύφημε Πρόδρομε* γ΄, *Δόξα*, *Ἔνσαρκε λύχνε*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Θεὸς λόγος ἐπεφάνη ἐν σαρκί*. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὸ Μ. Προκείμενον *Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ*, μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ. units.slavonic_text: 12.    If the Feast of the Epiphany occurs on a Saturday, on Friday morning after the prescribed Matins Service, the Great Hours are sung according to the order of Situation One, Paragraph 1 of the present Feast. The Great Vespers, the Liturgy of Basil the Great, and the Service of the Blessing of the Waters at the end of the Liturgy are sung as prescribed above in Situation One, Paragraph 2 of the present Feast. 13.    On Saturday, the Matins of the Feast, the Great Blessing of the Waters and the Liturgy of Chrysostom are sung according to the order of Situation One, Paragraph 3.
units.english_text: 14.    On that same Saturday evening: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Feast: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*), and 3 of the Forerunner: **"O most praised Forerunner of Christ"** (*Πανεύφημε Πρόδρομε Χριστοῦ*); **"Glory"**: **"O torch incarnate"** (*Ἔνσαρκε λύχνε*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"God the Word appeared in the flesh"** (*Θεὸς λόγος ἐπεφάνη ἐν σαρκί*). Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Great Prokeimenon in Tone 7: **"Our God is in heaven and on earth; all things whatsoever He hath willed, He hath done"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ, πάντα ὅσα ἠθέλησεν ἐποίησεν*, Ps. 113:11 LXX) with its verses. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: **"As a lover of the Spirit"** (*Ὡς τοῦ Πνεύματος ἐραστής*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Come, let us imitate the wise virgins"** (*Δεῦτε μιμησώμεθα*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*), and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Sunday after Epiphany, and the Synaxis
units.slavonic_text: Sunday after Epiphany, and the Synaxis of the Honored Forerunner.
units.english_text: 15.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Forerunner, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata, and one each of the Feast: **"When Jesus was born"** (*Τοῦ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος*) and **"When he saw Thee in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις βλέψας σε τοῦ Ἰορδάνου*); the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, the Canon of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*). After the Third Ode: the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Kathismata of the Forerunner: **"The great rain"** (*Ὁ μέγας ὑετός*) and **"Willingly He came forth upon earth"** (*Ἑκὼν προῆλθεν ἐπὶ γῆς*); after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Menologion of the day. Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; then the Ninth Ode is sung with the Megalynaria of the Feast: **"Every tongue is at a loss to praise Thee worthily"** (*Ἀπορεῖ πᾶσα γλῶσσα*), and that of the Forerunner with the Verse: **"Holy forerunner of God, pray for us"**...[^227]

units.slavonic_text: 14.    That Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Feast, and 3 of the Forerunner. units.english_text: 16.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς χθές, μετὰ τοῦ Στίχου τοῦ β΄ Ἀντιφώνου *Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*. Εἰσοδικὸν *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*. Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Προδρόμου *Μνήμη δικαίου* καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* [τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ παραλείπεται ἐδῶ· βλέπε § 39 τῆς Προθεωρίας], Κοντάκιον *Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*, ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου *Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*. Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: Στίχου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ
units.slavonic_text: Στίχου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Φῶς ἐκ φωτὸς δ΄ Δόξα, Ἄγγελος ἐκ στειρωτικῶν ὠδίνων, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 16.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς χθές· εἰς τὸ δεύτερον Σῶσον ἡμᾶς . . . ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου . . . Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς. [Τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ παραλείπεται εἰς §15, σελ. 149 τοῦ Τυπικοῦ. Παρουσιάζεται ὅμως εἰς §9, σελ. 33 τῆς Προθεωρίας]. Κοντάκιον Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου, τὸ Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου.² Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου . . . Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν. Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_text: *[Σημ. 2. 2. Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα ἀναγινώσκονται εἰς τὴν Ἀπόδοσιν τῆς ἑορτῆς (14 Ἰανουαρίου). Ἐὰν ὅμως ἡ 14 Ἰανουαρίου τύχῃ ἡ Κυριακὴ τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου, τότε τῇ 7 Ἰανουαρίου ἀναγινώσκεται ὁ μὲν Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ δὲ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα.]*

units.english_text: 17.    Ἡ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς τελεῖται τῇ ἑπομένῃ Κυριακῇ (14 Ἰανουαρίου). Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν* ς΄, *Δόξα*, *Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*, *Καὶ νῦν*, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*, Ἀπολυτίκιον τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* δίς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: ...Exapostilaria of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, and of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Feast: **"Light from Light"** (*Φῶς ἐκ φωτός*); **"Glory"**: **"An angel from barren pangs"** (*Ἄγγελος ἐκ στειρωτικῶν ὠδίνων*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_text: 16.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast as yesterday, with the verse of the Second Antiphon: **"Who wast baptized by John in the Jordan"** (*Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου βαπτισθείς*). Introit: **"Come, let us worship and bow down before Christ. Save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead..."** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν Χριστῷ. Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν...*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner: **"The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise"** (*Μνήμη δικαίου μετ’ ἐγκωμίων*), and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*) [the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple is omitted here in Violakis, but see § 39 of the Protheoria]; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); instead of the Trisagion Hymn: **"All of you who have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. units.slavonic_text: The Leave-taking.
units.english_text: 17.    The Apodosis of the Feast is celebrated on the following Sunday (January 14). On Saturday evening: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 6 of the Feast: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*); **"Glory"**: **"Thou hast bowed Thy head unto the Forerunner"** (*Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*); **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day: **"The Lord is King, He is clothed with majesty"** (*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν*, Ps. 92:1 LXX). At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"The Sun born of a virgin"** (*Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*); Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (twice), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 17.    The Leave-taking of the Feast in this Situation occurs on Sunday of the following week (the 14th of the month); its Service is sung as follows: In Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 6 of the Feast “Our illumination.” Glory, “You have bowed Your head before the Forerunner,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever, “The Sun born of a virgin.” The Resurrection Apolytikion and that of the Feast twice and Dismissal. 18.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion “When You, O Lord, were baptized in Jordan” and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon.
units.english_text: 18.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Sunday Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon...[^228]

units.english_text: οἱ Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ἀμφότεροι τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς*· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου*, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον. Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ, καὶ τὸ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, αἱ Θ΄ Ὠδαὶ ἀμφοτέρων τῶν Κανόνων μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Φῶς ἐκ φωτὸς* δ΄, *Δόξα*, *Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.slavonic_incipit: Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ
units.slavonic_text: Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ Στίχου Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα ψάλλονται καὶ οἱ δύο τῆς θ΄ Ὠδῆς Κανόνες μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Φῶς ἐκ φωτὸς δ΄. Δόξα, Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.
units.english_text: 20.    Τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ ψάλλονται μόνον αἱ Μεγάλαι Ὧραι μετὰ τοῦ Τροπαρίου *Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν* καὶ τοῦ Κοντακίου *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*· μετὰ δὲ τὴν Εὐχὴν τῆς Θ΄ Ὥρας γίνεται Ἀπόλυσις. Ἐν δὲ τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις εἰς πάντα (ἄνευ νηστείας), καθότι ἡ νηστεία τῆς Παραμονῆς μετατίθεται εἰς τὸ Σάββατον.

Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς εἰς β΄, Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ, τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τοῦ Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ {Τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ παραλείπεται εἰς σελ. 150, §19, τοῦ Τυπικοῦ· παρουσιάζεται ὅμως εἰς σελ. 33, §39 τῆς Προθεωρίας. units.english_text: ...The Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and both Canons of the Feast with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*). After the Third Ode, the Hypakoe of the Feast: **"When at Thy manifestation"** (*Ὅτε τῇ ἐπιφανείᾳ σου*); after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the day. Both double Katavasiai: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*) and **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; the Ninth Odes of both Canons are sung with their Megalynaria. Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion and that of the Feast (twice). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Feast: **"Light from Light"** (*Φῶς ἐκ φωτός*); **"Glory"**: **"O Savior, Who clothedst Thyself with the waters of Jordan"** (*Νάματα Ἰορδάνεια*); **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_text: 19.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast as in § 16, with the verse of the Second Antiphon: **"Who wast baptized by John in the Jordan"** (*Ὁ ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*). Introit of the Feast with **"Who art risen from the dead"** (*Ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, and that of the Feast: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** [the Dismissal Troparion of the Holy Patron of the Temple is omitted here in Violakis, but see § 39 of the Protheoria]; Kontakion: **"Thou hast appeared today to the universe"** (*Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον*); the Trisagion Hymn; the Epistle [Ephesians 4:7–13] and the Gospel [Matthew 4:12–17] of the Sunday after the Lights (since on the preceding Sunday the lections of the Forerunner were proclaimed). At **"Especially"**: **"Magnify, O my soul... O the marvels surpassing understanding"** (*Μεγάλυνον ψυχή μου... Ὦ τῶν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*). Communion Verse: **"The grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared unto all men"** (*Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις*, Titus 2:11); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: The Canons of the Resurrection and
units.slavonic_text: The Canons of the Resurrection and the two of the Feast with the Verse “Glory to You, O God.” After the 3rd Ode, the Ypakoi of the Feast “When at Your epiphany”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Saints of the day Both [double] Katavasie, and the entire order of the Morning Gospel. Then we sing the 9th Odes of both Canons with their Megalynaria. Exapostilaria of the Resurrec- tion and of the Feast twice. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Feast “Light of light.” Glory, “O Savior, who clothed yourself with the waters of Jordan,” Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology, and “Today salvation.” 19.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast; at the second Antiphon “Save us . . . Who were baptized by John in Jordan.” The Entrance Hymn of the Feast with “Who is risen from the dead.” The Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast “When You, O Lord, were baptized in Jordan” and that of the Saint of the Church. {The Apolytikion of the Saint of the Church is omitted on page 150, Paragraph 19 of the Typikon; it appears, however, in Paragraph 39, page 33 of the Protheoria. See also the note on page 20 of the Diptycha 1990.} The Kontakion “You have appeared today”; the Trisagios Hymn, Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday after Epiphany (since on the previous Sunday the Apostolos and Gospel of the Forerunner were read). At “Especially,” “Magnify, O my soul . . . Above all human thought,” Communion Hymn “The grace of God became manifest today,” “When You, O Lord, were baptized in Jordan,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 20.    On Friday morning: only the Great Hours are chanted, with the Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (*Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλών*) and the Kontakion: **"Today the Lord hath appeared in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*); after the Prayer of the Ninth Hour, the Dismissal takes place. At table, dispensation for all foods [without fasting] is observed, because the strict fast of the Paramony is transferred to Saturday.

units.slavonic_text: 20.    If the Feast of Epiphany occurs on a Sunday, on Friday morning (the 4th of the month) after the prescribed Service of Matins only the Great Hours are sung, and we say the Troparion “Make ready, O Zabulon” and the Kontakion “Today has the Lord appeared on the waters of Jordan,” the Dismissal after the Prayer of the 9th Hour. At table, all food is permitted {no fasting}. 21.    On that Friday evening, the Vespers of the Pre-feast is sung according to the order of the Mineon; after “Lord, now let your servant depart,” the Canon is sung, and, after the Irmos of the 9th Ode, the Trisagion, then the Apolytikion “The river Jordan turned back,” and Dismissal. 22.    On Saturday at Matins, after the Midnight Service, etc., the Kathismata are read, then the Canon of the Pre-feast and that of the Saints
units.english_text: 22.    On Saturday at Matins: after the Midnight Service, the Psalter Kathismata, the Canons from the Menaion (the Forefeast Canon and that of the Saints)...[^229]

units.english_text: ἀναγινώσκονται χῦμα τὰ Καθίσματα, ὁ Προεόρτιος Κανὼν καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἶτα ψάλλονται αἱ Καταβασίαι *Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάληψε πυθμένα* [ἀνεκάληψε *sic*], καὶ ἀκολούθως στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν* καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἐξαποστειλάριον δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ δ΄ τῆς ἡμέρας Προσόμοια *Τί ἀμφιγνοεῖς Βαπτιστὰ οἰκονομίαν;* *Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστα* (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῶν Αἴνων), Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*.

units.english_text: 23.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, *Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον *Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῶν Φώτων. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*. Μετὰ τὸ *Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, ψάλλονται τὰ Ἰδιόμελα τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ *Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων* κτλ. καὶ τελεῖται ὁ Ἁγιασμὸς κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν. Ἐν τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.

units.slavonic_text: ἀναγινώσκονται χῦμα τὰ Καθίσματα, ὁ Προεόρτιος Κανὼν καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἶτα ψάλλονται αἱ Καταβασίαι Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάληψε πυθμένα, καὶ ἀκολούθως στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἐξαποστειλάριον δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ δ΄ τῆς ἡμέρας Προσόμοια Τί ἀμφιγνοεῖς Βαπτιστὰ οἰκονομίαν; Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστα (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῶν Αἴνων), Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε. 23.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός, τὸ Προεόρτιον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῶν Φώτων. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς. Μετὰ τὸ Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, ψάλλονται τὰ Ἰδιόμελα τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων κτλ. καὶ τελεῖται ὁ Ἁγιασμὸς κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν. Ἐν τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου. 24.    Τῷ αὐτῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, ψάλλεται ὁ Μ. τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἑσπερινός, ἐν ᾧ οὐδὲν τῶν Ἀναστασίμων ψάλλομεν, ἀλλ’ ἅπαντα τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς ἑξῆς· Μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα, ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἰδιόμελα Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν εἰς ς΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ. Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα μετὰ τῶν Τροπαρίων καὶ τῶν Στίχων αὐτῶν, ὁ Ἀπόστολος, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον καὶ τὰ λοιπά, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 2. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἰδιόμελα Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἰδών σε ὁ Ἰωάννης καὶ τὰ ἕτερα δύο, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 25.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ ψάλλεται ἡ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου, ὁ Μ. Ἁγιασμός, ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Μ. Βασιλείου, ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 3-4. 26.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας καὶ τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωῒ ψάλλεται ἡ ἀκολουθία τοῦ τιμίου Προδρόμου, ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Α΄ § 5, 6, 7. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον.

units.english_text: ...of the day [read simply]. Then the Katavasiai are sung: **"He uncovered the bottom of the deep"** (*Βυθοῦ ἀνεκάλυψε πυθμένα*), and following this we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), and the Forefeast Exapostilarion twice. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomia of the day: **"Why dost thou hesitate, O Baptist, to accomplish this dispensation?"** (*Τί ἀμφιγνοεῖς, Βαπτιστά, τὴν οἰκονομίαν;*); **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"O John the Baptist"** (*Ἰωάννη Βαπτιστά*, seek in the Aposticha of the Praises); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion: **"The river Jordan once turned back"** (*Ἀπεστρέφετό ποτε*).

units.english_text: 23.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and the Beatitudes, with troparia from the Third and Sixth Odes of the Forefeast Canon. After the Little Entrance: **"Come, let us worship and bow down before Christ. Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in Thy saints..."** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*); the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, that of the Holy Patron of the Temple, and the Kontakion: **"Today the Lord hath appeared in the streams of the Jordan"** (*Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον*); the Epistle [1 Timothy 3:14–4:5] and the Gospel [Matthew 3:1–11] of the Saturday before the Lights [Epiphany]. At **"Especially"**: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Communion Verse of the day, and **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*). After **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*), the Idiomela of the Blessing of the Waters are sung: **"The voice of the Lord is upon the waters"** (*Φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων*), etc., and the Blessing of the Waters is performed according to the order in the Menaion. At table, dispensation for wine and oil is permitted.

units.slavonic_incipit: of the day. Then the Katavasie
units.slavonic_text: of the day. Then the Katavasie "He discovered the bottom of the depth of the sea," then we chant "More honorable." The Exapostilarion of the Pre- feast twice. At the Praises: the four Prosomia of the day "Why do you hesitate, O Baptist?" Glory, Now and ever, "John the Baptist" (seek in the Aposticha of the Praises), Great Doxology and the Apolytikion "The River Jordan turned back." 23.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes, hymns from the 3rd and 6th Ode of the Canon of the Pre-feast. After the Entrance, "Come let us worship... who are wonderful in Your Saints." The Apolytikion of the Pre- feast, the Apolytikion of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion "Today has the Lord appeared on the waters of Jordan," Apostolos and Gospel of the Saturday before Epiphany. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn of the day, and "We have seen the [true] light." After "Blessed be the name of the Lord," the Idiomela of the Blessing of the Waters "The voice of the Lord upon the waters," etc., are sung, and the Service of the Blessing of the Waters is performed according to the order of the Mineon. At table, the consumption of wine and oil is permitted. 24.    On that Saturday evening, the Great Vespers of the Feast is sung, at which we sing none of the Resurrection Hymns, but all of the Feast as follows: After the Introductory Psalm, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the 4 Idiomela "Our illumination" repeating the first two. Glory, Now and ever, "You did bow your head to the Forerunner." Entrance with the Gospel, "O Gladsome Light," and the Readings with their Hymns and Verses, the Apostolos, the Gospel and the rest, as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraph 2. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela "O Christ God, when John saw you" and the other two. Glory, Now and ever, "The Sun born of a virgin," then "Now let your servant depart" and the Trisagion; then the Apolytikion "When You, Lord, were baptized in Jordan" three times, and Dismissal. 25.    On that Sunday are sung the Service of the Matins of the Feast, the Great Blessing of the Waters, and the Liturgy of Saint Basil, as they are prescribed in Situation One, Paragraphs 3 -4. 26.    On that Sunday evening and Monday morning, the Service of the Honored Forerunner is sung, as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraphs 5, 6, 7. Apostolos and Gospel of the Forerunner, Communion Hymn "The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance."
units.english_text: 24.    On that same Saturday evening: Great Vespers of the Feast is chanted, in which we chant nothing of the Resurrection, but all of the Feast as follows: after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the Idiomela: **"Our illumination"** (*Τὸν φωτισμὸν ἡμῶν*) for 6 stichira [repeating the first two]; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"Thou didst bow Thy head to the Forerunner"** (*Ὑπέκλινας κάραν τῷ Προδρόμῳ*). Entrance with the Gospel Book, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Old Testament Readings with their Troparia and their verses; the Epistle, the Gospel, and the rest, as appointed in Situation One, § 2. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela: **"When John saw Thee in the river Jordan, O Christ God"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἰδών σε ὁ Ἰωάννης*) and the other two; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"The Sun born of a Virgin"** (*Τὸν ἐκ Παρθένου ἥλιον*); **"Lord, now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29–32); the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*) thrice, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 30.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας, ψάλλεται ὁ Προεόρτιος Ἑσπερινὸς κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν· μετὰ τὸ *Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, ὁ Προεόρτιος τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ Κανών, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς Θ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 31.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικὸν κτλ. εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν* δίς, Κανόνες ὁ Προεόρτιος *Ὡς ἐν ἠπείρῳ πεζεύσας* καὶ ὁ τῶν Ο΄ Ἀποστόλων *Χριστῷ μαθητεύσαντες* (ζήτει τῇ Δ΄ τοῦ μηνός), ἀφ’ ς΄, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος, τὰ Προεόρτια καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· εἶτα ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῶν Ο΄ *Καταλιπόντες κόσμον* καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον *Ὁ ἐκ Πατρὸς ἀχρόνως*, οἱ Αἶνοι τὸ *Σοὶ Δόξα, πρέπει* καὶ τὰ Ἀπόστιχα. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῶν Φώτων, Κοινωνικὸν *Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 29.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν Δευτέρᾳ, τῇ Παρασκευῇ πρωῒ (Γ΄ τοῦ μηνός), μετὰ τὴν τοῦ Ὄρθρου ἐνδιάτακτον Ἀκολουθίαν, ψάλλονται αἱ Μ. Ὧραι μόναι καὶ λέγεται Τροπάριον Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν καὶ Κοντάκιον Ἐν τοῖς ῥείθροις σήμερον· μετὰ τὴν Εὐχὴν τῆς Θ΄ Ὥρας Ἀπόλυσις. 30.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας, ψάλλεται ὁ Προεόρτιος Ἑσπερινὸς κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν· μετὰ τὸ Νῦν ἀπολύεις, ὁ Προεόρτιος τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ Κανών, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς Θ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 31.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικὸν κτλ. εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἑτοιμάζου Ζαβουλὼν δίς, Κανόνες ὁ Προεόρτιος Ὡς ἐν ἠπείρῳ πεζεύσας καὶ ὁ τῶν Ο΄ Ἀποστόλων Χριστῷ μαθητεύσαντες (ζήτει τῇ Δ΄ τοῦ μηνός), ἀφ’ ς΄, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος, τὰ Προεόρτια καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· εἶτα ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῶν Ο΄ Καταλιπόντες κόσμον καὶ τὸ Προεόρτιον Ὁ ἐκ Πατρὸς ἀχρόνως, οἱ Αἶνοι τὸ Σοὶ Δόξα, πρέπει καὶ τὰ Ἀπόστιχα. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Σαββάτου πρὸ τῶν Φώτων, Κοινωνικὸν Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 32.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, καὶ τῇ Κυριακῇ πρωῒ ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Κυριακῆς πρὸ τῶν Φώτων μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου καὶ τοῦ Ἁγιασμοῦ, ὡς διετυπώθη ἐν περιπτώσει Β § 4, 5, 6. Ἐν τῇ τραπέζῃ κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου. 33.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας ψάλλεται ὁ Μέγας Ἑσπερινὸς μετὰ τῶν Ἀναγνωσμάτων τῶν Τροπαρίων καὶ τῶν Στίχων αὐτῶν, τοῦ

units.english_text: 28.    The Apodosis falls on the following day, Monday (the 14th of the month), on which all the services of the Feast are chanted, as previously appointed in Situation One, § 11. The Epistle and the Gospel of the day are read; Communion Verse: **"The grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared unto all men"** (*Ἐπεφάνη ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ*, Titus 2:11); **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 28.    The Leave-taking occurs on the following day, Monday (the 14th of the month); on that day all the office for the Feast is sung, as prescribed in Situation One, Paragraph 11. Apostolos and Gospel of the day, Communion Hymn "The grace of God became manifest today," the Apolytikion "When You, O Lord, were baptized in the Jordan," and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 31.    On Saturday at Matins: after the Midnight Service, etc., at **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*), the Dismissal Troparion: **"Make ready, O Zebulun"** (twice); Canons: the Forefeast Canon: **"Traversing the deep on foot as on dry land"** (*Ὡς ἐν ἠπείρῳ πεζεύσας*) and that of the Seventy Apostles: **"Having been discipled unto Christ"** (*Χριστῷ μαθητεύσαντες*, seek on the 4th of the month); after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forefeast, and the Menologion of the Saints of the day; then the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode, and we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilarion of the Seventy Apostles: **"Having forsaken the world"** (*Καταλιπόντες κόσμον*) and the Forefeast Exapostilarion: **"Begotten timelessly of the Father"** (*Ὁ ἐκ Πατρὸς ἀχρόνως*); at the Praises: **"To Thee belongeth glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*), and the Aposticha. At the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle [1 Timothy 3:14–4:5] and the Gospel [Matthew 3:1–11] of the Saturday before the Lights [Epiphany]; Communion Verse: **"Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken unto Thyself, O Lord"** (*Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου, Κύριε*, Ps. 64:5 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 29.    If the Feast of Epiphany occurs on a Monday, on Friday morning (the 3rd of the month) after the prescribed Service of Matins, only the Great Hours are sung and we say the Troparion "Make ready, O Zabulon" and the Kontakion "Today has the Lord appeared on the waters of Jordan"; the Dismissal after the Prayer of the 9th Hour. 30.    On Friday evening, the Vespers of the Pre-feast is sung according to the order of the Mineon; after "Lord, now let your servant depart," the Pre-festal Canon of the Vespers is sung, and after the Irmos of the 9th Ode the Trisagion, the Apolytikion "Make ready, O Zabulon," and Dismissal. 31.    Saturday at Matins, after the Midnight Service, etc., at "God is the Lord": the Apolytikion "Make ready O Zabulon" twice, the Canon of the Pre-feast "Having travelled on foot on land" and the Canon of the 70 Apostles "Having been taught by Christ" (see the 4th of the month); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forefeast and the Minologion of the Saints of the day; then the Irmos of the 9th Ode; then we chant "More honorable." The Exapostilarion "Ageless from the Father," the Praises, the lesser Doxology "To You belongs glory," and the Aposticha. In the Liturgy, Apostolos and Gospel of the Saturday before Epiphany, Commun- ion Hymn "O Lord, blessed are those You chose," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal. 32.    On Saturday evening and Sunday morning, the Service of the Sunday before Epiphany is sung together with the Liturgy of Chrysostom and the Blessing of the Waters, as prescribed in Situation Two, Paragraphs 4, 5, 6. units.slavonic_text: 37.    If the Feast occurs on Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday, for the order of the Service of the Great Hours, of the Eve, of the Great Vespers, of the Liturgy of Basil the Great and the Blessing of the Waters, see Situation One, Paragraphs 1, 2. On the day of the Feast, the services of Matins, Great Blessing of the Waters and the Liturgy of Chrysostom [are performed] according to the order prescribed in Situation One, Paragraphs 3, 4. For the order of the Service of the Honored Forerunner on the following day, see Situation One, Paragraphs 5, 6, 7. The Sunday after Epiphany, if the Feast occurs on a Tuesday, falls on the 11th of the month, on which day is celebrated also the Feast of the Righteous Theodosios, the Founder of Monasteries. His Service is sung jointly with the Sunday service, according to the order of Paragraph 39.
units.english_text: For the order of the office of the Honorable Forerunner on the following day, see that same Situation One, § 5, 6, and 7. The Sunday after the Lights, when the Feast occurs on a Tuesday, falls on the 11th of the month, on which day the memory of our Righteous Father Theodosios the Cenobiarch is also celebrated. His office is chanted jointly with that of the Sunday, according to the order formulated in § 39.

units.english_text: 40.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ* καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων· εἰς δὲ τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ μεθέορτον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Στείβει θαλάσσης* καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ μεθέορτον *Βαβαὶ τῶν θείων ἔργων σου*. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ (ὅπου δ’ ἐπισημότερον ἑορτάζεται ὁ Ὅσιος, λέγονται ἀντὶ τῶν μεθεόρτων οἱ Αἶνοι τοῦ Ἁγίου εἰς δ΄). *Δόξα* τὸ Ἑωθινόν, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.english_text: 39.    If the feast falls on the Sunday after the Lights: at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Afterfeast: **"Didst thou see how I am invested"** (*Εἶδες πῶς περίκειμαι*), and 3 of the Righteous Saint; **"Glory"**: of the Afterfeast; **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the Afterfeast; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: his Service is sung together with that of the Post-feast according to the order of the Mineon; if the Feast occurs on a Saturday, the Apostolos of the Saint and the Gospel of the Saturday after Epiphany are read. 39.    If the Feast occurs on the Sunday after Epiphany, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Post- feast "Did you see how" and 3 of the Righteous Saint, Glory of the Post- feast, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Righteous Saint, Now and ever of the Post-feast. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint, of the Feast, and Dismissal. 40.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the "When You, O Lord, were baptized in Jordan" and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrec- tion Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; in the 3rd Stasis [Stichologia] the Kathismata of the Righteous Saint and of the Post- feast; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection, of the Feast and of the Righteous Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and of the Post-feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrec- tion, and the Minologion of the Saints. The Katavasie "Israel passed through," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing "More honorable." The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint and of the Post-feast "Look at your divine works." At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Post-feast (wherever the Righteous Saint is more formally celebrated, instead of those of the Post-feast we do the 4 Praises of the Righteous Saint). Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation." 41.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Feast. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Feast, of the Righteous Saint and of the Saint of the Church, Kontakion "You have appeared today." Apostolos of the Righteous Saint and Gospel of the Sunday after Epiphany. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "Praise [the Lord]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 40.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; at the third Stichologia [Stasis], the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Afterfeast; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Feast, and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the Saints of the day; Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Afterfeast: **"O the wonder of Thy divine works!"** (*Βαβαὶ τῶν θείων ἔργων σου*). At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast (where the Righteous Saint is celebrated with greater solemnity, instead of the afterfeast stichira, the 4 Praises of the Saint are chanted); **"Glory"**: the appointed Resurrectional Eothinon Doxastikon; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_text: 42.    Εἰ τύχοι ἄρχεσθαι τὸ Τριῴδιον τῇ ΙΑ΄ Ἰανουαρίου καὶ συμπέσοι καὶ ἡ Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐφεξῆς. Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου Θεοδοσίου γ΄. *Δόξα*, *Παντοκράτορ Κύριε*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ὁσίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ὁσίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: Κυριακὴ μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα μετὰ Τριῳδίου.
units.english_text: 43.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου μετὰ Στίχου *Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς Ὀκτωήχου, εἶτα Κάθισμα τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τοῦ Τριῳδίου· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Στείβει θαλάσσης*, εἶτα τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου, τὸ *Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ*, καὶ ψάλλεται ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμός, *Δόξα*, *Τῆς μετανοίας ἄνοιξόν μοι* καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ δύο Τροπάρια, τὸ *Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου* καὶ ἀκολούθως στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ (ἐκτὸς ἂν ἐπισήμως ἑορτάζηται ὁ Ἅγιος, ὅτε καὶ λέγονται ἀντὶ τῶν μεθεόρτων Αἶνοι ἐκ τοῦ Ἁγίου). *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.english_text: 42.    If the period of the Lenten Triodion begins on January 11 and this coincides with the Sunday after the Lights [Epiphany], the office is chanted as follows: at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and Kathisma 1 of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 10 Stichira: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 of our Righteous Father Theodosios; **"Glory"**: **"Almighty Lord"** (*Παντοκράτορ Κύριε*); **"Both now and ever"**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with the censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory"**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever"**: of the Triodion; Dismissal Troparia: the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 43.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata with those of the Afterfeast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Triodion with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι*), and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos of the Octoechos, then the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and that of the Triodion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints of the day, and the Synaxarion / Commentary [Hypomnema] of the Triodion; Katavasiai: **"The Lord, working wonders"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*); then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*) and the Resurrectional Morning Gospel; **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*); and Psalm 50 [LXX] is chanted; **"Glory"**: **"Open to me the doors of repentance, O Giver of Life"** (*Τῆς μετανοίας ἄνοιξόν μοι πύλας, Ζωοδότα*) and the remaining two penitential troparia [**"Guide me in the paths of salvation"** and **"As I ponder the multitude of evil deeds"**]; the litany: **"Save, O God, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον, ὁ Θεός, τὸν λαόν σου*); and following this we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and that of the Triodion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast (unless the Righteous Saint is celebrated with greater solemnity, when the Praises of the Saint are chanted instead of the afterfeast stichira); **"Glory"**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever"**: **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today is salvation come into the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: Note: It is necessary to know that the Holy Easter can occur as early as on March 22 and as late as on April 24; consequently, the Triodion period may begin in the earliest possible instance on January 11, and in the latest possible instance on February 13. Concerning this, see the Chart of Celebrations. 42.    If the Triodion period begins on January 11 and this occurs on the Sunday after Epiphany, the Service is sung as follows: In Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Triodion and 3 of the Righteous Theodosios, Glory, "Almighty Lord," Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Righteous Saint, Now and ever of the Triodion. The Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint, of the Feast and Dismissal. 43.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the "When You, O Lord, were baptized in Jordan" and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrec- tion Kathismata and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi of the Mode, the Anavathmi and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Triodion with the Verse "Glory to You, O God" and that of the Righteous Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Eight Modes [Oktoichos], then the Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and of the Triodion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, and the Minologion of the Saints of the day, and the Postscript of the Triodion. The Katavasie "Israel passed through," then "Let every breath" and the Gospel of Matins, "Having beheld the Resur- rection," Psalm 50, Glory, "Open to me the doors of repentance" and the other two Hymns. Then "Save, O Lord, Your people" and following this we sing "More honorable." The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint and of the Triodion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Post-feast (wherever the Righteous Saint is more formally celebrated, instead of those of the Post-feast hymns, we do the 4 Praises of the Righteous Saint). Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation." 44.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns

units.english_text: 45.    Εἰ τύχοι ἄρχεσθαι τὸ Τριῴδιον τῇ ΙΒ΄ ἢ τῇ ΙΓ΄ τοῦ μηνός, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Κυριακῆς μετὰ τὰ Φῶτα καὶ ἡ τοῦ Τριῳδίου ψάλλονται ὡς ἐφεξῆς· Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα γ΄ *Ὕμνον νῦν μεθέορτον* (ὅρα 12 Ἰανουαρίου), *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* μεθέορτον *Ὁρῶσά σε ἡ φύσις ἅπασα*, (ὅρα Δοξαστικὸν τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἑσπερινοῦ τῆς 12ης Ἰανουαρίου), τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 45.    If the Triodion begins on January 12 or 13, the office of the Sunday after the Lights and that of the Triodion are chanted as follows: On Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 Afterfeast stichira: **"Now let us sing an afterfeast hymn"** (*Ὕμνον νῦν μεθέορτον*, see January 12); **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone; Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: Afterfeast stichiron: **"All creation beholding Thee"** (*Ὁρῶσά σε ἡ φύσις ἅπασα*, see the Doxastikon of the Aposticha at Vespers on January 12); the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

If the Triodion period begins on January 12 or 13, the Service of the Sunday after Epiphany and of the Triodion is sung as follows: In Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Triodion and 3 of the Post-feast "Let us sing, O faithful, a Post-feast hymn" {see January 12}. Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever of the Post-feast "All of nature seeing you" {see Glory of the Stichira of January 12}. The Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Feast, and Dismissal. 46.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagios Hymn, the "When You, O Lord, were baptized in Jordan" and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Resurrection Apolytikion twice and "When You, O Lord, were baptized in Jordan" once, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and those of the Post-feast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection, of the Triodion and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, then the Kathisma of the Triodion and that of the Post-feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, and the Minologion of the Saints of the day, and the Postscript of the Triodion. The Katavasie "Israel passed through," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel of Matins of the Triodion (see the order in Paragraph 43); then we sing "More honorable." units.english_text: 46.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** (*Ἐν Ἰορδάνῃ*), and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion twice, and **"When Thou, O Lord, wast baptized in the Jordan"** once; then the Psalter and the Amomos [Psalm 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata with the afterfeast hymns in place of Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Triodion, and that of the Feast; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion with its Ikos, and the Kathisma of the Triodion and the Afterfeast; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints of the day, and the Commentary [Synaxarion] of the Triodion; the Katavasiai: **"The Lord traversing the deep"** (*Στείβει θαλάσσης*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel appointed for the Sundays of the Triodion (see the order in § 43); then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Triodion, and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 Afterfeast stichira; **"Glory..."**: **"By boasting of works"** (*Ταῖς ἐξ ἔργων καυχήσεσι*); **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: 1)    If after the Sunday after Epiphany there is only one Sunday until the First Sunday of the Triodion, on that Sunday we read the Apostolos of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9-15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1-10]. 2)    If there are two Sundays, on the first we read the Apostolos of the 29th Sunday [Colossians 3:4-11] and the Gospel of the 10 Lepers [12th Sunday of Luke, Luke 17:12-19], and on the second we read the Apostolos of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9-15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1-10]. 3)    If there are three Sundays, on the first we read the Apostolos of the 29th Sunday [Colossians 3:4-11] and the Gospel of the 10 Lepers, [12th Sunday of Luke, Luke 17:12-19], on the second we read the Apostolos of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9-15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus, [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1-10], and on the third the Apostolos of the 17th Sunday [2nd Corinthians 6:16 - 7:1] and the Gospel of the Canaanite Woman [17th Sunday of Matthew, Matthew 15:21-28]. 4)    If there are four Sundays, on the first we read the Apostolos of the 29th Sunday [Colossians 3:4-11] and the Gospel of the 10 Lepers; [12th Sunday of Luke, Luke 17:12-19]; on the second we read the Apostolos of the 31st Sunday [1 Timothy 1:15-17] and Gospel of the 13th Sunday of Luke [Young Man, Luke 18:18-27],* on the third Sunday the Apostolos of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9-15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1-10], and on the fourth the Apostolos of the 17th Sunday [2nd Corinthians 6:16 - 7:1] and the Gospel of the Canaanite Woman [17th Sunday of Matthew, Matthew 15:21-28].
units.english_text: 3.    If three Sundays intervene: on the first we read the Epistle of the 29th Sunday [Colossians 3:4–11] and the Gospel of the Ten Lepers [12th Sunday of Luke, Luke 17:12–19]; on the second we read the Epistle of the 32nd Sunday [1 Timothy 4:9–15] and the Gospel of Zacchaeus [15th Sunday of Luke, Luke 19:1–10]; and on the third we read the Epistle of the 17th Sunday [2 Corinthians 6:16–7:1] and the Gospel of the Canaanite Woman [17th Sunday of Matthew, Matthew 15:21–28].

provenance.verbatim_source: 3. units.slavonic_text: Τῇ ΙΖ΄.    Τοῦ Ὁσίου πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀντωνίου τοῦ Μεγάλου.
units.english_text: 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου δ΄, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ὁσίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα*, τοῦ Ὁσίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ὁσίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 5)    After the Leave-taking of the Feast of Epiphany, on the first Sunday or Feast, we begin the Katavasie of the Presentation "The sun once shone" and the Kontakion "You who have sanctified by Your birth a virgin womb."
units.english_text: 2.    If it falls on Sunday: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 6 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Righteous Saint; **"Glory..."**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saint [Wisdom 3:1–9; Wisdom 5:15–6:3; Wisdom 4:7–15]. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Righteous Saint; **"Both now and ever..."**: **"O Virgin Unwedded"** (*Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*); the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Righteous Saint: **"Emulating the zealous Elijah in thy ways"** (*Ζηλωτὴν Ἠλίαν*), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: The 17th.    Our Holy Father Anthony the Great.
units.english_text: 3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Righteous Saint, and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Righteous Saint, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in sequence, and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia] that of the Righteous Saint with its Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Righteous Saint; after the Third Ode, the Kontakion and Kathisma of the Righteous Saint, and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Righteous Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Righteous Saint...[^237]

units.slavonic_text: 1.    If the Feast of the Righteous Saint occurs on any day except Sunday, his Service is sung according to the Order of the Mineon. 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Righteous Saint, Glory of the Righteous Saint, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Righteous Saint, Now and ever, "Unwedded Virgin." The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal. 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Righteous Saint and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Righteous Saint and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Kathismata of the order, and in the 3rd Stasis [Stichologia] that of the Righteous Saint with the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrec- tion and of the Righteous Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Kathisma of the Righteous Saint and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion. The Katavasie "The sun once shone," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing "More honorable." The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Righteous Saint. Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation."

units.slavonic_text: δ΄.    Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Ὁσίου· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Ὁσίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικήν, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 5.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ὁσίου γ΄, Δόξα, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ὁσίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, τοῦ Ὁσίου, Καὶ νῦν τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ὁσίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 6.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὰ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας τοῦ Ὁσίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, εἶτα Κάθισμα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄ τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ὁσίου. Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. Ἐν τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου ἕτερα δ΄. Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ὁσίου Ἀντωνίου δύναται νὰ συμπέσῃ ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ ἀπὸ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ
units.english_text: 6.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὰ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας τοῦ Ὁσίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ὁσίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, εἶτα Κάθισμα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*. Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τοῦ Ὁσίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄ τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ὁσίου. *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*. Ἐν τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ ψάλλονται τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου ἕτερα δ΄. Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Κοινωνικὸν *Αἰνεῖτε*, *Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 4.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Righteous Saint. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint and of the Saint of the Church, Kontakion "You who have sanctified by Your birth a virgin womb." Apostolos of the Righteous Saint and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "Praise [the Lord]", "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal. 5.    If the Feast of the Righteous Saint occurs on the Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee, on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Triodion and 3 of the Righteous Saint, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Righteous Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Righteous Saint, Now and ever of the Triodion. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Righteous Saint, the Theotokion and Dismissal. 6.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Righteous Saint and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Ypakoi and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and in the 3rd Stasis [Stichologia] that of the Righteous Saint with the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection, of the Triodion and of the Righteous Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, then the Kathisma of the Triodion, the Righteous Saint and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, and the Minologion of the Righteous Saint, and the Postscript of the Triodion. The Katavasie "The sun once shone" and the entire order of the Morning Gospel of Matins of the Triodion. Then we sing "More honorable." The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion and of the Righteous Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Triodion and 3 of the Righteous Saint. Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation." Communion Hymn "Praise [the Lord]", "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: Τῇ ΙΗ΄.    Τῶν ἐν ἁγίοις πατέρων ἡμῶν Ἀθανασίου καὶ Κυρίλλου Πατριαρχῶν Ἀλεξανδρείας.
units.english_text: 3.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ μετὰ Τριῳδίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄. *Δόξα*, τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τῶν Ἁγίων, *Καὶ νῦν* τοῦ Τριῳδίου· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: The 18th.    Our Fathers Among the Saints Athanasios and Cyril, Patriarchs of Alexandria.
units.english_text: 3.    If it falls on Sunday within the Triodion: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 4 of the Saints; **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone. Entrance with censer, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Saints; **"Both now and ever..."**: of the Triodion; the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saints: **"Shining forth with deeds of orthodoxy"** (*Ἔργοις ἐκλάμψαντες ὀρθοδοξίας*), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    If the commemoration of the Saints occurs on any day except Sunday, their Service is sung according to the order of the Mineon. 2.    If the commemoration of the Saints occurs on a Sunday outside the Triodion period, their Service is sung according to the Sunday order of the Feast of Saint Anthony (see Paragraphs 2, 3, 4). 3.    If the commemoration of the Saint occurs on a Sunday within the Triodion period, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introduc- tory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried" we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 2 of the Triodion and 4 of the Saints. Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Triodion. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, the Theotokion and Dismissal. 4.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Liti of the Saints, the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Ypakoi and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; [then] the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and the third Stasis [Stichologia] of the Saints with the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon; the Canons of the Resurrection, of the Triodion and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, then the Kathisma of the Triodion, the Saints and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, and the Minologion of the Saints and the Postscript of the Triodion. The Katavasie "The sun once shone," and the entire order of the Morning Gospel of the Triodion; then we sing "More honorable." Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, of the Saints and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Triodion and 3 of the Saints, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation." In the Liturgy are sung the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Triodion. Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday, Communion Hymn "Praise [the Lord]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 4.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Saints, and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Hypakoe of the Tone, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in sequence, and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia] that of the Saints with its Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon, that of the Triodion, and that of the Saints; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, then the Kathisma of the Triodion, that of the Saints, and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Commentary [Synaxarion] of the Triodion; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel appointed for the Sundays of the Triodion; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Triodion, that of the Saints, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 3 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Saints; **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). In the Divine Liturgy: the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 other hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Triodion. The Epistle of the Saints [Hebrews 13:7–16] and the Gospel of the Sunday [Luke 18:10–14]; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal.[^239]

units.english_text: > *Σημ.* Ἀξιοσημείωτός ἐστιν ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ εἰς τὸν ἅγιον Εὐθύμιον α΄ Κανόνος, ποιηθέντος ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου τοῦ Δαμασκηνοῦ· διότι τούτου τοῦ Εἱρμοῦ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐν ταῖς μεταγενεστέραις ἐκδόσεσι πανταχοῦ ἀπαντᾶται οὕτω· *Παῖδας εὐαγεῖς ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ*, ἐν δὲ τῷ Κανόνι τούτῳ ἡ Ἀκροστιχὶς τοῦ Κανόνος *Ὄλβος πέφηνας γηγενῶν Εὐθύμιε* ἀπαιτεῖ τὸν τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς Εἱρμὸν ἄρχεσθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ Υ καὶ ἐν τοῖς κατὰ τὸ ,αφλγ΄ ἔτος ἐν Βενετίᾳ ἐκδοθεῖσι Μηναίοις ὑπὸ Στεφάνου Σαβίου, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς ἄρχεται ἀπὸ τοῦ Υ οὕτως *Υἱοὺς τῆς Σιὼν ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ* συμφώνως πρὸς τὴν Ἀκροστιχίδα, ἐξ οὗ δῆλον ὅτι αὕτη ἦν ἴσως ἡ ἀρχαία καὶ γνησία τοῦ Εἱρμοῦ τούτου ἀρχή· (Γνώμη τοῦ ἀοιδίμου Πατριάρχου Κωνσταντινουπόλεως Κωνσταντίου τοῦ Α΄).

units.slavonic_incipit: Σημ. Ἀξιοσημείωτός ἐστιν ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς
units.slavonic_text: Σημ. Ἀξιοσημείωτός ἐστιν ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ εἰς τὸν ἅγιον Εὐθύμιον α΄ Κανόνος, ποιηθέντος ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου τοῦ Δαμασκηνοῦ· διότι τούτου τοῦ Εἱρμοῦ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐν ταῖς μεταγενεστέραις ἐκδόσεσι πανταχοῦ ἀπαντᾶται οὕτω· Παῖδας εὐαγεῖς ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ, ἐν δὲ τῷ Κανόνι τούτῳ ἡ Ἀκροστιχὶς τοῦ Κανόνος Ὄλβος πέφηνας γηγενῶν Εὐθύμιε ἀπαιτεῖ τὸν τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς Εἱρμὸν ἄρχεσθαι ἀπὸ τοῦ Υ καὶ ἐν τοῖς κατὰ τὸ ,αφλγ΄ ἔτος ἐν Βενετίᾳ ἐκδοθεῖσι Μηναίοις ὑπὸ Στεφάνου Σαβίου, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς ἄρχεται ἀπὸ τοῦ Υ οὕτως Υἱοὺς τῆς Σιὼν ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ συμφώνως πρὸς τὴν Ἀκροστιχίδα, ἐξ οὗ δῆλον ὅτι αὕτη ἦν ἴσως ἡ ἀρχαία καὶ γνησία τοῦ Εἱρμοῦ τούτου ἀρχή· (Γνώμη τοῦ ἀοιδίμου Πατριάρχου Κωνσταντινουπόλεως Κωνσταντίου τοῦ Α΄).
units.english_text: 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ ἄνευ Τριῳδίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, *Δόξα*, *Ἡ γρήγορος γλῶσσά σου*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου *Τὰς καρδίας τῶν πιστῶν*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*.

units.slavonic_text: The 20th - Commemoration of our Righteous Father Efthymios the Great.
units.english_text: > *Note.* Worthy of note is the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode of the First Canon to Saint Euthymius, composed by Saint John of Damascus; for in later editions the beginning of this Heirmos is everywhere found thus: **"The holy Children in the furnace"** (*Παῖδας εὐαγεῖς ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ*); whereas in this Canon the Acrostic **"A wealth to mortals hast thou appeared, O Euthymius"** (*Ὄλβος πέφηνας γηγενῶν Εὐθύμιε*) requires the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode to begin with the letter *Y* [Upsilon]; and in the Menaia published in Venice in the year 1533 by Stephanos Savios, the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode begins with *Y* thus: **"Sons of Zion in the furnace"** (*Υἱοὺς τῆς Σιὼν ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ*), in accordance with the Acrostic, from which it is evident that this was perhaps the ancient and genuine beginning of this Heirmos (opinion of the ever-memorable Patriarch of Constantinople Constantius I).

units.slavonic_text: 1.    If the commemoration of the Saint occurs on any day except Sunday, or on a Sunday within or outside the Triodion period, the Service is sung according to the Sunday order of the Feast of Saint Anthony, see Paragraphs 1 - 6. Note: The Irmos of the 8th Ode of the First Canon of Saint Efthymios, composed by Saint John of Damascus, is worthy of note since the beginning of this Irmos in the earlier editions always began thus: “Παῖδας εὐαγεῖς ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ”; however, in this Canon the Acrostic of the Canon “Ὄλβος πέφηνας γηγενῶν Εὐθύμιε” requires that the Irmos of the 8th Ode begin with the letter “Υ,” and, in the Mineon published in Venice in 1533 by Stephanos Savios, the Irmos of the 9th Ode does begin with an “Υ” thus: “Υἱοὺς τῆς Σιὼν ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ” in accordance with the Acrostic. From this, one can say that this is perhaps the ancient and genuine beginning of this Irmos (opinion of the ever-memorable Patriarch of Constantinople Constantios the First).

units.slavonic_text: The 25th.    Our Father among the Saints Gregory the Theolo- gian.
units.english_text: 2.    If it occurs on Sunday outside the Triodion: on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 6 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory..."**: **"Thy watchful tongue"** (*Ἡ γρήγορος γλῶσσά σου*); **"Both now and ever..."**: the first Theotokion of the Tone; Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; **"Glory..."**: of the Saint: **"The hearts of the faithful"** (*Τὰς καρδίας τῶν πιστῶν*); **"Both now and ever..."**: **"O Virgin Unwedded"** (*Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε*)...[^240]

units.english_text: 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὸ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.english_text: 3.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Saint, and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in sequence, and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia] that of the Saint with its Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: the Resurrectional Canon and that of the Saint; after the Third Ode, the Resurrectional Kontakion with its Ikos, then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Menologion; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we recite the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exapostilaria: the Resurrectional Exapostilarion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira and 4 of the Saint; **"Glory..."**: of the Saint (*Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου*); **"Both now and ever..."**: **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη ὑπάρχεις*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).
