units.slavonic_text: 14.	In Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, 3 of the Triodion and 3 of the Post-feast, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever of the Post-feast. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Feast once, and Dismissal. 15.	On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, the Apolytikion of the Feast, the Exapsalmos and the Triadic "It is meet."* At "God is the Lord": the Resurrection Apolytikion twice and the Feast's once, the Psalter and the Amomos. The Kathismata of the Resurrection and one of the Feast's in place of each of the Theotokia, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon; the Canons of the Resurrection, of the Triodion and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, the Kathisma of the Triodion and of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, and the Minologion and of the Postscript of the Triodion. The Katavasie "The sun once shone" and the entire order of the Matins Gospel of the Triodion; then "More honorable." Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, the Triodion, and the Post-feast "Unchangeable according to hypostasis" (see February 3). At the Praises: 5 Resurrection Stichira, and 3 of the Triodion, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever, "Most blessed," Great Doxology and "Today salvation" and immediately the Liturgy, in which are sung the Typika and the Beatitudes 4 of the Mode and 4 hymns of the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Triodion. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, that of the Church and the Kontakion "By Your birth You sanctified a virgin womb." The Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "Praise [the Lord]," "We have seen the [true] Light" and Dismissal. {See above, Paragraph 6.}

Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς· αἱ καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα τὰ Μεγαλυνάρια *Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστιν* ὡς ἐν § 2· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς [*Ὁ ἐν χερσὶ πρεσβυτικαῖς*]. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.slavonic_text: 17.	Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, τὸ τῆς Λιτῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Δόξα Ἰδιόμελον (ἐὰν ὑπάρχῃ), εἶτα τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς· αἱ καταβασίαι Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα τὰ Μεγαλυνάρια Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστιν ὡς ἐν § 2· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς [Ὁ χερσὶ πρεσβυτικαῖς]. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.
units.english_text: 19.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῷ Σαββάτῳ τῶν Ψυχῶν, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῶν Ψυχῶν μετατίθεται καὶ προψάλλεται τῷ πρὸ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Ἀσώτου Σαββάτῳ· ἡ δὲ Ἀκολουθία τῆς ἑορτῆς ψάλλεται ἀμεταθέτως καὶ ἀπαραλλάκτως ὡς διετυπώθη ἐν § 1, 2, 3. Αὕτη ἦν καὶ ἡ διάταξις τῶν παλαιῶν Τυπικῶν, ὡς καὶ ἡ γνώμη τῶν ἀοιδίμων Πατριαρχῶν Κωνσταντίου τοῦ Βυζαντίου καὶ Γρηγορίου τοῦ ς΄.

units.english_text: 17.    On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, and **"Glory..."**: the Idiomelon of the Litiya of the Triodion (when there is one), and the Triadic hymns **"It is truly meet"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Amomos [Kathisma 17, Ps. 118 LXX]; the Resurrectional Kathismata, and one of the Feast in place of each of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, and of the Feast; after the Third Ode: the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, the Kathisma of the Triodion, and that of the Feast; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Sunday; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel as prescribed in the Triodion; then the Megalynaria: **"It is inconceivable"** (*Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστι*), as outlined in Paragraph 2; the Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, and of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 2 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Feast; **"Glory..."**: of the Triodion; **"Both now and ever..."**: of the Feast: **"He Who in the arms of the Elder"** (*Ὁ ἐν χερσὶ πρεσβυτικαῖς*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and Glory of the Liti of the Triodion (when there is one), and the Triadic "It is meet"; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata and one of the Feast's in place of each of the Theotokia, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection, of the Triodion and of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, the Kathisma of the Triodion and that of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, and the Minologion and the Postscript of the Sunday. The Katavasie "The sun once shone" and the entire order of the Matins Gospel as prescribed in the Triodion; then the Megalynaria "It is inconceivable," as outlined in Paragraph 2, Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, and of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Triodion and 3 of the Feast, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever of the Feast {"In elderly hands," Great Doxology and "Today salvation." 18.	In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast {see above Paragraph 3}. In the 2nd Antiphon: "O Son of God who was carried in the arms of Symeon the Just." The Entrance Hymn "The Lord has made known his victory; he has revealed his vindication in the sight of the nations. O Son of God who is risen from the dead, save us who sing to You, Alleluia!" The Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, and the Kontakion "By Your birth You sanctified a virgin womb." The Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially," "O Theotokos, the Hope [... In the shadow"], Communion Hymn "I will receive the cup of salvation," "We have seen the [true] Light" and Dismissal. {See above Paragraph 6.}
units.english_text: 18.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast {see above in Paragraph 3}. At the Second Antiphon: Refrain: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast carried in the arms of the righteous Symeon..."** (*Ὁ ἐν ἀγκάλαις τοῦ Δικαίου Συμεὼν βασταχθείς*); the Entrance Hymn [Introit]: **"The Lord hath made known His salvation; He hath revealed His righteousness before the nations. Save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead, who sing to Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Ἐγνώρισε Κύριος· Σῶσον ἡμᾶς . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*, Ps. 97:2 LXX); the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who didst sanctify the virginal womb by Thy birth"** (*Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικήν*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At **"Especially"**: **"O Theotokos, Hope of all Christians... In the shadow of the law"** (*Θεοτόκε ἡ ἐλπίς . . . [Ἐν νόμῳ σκιᾷ]*); Communion Verse: **"I will receive the cup of salvation"** (*Ποτήριον σωτηρίου λήψομαι*, Ps. 115:4 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινόν*), and Dismissal {see above in Paragraph 6}.

units.english_text: 19.    If the Feast occurs on the Saturday of Souls [Meatfare Saturday], the Office of the Souls is transferred and chanted beforehand on the Saturday prior to the Sunday of the Prodigal Son; the Office of the Feast, on the other hand, is chanted without transfer and without variation exactly as prescribed in Paragraphs 1, 2, and 3. This was also the rubric of the ancient Typika, and the judgment of the renowned Patriarchs Constantios the Byzantine and Gregory the Sixth.

units.slavonic_text: 19.	If the Feast occurs on the Saturday of the Souls, the Service of the Saturday of the Souls is chanted on the previous Saturday, i.e. the Saturday before the Sunday of the Prodigal Son; the Service of the Feast, on the other hand, is chanted without being moved to another day and without any alteration as prescribed in Paragraphs 1, 2, and 3. This is the order as prescribed in the ancient Typika, according also to the opinion of the revered Patriarchs Constantios the Byzantine and Gregory the Sixth. units.slavonic_incipit: ὅταν συμπέσῃ ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν
units.slavonic_text: ὅταν συμπέσῃ ἐν μιᾷ τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀπὸ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου μέχρι τῆς Κυριακῆς τῆς Τυρινῆς.
units.english_text: **β΄.**    Ἀπὸ τοῦ Σαββάτου τῆς τοῦ Ἀσώτου παραμονῆς μέχρι τῆς Τρίτης τῆς ἑβδομάδος τῆς Ἀπόκρεω, ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτή, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις γίνεται τῇ πρὸ τοῦ Σαββάτου τῶν Ψυχῶν Παρασκευῇ, διότι ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῶν Ψυχῶν οὐ μετατίθεται διὰ τὴν Ἀπόδοσιν τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀλλὰ ψάλλεται ἀμεταθέτως ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ τῶν Ψυχῶν Σαββάτῳ κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ διάταξιν.

units.slavonic_incipit: α΄. Ἀπὸ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Τελώνου
units.slavonic_text: α΄.	Ἀπὸ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Τελώνου καὶ Φαρισαίου μέχρι τῆς Παρασκευῆς τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος, ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτή, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις γίνεται τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἡμέρᾳ, ἤτοι τῇ Θ΄ τοῦ μηνός. β΄.	Ἀπὸ τοῦ Σαββάτου τῆς τοῦ Ἀσώτου παραμονῆς μέχρι τῆς Τρίτης τῆς ἑβδομάδος τῆς Ἀπόκρεω, ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτή, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις γίνεται τῇ πρὸ τοῦ Σαββάτου τῶν Ψυχῶν Παρασκευῇ, διότι ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῶν Ψυχῶν οὐ μετατίθεται διὰ τὴν Ἀπόδοσιν τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀλλὰ ψάλλεται ἀμεταθέτως ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ τῶν Ψυχῶν Σαββάτῳ κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ διάταξιν. γ΄.	Ἀπὸ τῆς Τετάρτης τῆς ἑβδομάδος τῆς Ἀπόκρεω μέχρι τοῦ Σαββάτου τῶν Ψυχῶν, ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτή, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις γίνεται τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς Τυρινῆς. δ΄.	Ἀπὸ τῆς Κυριακῆς τῆς Ἀπόκρεω, μέχρι τῆς τρίτης τῆς Τυρινῆς, ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτή, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις γίνεται τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος. ε΄.	Ἀπὸ τῆς τετάρτης τῆς Τυρινῆς, μέχρι τοῦ Σαββάτου, ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτή, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις γίνεται τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Τυρινῆς καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία ὡς διετυπώθη ἐν § 16, 17, 18. Συμπιπτούσης δὲ τῆς ἑορτῆς τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Τυρινῆς, ὅτε καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία κατὰ τὴν § 11, 12, 13 διάταξιν, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις ψάλλεται τῇ αὐτῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας ὡς ἐφεξῆς. 20.	Τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς Κυριακῆς τῆς Τυρινῆς, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ γ΄ τῶν Αἴνων τῆς ἑορτῆς Στιχηρὰ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Θεοδόχου Συμεὼν Δίκαιος καὶ τέλειος, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀνοιγέσθω ἡ Πύλη. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Μέγα Προκείμενον Μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς ἐκ τρίτου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ἔλαμψεν ἡ χάρις σου δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὁ τοῖς Χερουβὶμ ἐποχούμενος, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου καὶ ἡ Ἀπόλυσις οὕτω· Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός, ἡ ἐλπὶς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι, ὁ ἐν ἀγκάλαις τοῦ δικαίου Σημεὼν βασταχθῆναι καταδεξάμενος διὰ τὴν ἡμῶν σωτηρίαν Χριστὸς ὁ ἀληθινὸς Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Παναχράντου αὐτοῦ Μητρός, τῶν ἁγίων, ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων Ἀποστόλων καὶ πάντων τῶν Ἁγίων, ἐλεήσαι
units.english_text: **γ΄.**    Ἀπὸ τῆς Τετάρτης τῆς ἑβδομάδος τῆς Ἀπόκρεω μέχρι τοῦ Σαββάτου τῶν Ψυχῶν, ἐν οἵᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτή, ἡ Ἀπόδοσις γίνεται τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς Τυρινῆς.

units.english_text: 20.    On the evening of Cheesefare Sunday [Forgiveness Sunday], following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Stichira from the Praises of the Feast and 3 of the God-receiver Symeon: **"Righteous and perfect"** (*Δίκαιος καὶ τέλειος*); **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"Let the gate of heaven be opened"** (*Ἀνοιγέσθω ἡ πύλη*); Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Great Prokeimenon: **"Turn not away Thy face"** (*Μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς*, Ps. 68:18 LXX) thrice. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon: **"Thy grace hath shone forth"** (*Ἔλαμψεν ἡ χάρις σου*) twice, and the Martyrikon; **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"He Who is borne on high by the Cherubim"** (*Ὁ τοῖς Χερουβὶμ ἐποχούμενος*); **"Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, Luke 2:29); the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion thrice; and the Dismissal as follows: **"Glory to Thee, O Christ our God, our hope, glory to Thee. May He Who for our salvation deigned to be carried in the arms of the righteous Symeon, Christ our true God, through the intercessions of His all-pure Mother, of the holy, glorious, and all-praised Apostles, and of all the Saints, have mercy upon us and save us, as He is good and the Lover of mankind"** (*Δόξα σοι, ὁ Θεός, ἡ ἐλπὶς ἡμῶν, δόξα σοι· ὁ ἐν ἀγκάλαις τοῦ Δικαίου Συμεὼν βασταχθῆναι καταδεξάμενος διὰ τὴν ἡμῶν σωτηρίαν, Χριστὸς ὁ ἀληθινὸς Θεὸς ἡμῶν...*), without **"Through the prayers of our holy fathers"** (*Δι’ εὐχῶν*); but immediately the Choirs chant **"O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*)...[^258]

units.english_text: ...καὶ σῶσαι ἡμᾶς ὡς ἀγαθὸς καὶ φιλάνθρωπος, ἄνευ τοῦ *Δι’ εὐχῶν*, ἀλλ’ εὐθὺς οἱ Χοροὶ ψάλλουσι τὸ *Θεοτόκε Παρθένε* κτλ. τὸ *Κύριε ἐλέησον* μ΄, *Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός*, τὸ *Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*, καὶ μετὰ τὰς Μετανοίας, ὁ Ἱερεὺς ἄνευ ἑτέρας Ἀπολύσεως τὸ *Εὐξώμεθα ὑπὲρ εἰρήνης τοῦ κόσμου*, εἶτα ψάλλουσιν οἱ Χοροὶ τὸ *Πάντων προστατεύεις* ἵνα οὕτω τὴν ἐξ ἔθους ἱεροῦ ἀρχαίου ἐν τῷ τέλει τοῦ προεισοδίου τούτου Ἑσπερινοῦ τῆς τεσσαρακονθημέρου νηστείας οἱ εὐσεβεῖς Χριστιανοὶ λάβωσι τὴν συγχώρησιν· καὶ ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν τῇ περιστάσει ταύτῃ.

units.english_text: 21.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Α΄ ἑβδομάδος τῶν Νηστειῶν, τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Τυρινῆς ἑσπέρας, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα τοῦ Τριῳδίου *Ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν σάρκα* καὶ τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Λέγε Συμεών*, *Δόξα*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἀνοιγέσθω ἡ Πύλη*, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον *Ἰδοὺ δὴ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ Ἰδιόμελον (τοῦ Τριῳδίου) *Ἔλαμψεν ἡ χάρις σου* καὶ τὰ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἀπόστιχα Ἰδιόμελα *Κατακόσμησον τὸν Νυμφῶνά σου* καὶ *Τὸν ἐκλάμψαντα πρὸ αἰώνων*, *Δόξα*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὁ τοῖς Χερουβὶμ ἐποχούμενος*, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς ἐκ τρίτου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 22.    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ, εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ἐκ τρίτου, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος. Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν τοῦ Τριῳδίου *Τῆς νηστείας τῇ θείᾳ ἀπαρχῇ*, καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Χορὸς ἀγγελικός*, εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν *Τὴν πάνσεπτον ἐγκράτειαν*, καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ὁ ὢν σὺν τῷ Πατρί*, εἰς δὲ τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἐκ δευτέρου· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου· ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα, *Δόξα*, *Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλεησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ἀνοιγέσθω ἡ πύλη*, ὁ Κανὼν εἰς ἕξ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ, ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*, εἶτα τὰ Μεγαλυνάρια *Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστι*, μετὰ τῶν τῆς Θ΄ Ὠδῆς Τροπαρίων ὡς διετυπώθησαν ἐν § 2· τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον *Ἐν πνεύματι τῷ Ἱερῷ*...

units.english_text: ...**"O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*), etc.; **"Lord, have mercy"** (40 times); **"Blessed be He Who is"** (*Ὁ ὢν εὐλογητός*); **"Heavenly King"** (*Ἐπουράνιε Βασιλεῦ*); and after the Prostrations [Metanias], the Priest, without any other Dismissal prayer, intones: **"Let us pray for the peace of the world"** (*Εὐξώμεθα ὑπὲρ εἰρήνης τοῦ κόσμου*). Then the Choirs chant **"Thou protectest all"** (*Πάντων προστατεύεις*), so that, according to a venerable and ancient sacred custom, at the conclusion of this Introductory Vespers for the forty-day Fast [Great Lent], the pious Christians may receive mutual forgiveness; and the Apodosis of the Feast is observed in this situation.

units.english_text: 21.    If the Feast occurs on Monday of the First Week of the Great Fast [Clean Monday]: on Cheesefare Sunday evening at Vespers, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 3 Idiomela of the Triodion: **"Subduing the flesh by abstinence"** (*Ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν σάρκα*), and 3 of the Feast: **"Say, O Symeon"** (*Λέγε Συμεών*); **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"Let the gate of heaven be opened"** (*Ἀνοιγέσθω ἡ πύλη*); Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon: **"Behold now, bless the Lord"** (*Ἰδοὺ δὴ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 133:1 LXX), and the Old Testament Readings of the Feast. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon of the Triodion: **"Thy grace hath shone forth"** (*Ἔλαμψεν ἡ χάρις σου*), and the two Aposticha Idiomela of the Feast: **"Adorn thy bridal chamber"** (*Κατακόσμησον τὸν Νυμφῶνά σου*) and **"He Who shone forth before the ages"** (*Τὸν ἐκλάμψαντα πρὸ αἰώνων*); **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: **"He Who is borne on high by the Cherubim"** (*Ὁ τοῖς Χερουβὶμ ἐποχούμενος*); the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast thrice, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 22.    On Monday [Clean Monday] at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Feast; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Hexapsalmos. At **"God is the Lord"** (*Θεὸς Κύριος*): the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast thrice; the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata: at the first Stichologia, that of the Triodion: **"At the divine beginning of the Fast"** (*Τῆς νηστείας τῇ θείᾳ ἀπαρχῇ*), and that of the Feast: **"The angelic choir"** (*Χορὸς ἀγγελικός*); at the second Stichologia: **"The all-venerable continence"** (*Τὴν πάνσεπτον ἐγκράτειαν*), and that of the Feast: **"He Who is with the Father"** (*Ὁ ὢν σὺν τῷ Πατρί*); and at the third Stichologia: that of the Feast repeated; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"I will remember Thy name"** (*Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*, Ps. 44:18 LXX); **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Morning Gospel; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; **"Glory..."**: **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); **"Both now and ever..."**: the same; the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:3 LXX); and the Idiomelon: **"Let the gate of heaven be opened"** (*Ἀνοιγέσθω ἡ πύλη*); the Canon to 6; after the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Feast once; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Menologion; the Katavasiai: **"The sun once shone upon the dry ground"** (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*); then the Megalynaria **"It is inconceivable"** (*Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστι*) with the Troparia of the Ninth Ode as formulated in Paragraph 2; the Exapostilarion: **"In spirit in the holy Temple"** (*Ἐν πνεύματι τῷ Ἱερῷ*) thrice. At the Praises: the Stichira Prosomia: **"Fulfilling the written Law"** (*Νόμον τὸν ἐν γράμματι*); **"Glory... Both now and ever..."**: of the Feast: **"He Who in the arms of the Elder"** (*Ὁ ἐν χερσὶ πρεσβυτικαῖς*); Great Doxology...[^259]

Ὁ ἐν ἀγκάλαις τοῦ Δικαίου Συμεὼν βασταχθῆναι καταδεξάμενος, διὰ τὴν ἡμῶν σωτηρίαν, κτλ.*) Κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.

Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὁ ἐν χερσὶ πρεσβυτικαῖς· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον. 23 Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Εἰσοδικόν, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Ἀπόστολος, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Θεοτόκε ἡ ἐλπίς, Κοινωνικὸν Ποτήριον. Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις· Δόξα Σοι, ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, δόξα Σοι. Ὁ ἐν ἀγκάλαις τοῦ Δικαίου Συμεὼν βασταχθῆναι καταδεξάμενος, διὰ τὴν ἡμῶν σωτηρίαν, κτλ.) Κατάλυσις οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου.
units.english_text: 24.    Τῇ αὐτῇ Δευτέρᾳ ἑσπέρας ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτὴ καὶ ψάλλεται ὁ Ἑσπερινὸς ἀπαραλλάκτως ὡς προδιετυπώθη ἐν § 1, πλὴν τῶν Ἀναγνωσμάτων· μετὰ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Χαῖρε Κεχαριτωμένη* ἐκ τρίτου, Ἀπόλυσις καὶ Ἀπόδοσις. Ἀπόδειπνον Μέγα οὐ λέγομεν ταύτῃ τῇ ἑσπέρᾳ διὰ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς αἰδέσιμον, λέγομεν δὲ τὸ Μικρὸν Ἀπόδειπνον ἐν τοῖς κελλίοις· καὶ ταῦτα διὰ τοὺς ἐν πόλεσιν Ἱεροὺς Ναούς, ἐν δὲ ταῖς Ἱεραῖς Μοναῖς, ἐξακολουθήτωσαν κατὰ τὰ ἀρχαῖα τῶν Κτητόρων αὐτῶν Τυπικά. Αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ γνώμη τῶν ἀοιδίμων πατριαρχῶν Κωνσταντίου τοῦ Βυζαντίου καὶ Γρηγορίου τοῦ ΣΤ΄.

Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου καὶ Κοντάκιον ἐν τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν.

units.english_text: 23.    At the Divine Liturgy: the Antiphons of the Feast, the Entrance Hymn [Introit], the Dismissal Troparion, the Kontakion, the Epistle, the Gospel, and then the Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom. At "Especially": "O Theotokos, Hope of all Christians... In the shadow of the law", etc.; Communion Verse: "I will receive the cup of salvation" (Ps. 115:4 LXX); "We have seen the true light", and Dismissal: {"Glory to Thee, O Christ our God, our hope, glory to Thee. May He Who for our salvation deigned to be carried in the arms of the righteous Symeon, etc."} The partaking of wine and oil is permitted.

units.slavonic_text: Doxology and the Apolytikion. 23. In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast, the Entrance Hymn, the Apolytikion, the Kontakion, the Apostolos, the Gospel, and then the Liturgy of Chrysostom. At “Especially,” “O Theotokos, the hope . . . In the shadow,” etc., Communion Hymn “I will receive the cup of salvation,” “We have seen the [true] Light” and Dismissal {“Glory to You, our God, glory to You. May He who for our salvation were carried in the arms of Symeon the Just, etc.,} The partaking of wine and oil is allowed.
units.english_text: 24.    On this same Monday evening the Apodosis of the Feast is celebrated, and Vespers is chanted without any alteration exactly as prescribed in Paragraph 1, omitting the Old Testament Readings. After the Dismissal Troparion "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos" thrice: Dismissal and Apodosis. We do not say Great Compline this evening because of reverence for the Feast; we do, however, say Small Compline in our cells. This directive pertains to the Churches in the city; in the Holy Monasteries, however, let them follow the order of the ancient Typika of their Founders. The above is the judgment of the renowned Patriarchs Constantios the Byzantine and Gregory the Sixth.

units.slavonic_text: The Leave-taking. 24. On this Monday evening the Leave-taking of the Feast and Vespers are sung without any alteration as prescribed in Paragraph 1, omitting the Readings. Then the Apolytikion “Hail, O Theotokos Virgin” 3 times, Dismissal and Leave-taking. We do not say the Great Compline this evening because of reverence for the Feast; we do, however, say the Small Compline in our cells. This observation pertains to the Churches in the City; in the Holy Monasteries, however, let them follow the order of the ancient Typika of their Founders. The above is the opinion of the revered Patriarchs Constantios the Byzantine and Gregory the Sixth. The Feast of the Presentation of Our Lord may occur in the Triodion period from the Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee until the Monday of the First Week of the Fast [Great Lent]. (See the Chart of the 34 Paschalia.)

units.english_text: 1.    If the commemoration of the Hieromartyr occurs on any day except a Sunday, from the beginning of the Triodion period until the Friday of Cheesefare Week, his Office is chanted as prescribed in the Menaion. At Matins: Katavasiai "I shall open my mouth"; and in the Divine Liturgy: the Kontakion "Protection of Christians".

Εἰ τύχοι ἐν ταῖς πρώταις τέσσαρσι Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. units.english_text: 4.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ψάλλεται ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Δόξα*, *Καὶ νῦν* τοῦ Τριῳδίου (ἐὰν ὑπάρχῃ)· εἰ δὲ μὴ *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*· εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος. Τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὸ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, εἶτα ψάλλεται τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου β΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.english_text: 2.    If the commemoration occurs on a Sunday outside the Triodion period, the Office of the Saint together with the Resurrectional Office is chanted as on the commemorations of other celebrated Saints when they occur on a Sunday: for the Doxastikon of the Praises is chanted the Eothinon, the Epistle of the Saint, and the Gospel of the Sunday; Kontakion: "Protection of Christians"; Communion Verse: "Praise the Lord from the heavens" (Ps. 148:1 LXX), etc.

units.english_text: 3.    If the commemoration occurs on any of the first four Sundays of the Triodion period: on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone; Little Entrance, "O Gladsome Light", the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Triodion; the Resurrectional Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: Τῇ Πέμπτῃ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου Προσόμοια γ΄, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα τῆς ἑορτῆς, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 7.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τοῦ Ὄρθρου Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, *Δόξα*, *Ταῖς τοῦ ἀθλοφόρου*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλεησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τοῦ Ἁγίου *Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ*, Κανόνες ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*, καὶ ψάλλονται τὰ Μεγαλυνάρια τῆς ἑορτῆς *Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστιν* ὡς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 7. Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τοῦ Ὄρθρου Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ ἀθλοφόρου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλεησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τοῦ Ἁγίου Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ, Κανόνες ὁ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον, καὶ ψάλλονται τὰ Μεγαλυνάρια τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστιν ὡς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. 8. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν Ἐγνώρισε Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον Ὁ μήτραν παρθενικήν, Ἀπόστολος καὶ

units.english_text: 7.    At Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Saint is chanted; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Hexapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter and the Polyeleos of the Saint; the Kathismata of the Saint and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" (Ps. 91:13 LXX); then "Let every breath", and the Morning Gospel of the Saint; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": "Through the intercessions of the prize-bearing champion" (*Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀθλοφόρου*); "Both now and ever...": "Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"; the Verse: "Have mercy upon me, O God" (Ps. 50:3 LXX); and the Idiomelon of the Saint: "O God-crowned phalanx" (*Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ*); the Canons: that of the Feast and that of the Saint; after the Third Ode: the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the Feast; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Menologion; the Katavasiai: "The sun once shone upon the dry ground" (*Χέρσον ἀβυσσοτόκον*); and the Megalynaria of the Feast: "It is inconceivable" (*Ἀκατάληπτόν ἐστι*) are chanted as on the day of the Feast; Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saint, and again of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

units.slavonic_text: 6. If the Feast of Saint Charalampos occurs on the Saturday of the Souls, the Service of the Saint is sung in anticipation on Friday together with the Leave-taking of the Presentation [of the Lord] as follows: On Thursday at Vespers following the Introductory Psalm and the First Stasis [Stichologia] of the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing 3 Idiomela of the Feast and 3 Prosomia of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela of the Feast, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Saint and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal. 7. In Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Saint, then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos of the Saint. The Kathismata of the Saint and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia, the Anavathmi, the first Antiphon of the Mode IV and the Prokimenon “The righteous shall flourish” [Psalm 91:13 LXX, 92:12 RSV]. Then “Let all breath” and the Matins Gospel of the Saint; Psalm 50 read, Glory, “Through the intercessions of the fight-bearing one,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “Have mercy upon me” and the Idiomelon of the Saint “God-crowned phalanx”; the Canons of the Feast and of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saint and of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint and the Minologion. The Katavasie “The sun once shone” and the Megalynaria “It is inconceivable” as on the day of the Feast. Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saint and again of the Feast. At the Praises: the 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast. 8. In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast and the Entrance Hymn “The Lord has made known.” The Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Saint and the Kontakion “By Your birth You sanctified a virgin womb.” Apostolos
units.english_text: 8. units.slavonic_text: Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Θεοτόκε ἡ ἐλπίς [... Ἐν νόμῳ σκιᾷ], Κοινωνικὸν Ποτήριον σωτηρίου, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Τῇ αὐτῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας καὶ τὸ πρωῒ ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῶν Ψυχῶν κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξιν.
units.english_text: 9.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τετάρτῃ ἢ τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς Τυρινῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν, ἄνευ τῶν ἐν τῷ Τριῳδίῳ Ἰδιομέλων τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τελεῖται ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου* καὶ Κοντάκιον *Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*.

units.english_text: 10.    If the commemoration occurs on the Saturday of Cheesefare [Commemoration of the Holy Ascetic Monks and Nuns], on Friday evening after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant 3 Prosomia of the Saint and 3 of the Holy Venerable Fathers; "Glory...": of the Saint: "Thou didst sacrifice unto God a sacrifice of praise" (*Ἔθυσας τῷ Θεῷ*); "Both now and ever...": "Who for Thy sake, O God-Father David" (*Ὁ διὰ σὲ Θεοπάτωρ*); Little Entrance, "O Gladsome Light", the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Holy Venerable Fathers; "Both now and ever...": "O Lady, receive the prayers of Thy servants" (*Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*); the Dismissal Troparia: of the Saint, of the Venerable Fathers, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 9. If the Feast occurs on Wednesday or Friday of Cheesefare Week, the Service of the Saint is sung according to the Order in the Mineon, without the Idiomela of the day from the Triodion. Then the Liturgy of Chrysostom is celebrated, Apostolos and Gospel of the Saint, Katavasie “I shall open my mouth” and the Kontakion “Protection of all Christians.”
units.english_text: 11.    On Saturday at Matins: according to the stipulated rubrical order of the Office, the Morning Gospel is that of the Saint; Canons: of the Theotokos ("Having traversed the deep water", *Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*), that of the Saint, and that of the Venerable Fathers; [the Katavasiai: "I shall open my mouth"; the Exapostilaria: of the Saint and of the Venerable Fathers,]* and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Saint and 3 of the Venerable Fathers; "Glory...": of the Saint: "As a full alabaster flask" (*Ὥσπερ ἀλάβαστρον πλῆρες*); "Both now and ever...": "We bless thee, O Virgin Theotokos" (*Μακαρίζομέν σε*); Great Doxology; the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint; and then follows the Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom; Kontakion: "Protection of Christians"; Epistle of the Saint and Gospel of the Venerable Fathers; Communion Verse: "The righteous shall be held in everlasting remembrance" (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX), etc.[^263]

units.english_text: 13.    If the commemoration occurs on Tuesday of the First Week of the Great Fast: on Monday morning at Vespers, at "Lord, I have cried", we chant 3 Prosomia of the day from the Triodion and 3 of the Saint to the melody: "Thou hast given a sign" (*Ἔδωκας σημείωσιν*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": Theotokion Prosomion; "O Gladsome Light", and the Old Testament Readings of the day (it is understood that these are from the Triodion). At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon of the Aposticha twice, and the Martyrikon; "Glory... Both now and ever...": Theotokion Prosomion; "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart" [Luke 2:29]; the Trisagion Prayers; "O Virgin Theotokos", etc.; and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: February 10: Hieromartyr Charalampos; Situation VIII Concl. (§§ 14 concl. – 15); Situation IX (§ 16); Situation X (§ 17 incipit) (p. 396)]
units.english_text: Αἴνους, τὰ δ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου Προσόμοια, *Δόξα*, *Ὥσπερ ἀλάβαστρον πλῆρες*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Μακαρίζομέν σε*, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ἀναγινώσκονται αἱ Ὧραι λιταί, ἐν αἷς λέγεται Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὴν Θ΄ Ὥραν ψάλλονται οἱ Μακαρισμοί, εἶτα τὸ *Χορὸς ὁ ἐπουράνιος*, τὸ *Πιστεύω εἰς ἕνα θεόν*, ἡ Εὐχὴ *Ἄνες, ἄφες*, τὸ *Πάτερ ἡμῶν*, *Ὅτι σοῦ ἐστιν*, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου· τὸ *Κύριε ἐλέησον* μ΄, *Ὁ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ*, *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν τῶν Χερουβίμ*, *Ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου*, *Ὁ Θεὸς οἰκτιρήσαι ἡμᾶς*, καὶ ποιοῦμεν τὰς διατετυπωμένας τρεῖς μεγάλας Μετανοίας, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, *Κύριε ἐλέησον* ιβ΄ καὶ ἡ Εὐχὴ *Παναγία Τριὰς* καὶ εὐθὺς ἡ Ἀπόλυσις, καὶ ἄρχεται ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων.

units.english_text: 15.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὸ τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἰδιόμελον *Νηστείαν οὐκ ἀποχὴν βρωμάτων* δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, εἶτα τὰ γ΄ τῆς σειρᾶς Προσόμοια *Βρώσει πάλαι πικρᾷ* καὶ δ΄ Προσόμοια τοῦ Ἁγίου *Ὅλος ἐκ νεότητος*, *Δόξα*, *Ἔθυσας τῷ Θεῷ*, *Καὶ νῦν* Σταυροθεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας, τὸ *Κατευθυνθήτω* καὶ ἡ Εὐλόγησις τῶν ἄρτων· μετὰ τὸ *Πλούσιοι ἐπτώχευσαν* εὐθὺς ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ *Νῦν αἱ δυνάμεις* καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον*, τὸ *Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Ἐν δὲ τῇ τραπέζῃ ξηροφαγία.

units.english_text: Theotokion. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": **"As a full alabaster flask"** (*Ὥσπερ ἀλάβαστρον πλῆρες*); "Both now and ever...": **"We bless thee, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Μακαρίζομέν σε*); Great Doxology, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the plain Hours are read, in which the Dismissal Troparion and Kontakion of the Saint are recited. At the Ninth Hour: the Beatitudes are chanted; then **"The heavenly choir"** (*Χορὸς ὁ ἐπουράνιος*); the Symbol of Faith (**"I believe in one God"**); the Prayer of Remission: **"Pardon, remit, forgive"** (*Ἄνες, ἄφες*); **"Our Father"**, the ecphonesis **"For Thine is the kingdom"**, and the Kontakion of the Saint; "Lord, have mercy" (40 times), the prayer **"Thou Who at all times"** (*Ὁ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ*), **"More honorable than the Cherubim"**, **"In the name of the Lord"**, **"God be merciful unto us"**, and we make the three prescribed great prostrations [metanias]; then the Trisagion Prayers, "Lord, have mercy" (12 times), and the prayer **"O Most Holy Trinity"** (*Παναγία Τριὰς*), and immediately the Dismissal; and the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts begins.

units.english_text: 15.    At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant the Idiomelon of the Aposticha: **"Keeping the fast not only by refraining from foods"** (*Νηστείαν οὐκ ἀποχὴν βρωμάτων*, twice), and the Martyrikon; then the 3 cycle Prosomia: **"By the tasting of bitter food of old"** (*Βρώσει πάλαι πικρᾷ*), and 4 Prosomia of the Saint: **"Wholly from thy youth"** (*Ὅλος ἐκ νεότητος*); "Glory...": **"Thou didst sacrifice unto God a sacrifice of praise"** (*Ἔθυσας τῷ Θεῷ*); "Both now and ever...": Stavrotheotokion; Little Entrance with the Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Old Testament Readings of the day; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX] and the Blessing of the Loaves [Artoklasia]; immediately following **"The rich have become poor"** [Ps. 33:11 LXX], the Epistle and the Gospel of the Saint, **"Now the powers of heaven"**, and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts; Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX), **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal. In the refectory, xerophagy [strict fast].

units.slavonic_text: Theotokion. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomia of the Saint, Glory, "As alabaster," Now and ever, "We bless you," Great Doxology, the Apolytikion of the Saint, and the Hours are read plainly, in which are said the Apolytikion and Kontakion of the Saint. In the Ninth Hour the Beatitudes are sung, then "The heavenly choir," "I believe in one God," the Prayer "Forgive, remit and pardon," "Our Father," "For Yours is," and the Kontakion of the Saint. Then "Lord, have mercy" (40 times), "You who at all times," "More honorable than the Cherubim," "In the name of the Lord," "God be merciful to us" and the three great Prostrations, then the Trisagion, "Lord, have mercy (12 times), and the Prayer "O Most Holy Trinity," and immediately the Dismissal, then the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts begins. 15. In Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the Idiomelon of the Aposticha "Let us keep the Fast not only by refraining from food" (twice) and the Hymn to the Martyrs, then the 3 Prosomia "Cast out of old from Paradise through the eating of bitter food," and the 4 Prosomia of the Saint "Entirely from your youth," Glory, "You offered to the Lord a sacrifice of praise" and the Stavrotheotokion. Entrance with the Gospel, "O Gladsome Light," and the Readings of the day. Then "Let my prayer arise," and the Blessing of the Bread [Artoklasia] followed immediately by "The rich have become poor." The Apostolos and the Gospel of the Saint, the "Now the powers of heaven" and the rest of the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts, Communion Hymn "In eternal memorial," "I will bless the Lord," and Dismissal. At table, xero- phagia (strict fast).

units.slavonic_text: morning after the Introductory Psalm and the "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the Idiomelon "While fasting with the body" (twice) and the Hymn to the Martyrs, the 3 Prosomia of the order, and 4 of the Saint, Glory, Now and ever Prosomion, Entrance "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings of the Triodion. units.slavonic_text: 18. If the Feast occurs on Friday of this week, on Thursday morning in Vespers, after the 3 Prosomia of the day are sung the 3 Prosomia of the Saint according to the order of Situation 8, Paragraph 13. On Friday morning, the Service of Matins with the Hours is sung as prescribed in Situation 8, Paragraph 14. Vespers with the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts is sung as follows: 19. In Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the Idiomelon of the day "Come, you faithful" (twice) the 4 Prosomia of Saint Charalampos, and 4 of Saint Theodore. Glory, "You offered to the Lord a sacrifice of praise" and the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance with the Gospel, "O Gladsome Light," and the Readings of the Triodion. Then the "Let my prayer arise," and the Blessing of the Bread [Artoklasia]; then follow the Apostolos and the Gospel of the Saint, the "Now the powers of heaven," Communion Hymn "In eternal memorial," "I will bless the Lord," and Dismissal. In the evening the Iki [Salutations] of the Theotokos as customary, then the Kontakion "You have carried as a shield of faith," etc.
units.english_text: 19.    At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant the Idiomelon of the day: **"Come, ye faithful, let us work"** (*Δεῦτε πιστοὶ ἐπεργασώμεθα*, twice), 4 Prosomia of St. Charalampos, and 4 of St. Theodore; "Glory...": **"Thou didst sacrifice unto God a sacrifice of praise"** (*Ἔθυσας τῷ Θεῷ*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone occurring; Little Entrance with the Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Old Testament Readings of the Triodion; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX] and the Blessing of the Loaves [Artoklasia]; then immediately the Epistle and Gospel of the Saint, **"Now the powers of heaven"**, Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX), **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: δ΄ Προσόμοια τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους, καὶ
units.slavonic_text: δ΄ Προσόμοια τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους, καὶ δ΄ τοῦ ἁγίου Θεοδώρου· Δόξα, Ὀργάνῳ χρησάμενος ὁ δυσμενής, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ θεοτοκίον τοῦ τυχόντος ἤχου. Εἴσοδος μετὰ Θυμιατοῦ, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῆς ἡμέρας. Νῦν αἱ δυνάμεις, Κοινωνικὸν Γεύσασθε, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀναγινώσκονται οἱ Οἶκοι τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὡς εἴθισται, καὶ μετὰ τὸ Τρισάγιον τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου κτλ., τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 21. Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ψάλλεται ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Μεγάλα τὰ τῆς πίστεως καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια τῶν Ἁγίων, μετὰ τῶν Θεοτοκίων. Εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν τὸ ἐκ τοῦ Τριῳδίῳ Ζέων πίστεως καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· καὶ εἰς τὴν γ΄ τὸ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, καὶ τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον, Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει, Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους· ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν ἀθλοφόρων [τοῦ ἀθλοφόρου],* Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου· ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ. Κανόνες ὁ α΄ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου εἰς τὴν δ΄ Ὠδὴν Ὁ καθήμενος ἐν δόξῃ· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους καὶ τὰ δύο τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, γ΄ προσόμοια τοῦ Ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Τριῳδίου· Δόξα, Ὥσπερ ἀλάβαστρον πλῆρες, Καὶ νῦν Μακαρίζομέν σε· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Μεγάλα τὰ τῆς πίστεως. 22. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια δ΄ ἐκ τῆς γ΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Μηναίου καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν· Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: Prosomia of Saint Charalampos, and 4 of Saint Theodore; Glory, "Using as his tool the Apostate Emperor," Now and ever the first Theotokion of the current Mode. Entrance with the censer, "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings of the day. The "Now the powers of heaven," Communion Hymn "Taste and see," "I will bless the Lord," and Dismissal. In the evening the Iki [Salutations] of the Theotokos are performed as customary, and, after the Trisagion, the Kontakion of the Saint, etc., the Gospel and Dismissal. 21. On Saturday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of Saint Charalampos is sung; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion "Great are the achievements of faith" and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia of the Saints and the Theotokion. Then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. Kathismata of the first Stasis [Stichologia], that of Saint Charalampos and the Theotokion. At the second Stasis [Stichologia] the Kathisma of the Triodion "Burning with faith" and the Theotokion; and in the third Stasis [Stichologia] that of Saint Charalampos and the Theotokion. The Anavathmi, the first Antiphon of Mode IV, and the Prokimenon "The righteous shall flourish" (Psalm 91:13 LXX, 92:12 RSV). Then "Let all breath" and the Matins Gospel of Saint Charalampos; then Psalm 50 (read), Glory, "Through the interces- sions of the fight-bearing ones [one],*" Now and ever, "Through the intercessions of the Theotokos," the Verse "Have mercy upon me" and the Idiomelon of the Saint "God-crowned phalanx." The Canons: the first of the Triodion and that of Saint Charalampos. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, then the Kathisma of the Saint, of the Triodion and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of Saint Charalampos and the Minologion of the Saints. The Katavasie "I shall open my mouth," and for the Fourth Ode we sing "He who sits in Glory"; then we chant "More honorable." The Exapostilaria: of Saint Charalampos and two of the Triodion. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of Saint and 3 of the Triodion; Glory, "As alabaster," Now and ever, "We bless you," Great Doxology, and the Apolytikion "Great are the achievements of faith." 22. In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes. 4 hymns from the 3rd Ode of the Canon of the Mineon and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Triodion. Apolytikia after the Entrance: of the Saints of the day, of the Saint of the Church, and Kontakion "Protection of all Christians." Apostolos of the Saint and Gospel of the day. At "Especially," "It is meet," Communion Hymn "In eternal memorial," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 21.    On Saturday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of St. Charalampos is chanted; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Great are the achievements of faith"** (*Μεγάλα τὰ τῆς πίστεως*, Tone 2), and the Hexapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia of the Saints and the Theotokia; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; Kathismata: of the first Stichologia, that of St. Charalampos and the Theotokion; at the second Stichologia, the Kathisma from the Triodion: **"Fervent in faith"** (*Ζέων πίστεως*) and the Theotokion; and at the third Stichologia, that of St. Charalampos and the Theotokion; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree"** (*Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει*, Ps. 91:13 LXX); then "Let every breath", and the Morning Gospel of St. Charalampos; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the prize-bearing champion [champions]"** (*Ταῖς τῶν ἀθλοφόρων [τοῦ ἀθλοφόρου]*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"**; the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God"** (Ps. 50:3 LXX); and the Idiomelon: **"O God-crowned phalanx"** (*Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ*). The Canons: the first Canon of the Triodion and that of St. Charalampos; after the Third Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion; then the Kathisma of the Saint, that of the Triodion, and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of St. Charalampos, and the Menologion of the Saints; the Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"**, and for the Fourth Ode the Heirmos: **"He Who sitteth in glory"** (*Ὁ καθήμενος ἐν δόξῃ*); then we chant with verses "More honorable than the Cherubim"; the Exapostilaria: that of St. Charalampos and the two of the Triodion. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of St. Charalampos and 3 of the Triodion; "Glory...": **"As a full alabaster flask"** (*Ὥσπερ ἀλάβαστρον πλῆρες*); "Both now and ever...": **"We bless thee, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Μακαρίζομέν σε*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion: **"Great are the achievements of faith"** (*Μεγάλα τὰ τῆς πίστεως*).

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: February 10: Hieromartyr Charalampos; Situation XIII: Sunday of Orthodoxy (§§ 23–25) (p. 402)]
units.english_text: 23.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Ὀρθοδοξίας, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου. *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τοῦ Τριῳδίου· τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 24.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ψάλλεται ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Δόξα* τοῦ Ἁγίου, *Καὶ νῦν* τοῦ Τριῳδίου *Χαίρετε προφῆται τίμιοι* καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ *Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Τὴν ἄχραντον εἰκόνα σου* καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος*, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὰ τῆς γ΄ Στιχολογίας τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, ὁ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ’ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι *Θαλάσσης τὸ ἐρυθραῖον πέλαγος*, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ ἐν ταῖς Κυριακαῖς τοῦ Τριῳδίου διάταξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*· Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, τοῦ Τριῳδίου γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. *Δόξα* τοῦ Τριῳδίου, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ὑπερευλογημένη*. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ *Σήμερον σωτηρία*.

units.english_text: 23.    If the commemoration occurs on the Sunday of Orthodoxy: on Saturday evening at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the reading from the Psalter [Kathisma 1], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant 4 Resurrectional Stichira, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone; Little Entrance, "O Gladsome Light", the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrectional Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Triodion; the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion [**"Thy pure icon do we venerate"**, *Τὴν ἄχραντον εἰκόνα σου*, Tone 2], of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

On Sunday at Matins: after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon and the Litiya of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Triodion: **"Rejoice, ye honored prophets"** (*Χαίρετε προφῆται τίμιοι*), and the Triadic hymns: **"It is truly meet"**; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Thy pure icon do we venerate"** (*Τὴν ἄχραντον εἰκόνα σου*), and the Hexapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos; the Resurrectional Kathismata in order, and the Kathisma of the third Stichologia of the Saint with the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, and of the Saint; after the Third Ode: the Resurrectional Kontakion and Ikos, then the Kathisma of the Triodion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion; after the Sixth Ode: the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion, the Menologion of the Saint, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Triodion; the Katavasiai: **"The Red Sea's abyssal depth"** (*Θαλάσσης τὸ ἐρυθραῖον πέλαγος*), and the entire order of the Morning Gospel appointed for Sundays of the Triodion; then we chant with verses "More honorable than the Cherubim"; Exapostilaria: that of the Resurrection, that of the Triodion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 2 Resurrectional Stichira, 3 of the Triodion, and 3 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Triodion; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

After the Little Entrance: the Dismissal Troparia of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, of the Saint, of the Patron Saint of the Temple, and the Kontakion: **"To thee, the champion leader"** (*Τῇ ὑπερμάχῳ*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday, and the rest of the Liturgy of St. Basil the Great follows; Communion Verse: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX), "We have seen the true light", and Dismissal.[^268]

units.slavonic_text: 23. If the Feast occurs on the Sunday of Orthodoxy, Saturday at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the Reading from the Psalter, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Triodion and 3 Prosomia of the Saint, Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," and the Readings of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Triodion. Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, of the Saint, the Theotokion and Dismissal. 24. On Sunday, at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon and the Liti of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Triodion "Rejoice, O honored prophets" and the Triadic "It is meet;" then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion "We venerate Your holy icon" and the Exapsalmos. At "God is the Lord": the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and the third Stasis [Stichologia] of the Saint with the Theotokion; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, then the Kathisma of the Triodion, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Triodion and the Minologion of the Saint and the Postscript of the Triodion. The Katavasie "The open expanse of the Red Sea," and the entire order of the Matins Gospel as on a Sunday of the Triodion; then "More honorable." The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, of the Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 2 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Triodion and 3 of the Saint; Glory of the Triodion, Now and ever, "Most blessed are you," Great Doxology, and "Today salvation." 25. In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Sunday (See the Orologion, Sunday of Orthodoxy). Apolytikia after the Entrance: of the Resurrection, of the Triodion, of the Saint, of the Saint of the Church, and Kontakion "To the champion general." Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday and then the Liturgy of Saint Basil. Communion Hymn "Praise [the Lord]," "We have seen the [true] light," and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 26.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Β΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* τὰ Κατανυκτικὰ τοῦ ἤχου οὐ ψάλλονται, ἀλλὰ τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου *Δίδου μοι κατάνυξιν*, καὶ τὰ ἕτερα β΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους *Ὅλος ἐκ νεότητος*, *Δόξα*, *Ἔθυσας τῷ Θεῷ*, *Καὶ νῦν* Προσόμοιον Θεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὸ Μέγα Προκείμενον *Ἔδωκας κληρονομίαν*, μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ ἐκ τρίτου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα ψάλλεται τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Δεῦτε ἐκκαθάρωμεν* ἀργῶς, δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, *Δόξα*, *Τὸν νοερὸν ἀδάμαντα*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ἐκ παντοίων κινδύνων*, *Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 27.    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωΐ, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου ἀπὸ τῆς Λιτῆς μέχρι τῆς Δοξολογίας, ὡς καὶ τῶν Ὡρῶν, ψάλλεται ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Η΄ § 14. Ἐν δὲ τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα* ψάλλομεν τὸ τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἰδιόμελον *Τὴν σωματικὴν νηστείαν* δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, τῆς σειρᾶς Προσόμοια γ΄ *Τίνι ὡμοιώθης ταλαίπωρε*, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄ *Ἔδωκας τὸ σῶμά σου*, *Δόξα*, *Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ*, *Καὶ νῦν* Προσόμοιον Θεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, *Φῶς ἱλαρόν*, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ *Κατευθυνθήτω* καὶ ἡ τῶν ἄρτων εὐλόγησις· μετὰ τὸ *Πλούσιοι ἐπτώχευσαν*, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον*, *Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 26. Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Β΄ ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ Κατανυκτικὰ τοῦ ἤχου οὐ ψάλλονται, ἀλλὰ τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου Δίδου μοι κατάνυξιν, καὶ τὰ ἕτερα β΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους Ὅλος ἐκ νεότητος, Δόξα, Ἔθυσας τῷ Θεῷ, Καὶ νῦν Προσόμοιον Θεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Μέγα Προκείμενον Ἔδωκας κληρονομίαν, μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ ἐκ τρίτου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα ψάλλεται τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Δεῦτε ἐκκαθάρωμεν ἀργῶς, δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, Δόξα, Τὸν νοερὸν ἀδάμαντα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἐκ παντοίων κινδύνων, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Τὸ Θεοτόκε Παρθένε οὐ ψάλλεται, διὰ τὸ τελεῖσθαι αὔριον Λειτουργίαν Προηγιασμένην. 27. Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωΐ, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου ἀπὸ τῆς Λιτῆς μέχρι τῆς Δοξολογίας, ὡς καὶ τῶν Ὡρῶν, ψάλλεται ὡς διετάχθη ἐν περιπτώσει Η΄ § 14. Ἐν δὲ τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὸ τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἰδιόμελον Τὴν σωματικὴν νηστείαν δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, τῆς σειρᾶς Προσόμοια γ΄ Τίνι ὡμοιώθης ταλαίπωρε, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄ Ἔδωκας τὸ σῶμά σου, Δόξα, Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ, Καὶ νῦν Προσόμοιον Θεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω καὶ ἡ τῶν ἄρτων εὐλόγησις· μετὰ τὸ Πλούσιοι ἐπτώχευσαν, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τῶν Προηγιασμένων, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 28. Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος, ἅπασαν τὴν τῆς Ἀκολουθίας διάταξιν ὅρα ἐν περιπτώσει Η΄ §13, 14, 15. Ἐννοεῖται ὅμως ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Τριῳδίου λέγονται τὰ τῆς ἡμέρας. units.english_text: 26.    If the commemoration occurs on Monday of the Second Week of the Great Fast: on Sunday evening at Vespers, at "Lord, I have cried", the penitential Katanyktika hymns of the Tone are not chanted; instead we chant the 3 cycle Prosomia of the Triodion: **"Grant me compunction"** (*Δίδου μοι κατάνυξιν*) and the other two, and 3 Prosomia of St. Charalampos: **"Wholly from thy youth"** (*Ὅλος ἐκ νεότητος*); "Glory...": **"Thou didst sacrifice unto God a sacrifice of praise"** (*Ἔθυσας τῷ Θεῷ*); "Both now and ever...": Prosomion Theotokion; Little Entrance, "O Gladsome Light", and the Great Prokeimenon: **"Thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear Thy name"** (*Ἔδωκας κληρονομίαν*, Ps. 60:6 LXX) chanted thrice with its verses. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon: **"Come, let us cleanse ourselves"** (*Δεῦτε ἐκκαθάρωμεν*) is chanted slowly twice, with the Martyrikon; "Glory...": **"The noetic adamant"** (*Τὸν νοερὸν ἀδάμαντα*); "Both now and ever...": **"From perils of every kind"** (*Ἐκ παντοίων κινδύνων*); then "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart" [Luke 2:29], the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 27.    On Monday morning: the Office of Matins of the Saint from the Litiya until the Great Doxology, as well as the Hours, are chanted as prescribed in Situation Eight, Paragraph 14. At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant the Idiomelon of the Aposticha: **"Keeping bodily fasting"** (*Τὴν σωματικὴν νηστείαν*, twice), and the Martyrikon; 3 cycle Prosomia: **"Unto what hast thou become likened, wretched soul"** (*Τίνι ὡμοιώθης ταλαίπωρε*), and 4 of the Saint: **"Thou didst surrender thy body"** (*Ἔδωκας τὸ σῶμά σου*); "Glory...": **"O God-crowned phalanx"** (*Φάλαγγα θεοστεφῆ*); "Both now and ever...": Prosomion Theotokion; Little Entrance with the Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", the Old Testament Readings of the Triodion; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX] and the Blessing of the Loaves [Artoklasia] with **"The rich have become poor"** [Ps. 33:11 LXX]; the Epistle and the Gospel of the Saint, and then the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts; Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX), **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 26. If the Feast occurs on Monday of the Second Week, Sunday at Vespers, at "Lord, I have cried," the Penitential {Kataniktika} Hymns of the Mode are not sung, but we sing the 3 Prosomia of Triodion "Grant me contrition," and the two others and 3 Prosomia of Saint Charalampos "Entirely from my youth," Glory, "You sacrificed to God," Now and ever Prosomion Theotokion. Entrance, "O Gladsome Light," the Great Prokimenon "You gave inheritance," 3 times with its verses. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon "Come let us cleanse ourselves" is sung twice slowly, and the Martyrikon. Glory, "Let us praise in spirit that living steel of endurance," Now and ever, "From all dangers"; then "Now let me depart" and the Trisagion. The Apolytikion of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal. The "O Theotokos Virgin" is not sung, since the Presanctified Liturgy will be celebrated tomorrow. 27. On Monday morning, the Service of Matins of the Saint from the Liti until the Doxology, as well as the Hours, are sung as prescribed in Situation 8, Paragraph 14. In the Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the Idiomelon of the Aposticha "Let us keep a spiritual fast" twice, and the Martyrikon, the three Prosomia of the order "To what shall you be likened," and 4 of the Saint "You gave your body," Glory, "God-crowned phalanx" Now and ever Prosomion Theotokion. Entrance with the Gospel, "O Gladsome light," the Readings of the Triodion. Then "Let my prayer arise" and the Blessing of the Bread with "The rich were made poor." The Apostolos and the Gospel of the Saint and then the Liturgy of the Presanctified. Communion Hymn "In eternal memorial," "I will bless the Lord," and Dismissal. 28. If the Feast occurs on Tuesday of this week, for the entire order of the Service see Situation 8, Paragraphs 13, 14, 15. It is understood, however, that the hymns from the Triodion are those of the day. Note that the Commemoration of Saint Charalampos may occur within the Triodion period from the Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee to the Tuesday of the Second Week of Lent, as can be seen in the Festal Chart.
units.english_text: 28.    If the commemoration occurs on Tuesday of this same week: for the entire order of the Office see Situation Eight, Paragraphs 13, 14, and 15. It is understood, however, that the hymns appointed from the Triodion are those of the day.

provenance.verbatim_source: 28.    If the commemoration occurs on Tuesday of this same week: for the entire order of the Office see Situation Eight, Paragraphs 13, 14, and 15. It is understood, however, that the hymns appointed from the Triodion are those of the day.

units.slavonic_text: ΠΕΡΙΠΤΩΣΕΙΣ Α΄. 1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ αὕτη ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἀπὸ τῆς Πέμπτης τῆς ἑβδομάδος τοῦ Ἀσώτου μέχρι τῆς Παρασκευῆς τῆς Τυρινῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐστι διατεταγμένη ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ.

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: February 24: Finding of the Head of the Forerunner; Situation VI (§§ 6–8) (p. 408)]
units.english_text: 6.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς Α΄ ἑβδομάδος τῶν Νηστειῶν, τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωῒ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ψάλλομεν γ΄ Προσόμοια τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου *Χαίροις ἡ ἱερὰ κεφαλή*, *Δόξα*, *Καὶ νῦν* Προσόμοιον Θεοτοκίον, τὸ *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου Ἰδιόμελον δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, *Δόξα*, *Καὶ νῦν* Θεοτοκίον, *Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

provenance.verbatim_source: 6.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς Α΄ ἑβδομάδος τῶν Νηστειῶν, τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωῒ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ *Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, ψάλλομεν γ΄ Προσόμοια τῆς σειρᾶς τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου *Χαίροις ἡ ἱερὰ κεφαλή*, *Δόξα*, *Καὶ νῦν* Προσόμοιον Θεοτοκίον, τὸ *Φῶς ἱλαρὸν* καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Τριῳδίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου Ἰδιόμελον δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, *Δόξα*, *Καὶ νῦν* Θεοτοκίον, *Νῦν ἀπολύεις*, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ *Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 7.    Τῇ Τρίτῃ πρωῒ μετὰ τὸν Ἑξάψαλμον, εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἐκ γῆς ἀνατείλασα* δίς, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ Α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ* κτλ. τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα, *Δόξα*, *Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν*, ὁ Κανὼν *Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας* καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου κτλ. αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*, καὶ μετὰ *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια *Ἤνοιξε Προπύλαια* εἰς δ΄, *Δόξα*, *Τὴν πανσεβάσμιον κάραν*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*, Δοξολογία Μ. τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον, καὶ ἀναγινώσκονται αἱ Ὧραι, ἐν αἷς λέγεται Ἀπολυτίκιον *Ἐκ γῆς ἀνατείλασα*, καὶ Κοντάκιον *Προφῆτα Θεοῦ καὶ Πρόδρομε*. Εἰς τὴν Θ΄ Ὥραν ψάλλονται οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ ὡς εἴθισται, καθὼς διετάχθησαν ἐν τῇ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους ἑορτῇ ἐν περιπτώσει Η΄ § 14.

provenance.verbatim_source: 7. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ τοῦ Τριῳδίου Ἰδιόμελον δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικὸν ἅπαξ, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν Θεοτοκίον, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Θεοτόκε Παρθένε, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 7. Εἰς τὴν Θ΄ Ὥραν ψάλλονται οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ ὡς εἴθισται, καθὼς διετάχθησαν ἐν τῇ τοῦ ἁγίου Χαραλάμπους ἑορτῇ ἐν περιπτώσει Η΄ § 14. 8.    Εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὰ Πρὸς Κύριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὸ τῶν Ἀποστίχων Ἰδιόμελον τῆς ἡμέρας δίς, καὶ τὸ Μαρτυρικόν, εἶτα τὰ γ΄ τοῦ Τριῳδίου Προσόμοια καὶ δ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου Δεῦτε τὴν τιμίαν κεφαλήν, Δόξα, Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν, Καὶ νῦν Σταυροθεοτοκίον, Εἴσοδος μετὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα (τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκ τοῦ Τριῳδίου), τὸ Κατευθυνθήτω, ὁ Ἀπόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ Νῦν αἱ δυνάμεις, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς Μνημόσυνον, Εὐλογήσω τὸν Κύριον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 6.    If the Feast occurs on Tuesday of the First Week of the Great Fast: on Monday morning, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant 3 Prosomia of the cycle of the Triodion and 3 Prosomia of the Forerunner: **"Rejoice, O sacred head"** (*Χαίροις ἡ ἱερὰ κεφαλή*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": Prosomion Theotokion; "O Gladsome Light" and the Old Testament Readings of the Triodion. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon of the Triodion twice, and the Martyrikon once; "Glory... Both now and ever...": Theotokion; then "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart" [Luke 2:29] and the Trisagion Prayers; then **"O Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 7.    On Tuesday morning, after the Hexapsalmos, at "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion: **"Having arisen from the earth"** (*Ἐκ γῆς ἀνατείλασα*, twice), and the Theotokion; then the Psalter; the Kathismata in order; the Anavathmoi: the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"There will I make the horn of David bud forth"** (*Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαβίδ*, Ps. 131:17 LXX); "Let every breath praise the Lord" and the Morning Gospel [Luke 7:17–30]; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of Thy Forerunner"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: "Have mercy on me, O God" [Ps. 50:3 LXX] and the Idiomelon: **"The divine treasure"** (*Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν*); the Canon: **"Having traversed the water"** (*Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*) and that of the Forerunner, etc.; the Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); and after "More honorable than the Cherubim", the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomia **"He opened the fore-doors"** (*Ἤνοιξε Προπύλαια*) in 4; "Glory...": **"The all-venerable head"** (*Τὴν πανσεβάσμιον κάραν*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, thou art the true vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); Great Doxology, the Dismissal Troparion; and the Hours are read, in which are recited the Dismissal Troparion **"Having arisen from the earth"** and the Kontakion: **"O Prophet of God and Forerunner"** (*Προφῆτα Θεοῦ καὶ Πρόδρομε*). At the Ninth Hour, the Beatitudes are chanted as customary, as prescribed for the Feast of St. Charalampos in Situation Eight, Paragraph 14.

units.slavonic_text: SITUATION SIX 6.    If the Feast occurs on Tuesday of the First Week of Lent, on Monday morning after the Introductory Psalm, at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the Prosomia of the order of the Triodion and the 3 Prosomia of the Forerunner "Hail, O sacred head," Glory, Now and ever Prosomion Theotokion. "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings of the Triodion. At the Aposticha: the Idiomelon of the Triodion twice, and the Martyrikon once. Glory, Now and ever, Theotokion. Then "Now let your servant" and the Trisagion. Then "Theotokos Virgin" and Dismissal. 7.    On Tuesday morning after the Exapsalmos, at "God is the Lord": the Apolytikion "The head of the Forerunner arose from the earth" twice, and the Theotokion, then the Psalter. The Kathismata in order, the Anavathmi of the First Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon "There I will make the horns of David bud forth" [Psalm 132: 17, 1]. Then "Let everything that breathes" and the Gospel [Luke 7:17-30], Psalm 50 read, Glory, "Through the intercessions of your Forerunner," Now and ever, "Through the intercessions of the Theotokos," the Verse: "Have mercy on me, O God" and the Idiomelon "The all-holy sheath of the divine." The Canon "Having crossed the water" and the one of the Forerunner, etc. The Katavasie "I will open my mouth," with "More honorable." The Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the Prosomia "He opened the fore-doors" in four, Glory, "The all-venerable head," Now and ever, "Theotokos, you are the true vine," Great Doxology, the Apolytikion; and the Hours are read, in which is said the Apolytikion "The head of the forerunner arose from the earth," and the Kontakion "O Prophet of God and Forerunner." At the Ninth Hour, the Beatitudes are sung as is the custom, as was prescribed in the Feast of Saint Charalampos, in Situation 8, Paragraph 14. 8.    In Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm and the "To the Lord," at "Lord, I have cried," we sing the Idiomelon of the day twice and the Martyrikon from the Aposticha, then the 3 Prosomia of the Triodion and the 4 of the Forerunner "Behold, the divine head," Glory, "The all-holy sheath of the divine," Now and ever the Stavrotheotokion. Entrance with the Gospel, "O Gladsome Light" and the Readings {of the day from the Triodion}. Then "Let my prayer arise," the Apostolos [2nd Corinthians 4:6-15] and Gospel of the Forerunner [Matthew 11:2-15]. Then "Now the powers," Communion Hymn "In eternal memorial," "I will bless the Lord," and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 8.    At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant the Idiomelon of the day from the Aposticha twice, and the Martyrikon; then 3 Prosomia of the Triodion and 4 of the Forerunner: **"Come, let us honor the precious head"** (*Δεῦτε τὴν τιμίαν κεφαλήν*); "Glory...": **"The divine treasure"** (*Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν*); "Both now and ever...": Stavrotheotokion; Little Entrance with the Gospel Book, "O Gladsome Light", and the Readings of the day from the Triodion; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX]; the Epistle [2 Cor. 4:6–15] and Gospel of the Forerunner [Matt. 11:2–15]; **"Now the powers of heaven"** (*Νῦν αἱ δυνάμεις*); Communion Verse: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.[^271]

units.english_text: 11.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικὸν καὶ τὸν Ἑξάψαλμον, εἰς τὸ *Θεὸς Κύριος* τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Προδρόμου, τοῦ ἁγίου Θεοδώρου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Καθίσματα ἀμφοτέρων τῶν Ἁγίων μετὰ τῶν Θεοτοκίων αὐτῶν, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τῶν Ἀναβαθμῶν τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον *Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαβίδ*, τὸ *Πᾶσα πνοὴ* καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, *Δόξα*, *Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου*, *Καὶ νῦν*, *Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*, ὁ Στίχος *Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς* καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον *Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν*, Κανόνες ὁ α΄ τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου, ἀπὸ γ΄ ᾨδῆς μετὰ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ τὸν Οἶκον τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὰ τοῦ Μηναίου καὶ τοῦ Τριῳδίου Καθίσματα μετὰ τῶν Θεοτοκίων, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Τριῳδίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Τριῳδίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι *Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*, καὶ μετὰ *Τὴν τιμιωτέραν* Ἐξαποστειλάρια τοῦ Προδρόμου, τοῦ ἁγίου Θεοδώρου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τοῦ Προδρόμου Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ ἁγίου Θεοδώρου, *Δόξα* τοῦ Προδρόμου, *Καὶ νῦν* Θεοτοκίον, Δοξολογία Μ. τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου, Κοντάκιον *Προστασία τῶν χριστιανῶν*, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Τριῳδίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου, Κοινωνικὸν *Εἰς μνημόσυνον* καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 10.    If the Feast occurs on Saturday of this same [First] week [Miracle of the Kolyva of St. Theodore the Recruit]: on Friday morning, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and "Unto the Lord" [Kathisma 18, Pss. 119–133 LXX], at "Lord, I have cried", we chant the Idiomelon of the day: **"Come, ye faithful, let us work"** (*Δεῦτε πιστοὶ ἐπεργασώμεθα*, twice), 4 Prosomia of the Forerunner, and 4 of St. Theodore; "Glory...": **"Using the apostate emperor as his tool"** (*Ὀργάνῳ χρησάμενος*); "Both now and ever...": the first Dogmatic Theotokion of the Tone occurring; Little Entrance with the censer, "O Gladsome Light", and the Old Testament Readings of the Triodion; **"Let my prayer arise"** [Ps. 140:2 LXX]; **"Now the powers of heaven"** (*Νῦν αἱ δυνάμεις*); Communion Verse: **"O taste and see that the Lord is good"** (*Γεύσασθε καὶ ἴδετε*, Ps. 33:9 LXX); **"I will bless the Lord at all times"** (Ps. 33:2 LXX), and Dismissal.
