units.slavonic_incipit: μετὰ τὴν Συναπτὴν οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ
units.slavonic_text: μετὰ τὴν Συναπτὴν οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Δικαίως ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ ἅπαξ, καὶ εὐθὺς Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀθλοφόρου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τοῦ μεγάλου Βασιλέως (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν)· [Εἰς τὴν Περίπτωσιν Δ΄ § 11, εἰς τὸ ἴδιον μέρος τῆς ἀκολουθίας, ὁ Βιολάκης ἔχει ὡς Ἰδιόμελον Σήμερον ἡ οἰκουμένη πᾶσα.] Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου, Κύριε ἐλέησον ιβ΄, Ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς, καὶ ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου ἀνὰ δ΄ μετὰ Στίχου εἰς μὲν τὸν Ἀναστάσιμον Δόξα τῇ ἁγίᾳ Ἀναστάσει σου Κύριε, εἰς δὲ τὸν τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν· ἐν τῷ τέλει ἑκάστης Ὠδῆς ἡ Καταβασία, τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη τρίς, Ἀναστὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἅπαξ, καὶ ἡ Αἴτησις· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον {τοῦ Πάσχα}· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ γ΄, καὶ τὸ Ἀναστὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· εἶτα μετὰ τὴν ζ΄ καὶ η΄ Ὠδὴν ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Πάσχα, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἔαρ ἡμῖν ἐξέλαμψεν, αὖθις τὸ πρῶτον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄ καὶ τὰ Στιχηρὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα, Ἀνέτειλε τὸ ἔαρ, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα, τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη τρίς, καὶ ἄρχεται ἡ Λειτουργία.
units.english_text: Κατ᾿ αὐτὸν τὸν τύπον ψάλλεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου, ὅταν συμπέσῃ ἡ μνήμη αὐτοῦ τῇ Τρίτῃ, Τετάρτῃ, Πέμπτῃ καὶ τῷ Σαββάτῳ τῆς Διακαινησίμου· ἐξαιρεῖται δὲ μόνον τὸ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Πάσχα ἀναγινωσκόμενον Εὐαγγέλιον, ἀλλ᾿ ἀναγινώσκονται ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου.

units.slavonic_text: [English Facing Translation: Month of April: St. George the Trophy-Bearer (April 23); Situation One Concl. (§§ 2–3) and General Rubric (p. 507)]
units.english_text: we chant the Anavathmoi: the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4, the Prokeimenon: **"The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree"** (*Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει*, Ps. 91:13 LXX). Then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*) and the Matins Gospel: **"Beware of men"** (*Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων*, Luke 21:12–19). Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*) once, and immediately "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Trophy-Bearer"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀθλοφόρου πρεσβείαις*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50 LXX) and the Idiomelon: **"Of the great King"** (*Τοῦ μεγάλου Βασιλέως*, look in the Litiya). [In Situation IV, Paragraph 11, at the same place in the service, Violakis has as the Idiomelon: **"Today the whole world"** (*Σήμερον ἡ οἰκουμένη πᾶσα*)]. Then **"O God, save Thy people"**, **"Lord, have mercy"** (12 times), **"Through the mercy and compassion"**, and the Canon of Pascha and that of the Saint to 4 each, with the Verse for the Resurrection Canon: **"Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord"**, and for the Canon of the Saint, the Verse: **"Holy one of God, intercede for us"**; at the end of each Ode the Katavasia: **"Christ is risen"** (thrice), **"Jesus having risen from the tomb"** (once), and the Little Litany. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe of Pascha and the Paschal Kontakion. After Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint and the Menologion. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (thrice), and **"Jesus having risen from the tomb"**. After Odes 7 and 8, Ode 9 of Pascha is sung with the Megalynaria and that of the Saint. The Exapostilarion of Pascha, that of the Saint: **"Springtime has shone forth upon us"** (*Ἔαρ ἡμῖν ἐξέλαμψεν*), and again the Exapostilarion of Pascha. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira, 4 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": **"Spring has dawned"** (*Ἀνέτειλε τὸ ἔαρ*); "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); **"Christ is risen"** (thrice), and the Divine Liturgy begins.

units.english_text: 3.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons of Pascha, and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon]: **"In the congregations bless God"** (*Ἐν Ἐκκλησίαις εὐλογεῖτε τὸν Θεόν*, Ps. 67:27 LXX). **"Christ is risen"**, the Hypakoe: **"They who were with Mary"** (*Προλαβοῦσαι τὸν ὄρθρον*), the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint: **"Liberator of captives"** (*Ὡς τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐλευθερωτής*), and the Kontakion of Pascha: **"Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"** (*Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ*). Instead of the Trisagion, **"As many of you as have been baptized into Christ"** (Galatians 3:27), the Epistle of the Saint: Acts 12:1–11, and the Gospel of the day: **"No man hath seen God at any time"** (*Θεὸν οὐδεὶς ἑώρακε πώποτε*, John 1:18–28). At "Especially": **"The Angel cried out to her that is full of grace... Shine, shine"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*); Communion Hymn: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX)¹; **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: we chant the Anavathmi, the First
units.slavonic_text: we chant the Anavathmi, the First Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “The righteous shall flourish.” Then “Let everything that breathes” and the Gospel “Be careful of men” [Luke 21:12-19]. Then “Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ” once, and immediately Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Champion,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God have mercy on me” and the Idiomelon “The Great King” (look in the Liti). {In Situation 4, Paragraph 11, at the same place in the service, Violakis has as the Idiomelon “Today, the whole world.”} Then “O God, save Your people,” “Lord, have mercy” (12 times), “Through the mercy and compassion,” and the Canon of Pascha and that of the Saint with four hymns, with the Verse for the Resurrection Canon “Glory to Your Resurrection, O Lord,” and for the Canon of the Saint, the Verse “Holy One of God, intercede for us”; at the end of each Ode the Katavasia “Christ is risen” (3 times), “Having arisen from the grave” (once) and the Petition. After the 3rd Ode, the Ypakoi of Pascha and the Kontakion {of Pascha}. After the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint and the Minologion. Then “Having beheld the Resurrection” 3 times, and “Having risen from the grave.” After the 7th and 8th Odes, the 9th Ode of Pascha with the Megalynaria and those of the Saint. The Exapostilarion of Easter, that of the Saint “Springtime has shone forth” and again the Exapostilarion of Easter. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira, and 4 of the Saint and the Stichira “A sacred Pascha,” Glory, “Spring has dawned,” Now and ever, “It is the day of Resurrection,” “Christ is risen” 3 times; and the Liturgy begins.
units.english_text: The service of the Saint is celebrated in this manner when his commemoration falls on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Saturday of Bright Week; however, instead of the Gospel read at the Vespers of Easter Sunday, the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint are read at Vespers.

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: Month of April: St. George the Trophy-Bearer (April 23); Situation II (§§ 4–6) Bright Friday (Life-Giving Spring) (p. 508)]
units.english_text: 4.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς Διακαινησίμου, τῇ Πέμπτῃ ἑσπέρας, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ γ΄, τῆς Θεοτόκου γ΄, καὶ δ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Τίς λαλήσει τὰς δυναστείας σου Πηγή, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον Ἀγαπήσω σε Κύριε ἡ ἰσχύς μου μετὰ τῶν Στίχων, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Στιχηρὸν Τὴν Ἀνάστασίν σου Χριστὲ Σωτήρ, καὶ τὰ γ΄ ἀπόστιχα Στιχηρὰ τῆς Θεοτόκου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα, τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 5.    Τῇ Παρασκευῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, ἡ Ἀκολουθία μέχρι τῶν Κανόνων ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν § 2 διάταξιν, οἱ Κανόνες τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ οἱ τῆς Θεοτόκου μετὰ Στίχων, εἰς μὲν τὸν Ἀναστάσιμον Δόξα τῇ Ἁγίᾳ Ἀναστάσει σου, εἰς τὸν τοῦ Ἁγίου, Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, καί εἰς τὸν τῆς Θεοτόκου Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ Προλαβοῦσαι τὸν Ὄρθρον, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς Θεοτόκου· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Θεοτόκου· μετὰ τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ γ΄, μετὰ καὶ τὴν ζ΄ καὶ η΄ Ὠδὴν ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Πάσχα μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ ἡ τῆς Θεοτόκου μετὰ Στίχου Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε, τὰ Ἐξαποστειλάρια τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς Θεοτόκου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, τῆς Θεοτόκου γ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄ καὶ τὸ Πάσχα ἱερόν. Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα, καὶ τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη γ΄.

Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, Ἀντίφωνα καὶ Εἰσοδικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, ἡ Ὑπακοή, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ἐξ ἀκενώτου σου πηγῆς καὶ τὸ Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἡμέρας. units.slavonic_text: [English Facing Translation: Month of April: St. George the Trophy-Bearer (April 23); Situation Two (§§ 4–6) Bright Friday (Life-Giving Spring) (p. 509)]
units.english_text: 4.    If the commemoration [of the Saint] falls on Friday of Bright Week, on Thursday evening, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Theotokos, and 4 of the Saint. "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"Who can tell of thy mighty deeds, O Pure Spring?"** (*Τίς λαλήσει τὰς δυναστείας σου Πηγή*). Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Prokeimenon: **"I will love Thee, O Lord, my strength"** (*Ἀγαπήσω σε Κύριε ἡ ἰσχύς μου*, Ps. 17:2 LXX) with its verses, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron: **"Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior"** (*Τὴν Ἀνάστασίν σου Χριστὲ Σωτήρ*) and the 3 Aposticha Stichira of the Theotokos; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); **"Christ is risen"** (once), the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, again **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 5.    On Bright Friday at Matins, the service up to the Canons is sung according to the order in Paragraph 2; then the Canons of Pascha, of the Saint, and of the Theotokos, with the verses: for the Resurrection Canon, **"Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord"**; for the Canon of the Saint, **"Holy one of God, intercede for us"**; and for the Theotokos, **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"**. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe: **"They who were with Mary"** (*Προλαβοῦσαι τὸν ὄρθρον*), then the Sessional Hymn of the Saint and that of the Theotokos; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, the Menologion, and the Synaxarion commentary of the Theotokos [the Life-Giving Spring]. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (thrice). After Odes 7 and 8, we chant Ode 9 of Pascha with the Megalynaria, that of the Saint, and that of the Theotokos with the verse: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"**. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saint, and of the Theotokos. At the Praises: 2 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Theotokos, 3 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); and **"Christ is risen"** (thrice).

units.slavonic_text: SITUATION TWO
units.english_text: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha; after the Entrance, **"Christ is risen"**, the Hypakoe, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, the Kontakion of the Spring: **"From thy unfailing fount"** (*Ἐξ ἀκενώτου σου πηγῆς*) and that of Pascha: **"Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"** (*Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ*), the Epistle of the Saint [Acts 12:1–11], and the Gospel of the day [John 2:12–22]. At "Especially": **"The Angel cried out to her that is full of grace... Shine, shine"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*); Communion Hymn: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX)*; **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 4.    If the Feast [of the Saint] falls on Friday of Bright Week, on Thursday evening, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing the three Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Theotokos, and 4 of the Saint. Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, “Who can tell of your mighty deeds, O Life-giving Spring.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon “I will love You, O Lord” with its verses, and the Readings of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron “Your Resurrection, Christ Savior” and the three Aposticha Stichira of the Theotokos, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, “It is the day of Resurrection,” “Christ is risen” once, the Apolytikion of the Saint, and again “Christ is risen,” and the Dismissal.
units.english_text: * {It is possible that the same rules that apply to the rest of the week apply here as well: that is, if the church in which the Liturgy is celebrated is dedicated to Saint George, then we sing: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"**, and if not, then we sing the Communion Hymn of Pascha: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*).}[^321]

units.english_text: 7.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τοῦ Θωμᾶ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη τρίς, ὁ Προοιμιακὸς καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου· τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 8.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ἐπαίνει Ἱερουσαλὴμ τὸν Κύριον, καὶ εὐθὺς ὁ Κανὼν τῆς ἑορτῆς ἄνευ Στίχου, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ Στίχου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ Ὡς ἐν μέσῳ τῶν μαθητῶν σου, τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου χῦμα· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ὡς καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου ἀνὰ δ΄, τὸ Ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν δίς, Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν κτλ. καὶ τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον Ἐμῶν μελῶν χειρί σου, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα, Ἀνέτειλε τὸ ἔαρ, Καὶ νῦν, Μεθ᾿ ἡμέρας ὀκτώ, Δοξολογία Μ. καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.english_text: 7.    If the commemoration of the Saint occurs on the Sunday of Saint Thomas, on Saturday evening, after **"Christ is risen"** (thrice), the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], and the Psalter reading [1st Kathisma, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 6 Idiomela of the Feast and 4 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Prokeimenon: **"The Lord is King"** (*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν*, Ps. 92:1 LXX), and the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Stichira of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. The Dismissal Troparion of the Feast: **"While the tomb was sealed"** (*Ἐσφραγισμένου τοῦ μνήματος*), that of the Saint: **"Liberator of captives"** (*Ὡς τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐλευθερωτής*), again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 8.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Triadic Canon, the Litiya of the Feast and that of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast, and the Triadika: **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter readings, and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns of the Saint, and one Sessional Hymn of the Feast instead of a Theotokion; the Anavathmoi: the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4, the Prokeimenon: **"Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem"** (*Ἐπαίνει Ἱερουσαλὴμ τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 147:1 LXX), and immediately the Canon of the Feast without verses, and that of the Saint with the Verse: **"Holy one of God, intercede for us"**. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe: **"Even as Thou didst come into the midst of Thy disciples, O Savior"** (*Ὡς ἐν μέσῳ τῶν μαθητῶν σου παρεγένου Σωτήρ*), the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint (read plainly); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion, and the Synaxarion commentary of the Feast. The Katavasiai of Pascha and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then Ode 9 of the Feast and that of the Saint with four troparia each. **"Holy is the Lord our God"** (*Ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν*, Ps. 98:9 LXX) twice, then **"Exalt ye the Lord our God"** (*Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν*, Ps. 98:5 LXX), etc. The Exapostilarion: **"With thy hand thou hast searched out My wounds, O Thomas"** (*Ἐμῶν μελῶν χειρί σου*), that of the Saint, and the other of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint; "Glory...": **"Spring has dawned"** (*Ἀνέτειλε τὸ ἔαρ*); "Both now and ever...": **"Eight days after Thy Resurrection, O Savior"** (*Μεθ᾿ ἡμέρας ὀκτώ*); Great Doxology and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

units.english_text: ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Προσόμοια τῆς σειρᾶς β΄ (δηλ. ἐκ τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου) καὶ ς΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ τοῦ Ἁγίου Προσόμοια, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῆς ἑορτῆς), τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 11.    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου δὶς καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Δικαίως ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι, καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀθλοφόρου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Σήμερον ἡ οἰκουμένη πᾶσα, ὁ Κανὼν τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα· εἶτα Στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, ἡ Καταβασία Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα, Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ δ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου Προσόμοια, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου.

units.english_text: Sunday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 2 Prosomia of the sequence {i.e. from the Pentecostarion} and 6 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"The doors being closed"** (*Τῶν θυρῶν κεκλεισμένων*). Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Great Prokeimenon: **"Our God is in heaven and on earth; He hath done whatsoever He pleased"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ*, Ps. 113:11 LXX) with its verses, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"O, of the strange wonder!"** (*Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος*, look in the Aposticha of the Feast). The Dismissal Troparion of the Saint: **"Liberator of captives"** (*Ὡς τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐλευθερωτής*), that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 11.    On Monday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Saint; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast; the Triadika: **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint twice, and that of the Feast once; the Psalter reading of the day, and the Polyeleos of the Saint. Sessional Hymns of the Saint, and one Sessional Hymn of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Anavathmoi: the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4, the Prokeimenon: **"The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree"** (*Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει*, Ps. 91:13 LXX). Then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*) and the Matins Gospel of the Saint. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), and Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly. "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Trophy-Bearer"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀθλοφόρου πρεσβείαις*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Today the whole world"** (*Σήμερον ἡ οἰκουμένη πᾶσα*), with the Canon of the Feast and that of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn of the Saint and that of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint and the Menologion. The Katavasiai of Pascha; then we chant the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), followed by the Katavasia of Ode 9: **"The Angel cried out to her that is full of grace... Shine, shine"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*). The Exapostilarion of the Saint and that of the Feast. At the Praises: 4 Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology and the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint.

units.slavonic_text: Sunday evening, after the Introductory Psalm, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing two Stichira of the sequence {i.e. from the Pentikostarion} and 6 of the Saint. Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, “The doors being closed.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon “Our God in heaven and on the earth” with its verses and the Readings of the Saint. units.english_text: 12.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha; after the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"With his searching right hand"** (*Τῇ φιλοπράγμονι δεξιᾷ*). The Epistle and Gospel of the Saint. At "Especially": **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal².

Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Προσόμοια τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄, καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου. Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Μεθ᾿ ἡμέρας ὀκτώ, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_incipit: Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα,
units.slavonic_text: Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα, τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, {Σημ. ὅτι τὸ Πεντηκοστάριον ἔχει μόνον 3 Στιχηρὰ διὰ τὸν ἑσπερινὸν τῆς Παρασκευῆς} Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_text: 15.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικόν, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον Τῇ φιλοπράγμονι δεξιᾷ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Σὲ τὴν φαεινὴν λαμπάδα, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς Χριστὸς Ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, Ἀπόλυσις καὶ Ἀπόδοσις τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_text: 14.    Τῇ Σαββάτῳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν ἐκ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τοῦ Ἁγίου κτλ. ὡς ἐν περιπτώσει Δ΄ § 11, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα, καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου, ἡ Καταβασία Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ α΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Προσόμοια τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄, καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου. Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Μεθ᾿ ἡμέρας ὀκτώ, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.
units.english_text: 16.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Μυροφόρων, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τῶν Μυροφόρων β΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Μυροφόρων, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Στιχηρόν, καὶ τὸ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Σὲ τὸν ἀναβαλλόμενον τὸ φῶς, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον, Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς Μυροφόροις γυναιξί καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

The Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Saint, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 14.    On Saturday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast, and the Triadika: **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter reading of the day, and the Polyeleos of the Saint etc., as in Situation Four, Paragraph 11. The Katavasiai of Pascha; Ode 9 of the Feast as well as that of the Saint is sung, and the Katavasia of Ode 9: **"The Angel cried out to her that is full of grace... Shine, shine"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*). The first Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Saint, and the other of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"Eight days after Thy Resurrection, O Savior"** (*Μεθ᾿ ἡμέρας ὀκτώ*); Great Doxology and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

units.slavonic_text: the Feast, on Friday evening, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing the four Idiomela of the Feast and four of the Saint. {Note: the Pentikostarion only has 3 Stichira for Friday Vespers.} Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast. “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Saint. units.english_text: 15.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha; after the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia of the Feast, of the Saint, and of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"With his searching right hand"** (*Τῇ φιλοπράγμονι δεξιᾷ*). The Epistle and Gospel of the Saint. At "Especially": **"Thee, the radiant lamp"** (*Σὲ τὴν φαεινὴν λαμπάδα*); Communion Hymn of the Feast: **"Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem"** (*Ἐπαίνει Ἱερουσαλήμ*, Ps. 147:1 LXX); **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), Dismissal, and the Apodosis of the Feast.

units.slavonic_text: 14.    On Saturday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast, and the Triadic “It is meet”; the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter of the day, and the Polyeleos of the Saint etc., as in Situation Four, Paragraph 11. The Katavasie of Pascha; the 9th Ode of the Feast as well as that of the Saint, the Katavasia “The Angel cried.” The first Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Saint, and the other of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, “Eight days after Your arising,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast.
units.english_text: 16.    If the commemoration of the Saint occurs on the Sunday of the Myrrhbearers, on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Myrrhbearers, and 4 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Myrrhbearers. Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Apostichon, then the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment"** (*Σὲ τὸν ἀναβαλλόμενον τὸ φῶς ὥσπερ ἱμάτιον*, Ps. 103:2 LXX). The Dismissal Troparia: **"When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal"** (*Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον*), **"The noble Joseph"** (*Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"Unto the myrrhbearing women"** (*Ταῖς Μυροφόροις γυναιξί*), and Dismissal.

In the Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of Pascha; after the Entrance, the Apolytikia of the Feast, of the Saint, of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “With his searching right hand.” The Apostolos and Gospel of the Saint. At “Especially,” “You, the shining lamp,” Communion Hymn of the Feast, “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name,” and Dismissal and the Leave-taking of the Feast.

units.english_text: ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ὅτε κατῆλθες, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν τῶν Μυροφόρων Τὸν λίθον τοῦ μνήματος, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού, Καὶ νῦν, Πάντα ὑπὲρ ἔννοιαν· εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν Αἱ Μυροφόροι ὄρθριαι, Δόξα, Πόθῳ ζέοντι, Καὶ νῦν, Τὰ μύρα τῆς ταφῆς· εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς, {Δόξα,} Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερδεδοξασμένη, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ τοῦ Πάσχα, ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὰ δύο Θεοτοκία· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῶν Μυροφόρων· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Μυροφόρων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα ἡ θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα ὡς καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὰ β΄ Θεοτοκία ὡς σύνηθες, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῶν Μυροφόρων. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄, καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα, Ἀνέτειλε τὸ ἔαρ, Καὶ νῦν Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: the Dismissal Troparion: **"When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal"** (*Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον*), and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, the Psalter reading of the day, and the Polyeleos of the Saint. Sessional Hymns: after the 1st Psalter reading [Stichologia], of the Myrrhbearers: **"The stone of the grave"** (*Τὸν λίθον τοῦ μνήματος*); "Glory...": of the Saint: **"Behold, the springtime of grace has dawned"** (*Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού*); "Both now and ever...": **"Beyond comprehension"** (*Πάντα ὑπὲρ ἔννοιαν*). After the 2nd Psalter reading: **"The Myrrhbearing women, having risen early"** (*Αἱ Μυροφόροι ὄρθριαι*); "Glory...": **"Ablaze with desire"** (*Πόθῳ ζέοντι*); "Both now and ever...": **"Bringing myrrh for Thy burial"** (*Τὰ μύρα τῆς ταφῆς*). After the 3rd Psalter reading: **"Studiously cultivating the seed"** (*Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς*); {"Glory...",} "Both now and ever...": **"Most glorified art thou"** (*Ὑπερδεδοξασμένη*). The Resurrectional Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of Pascha, of the Saint, and the two Theotokia. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saint and that of the Myrrhbearers; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Myrrhbearers, the Menologion, and the Synaxarion commentary of the Sunday. The Katavasiai of Pascha, and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then Ode 9 of Pascha as well as that of the Saint, then the two Theotokia as usual. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saint, and of the Myrrhbearers. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": **"Spring has dawned"** (*Ἀνέτειλε τὸ ἔαρ*); "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha; after the Entrance, the three Dismissal Troparia: of the Myrrhbearers, of the Saint, and of the Patron Saint of the Church; the Kontakion: **"Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"** (*Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ*). The Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially": **"The Angel cried out to her that is full of grace... Shine, shine"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*); Communion Hymn: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*); **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: the Apolytikion “When You did descend unto death,” and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter of the day and the Polyeleos. Kathismata of the First Stasis [Stichologia] “The stone of the grave,” Glory of the Saint “Behold, the springtime of grace has dawned,” Now and ever, “Beyond comprehension.” At the Second Stasis “The Myrrhbearers, having risen early,” Glory, “Ablaze with the desire,” Now and ever, “Bringing myrrh for Your burial.” At the Third Stasis “Studiously cultivating,” {Glory,} Now and ever, “Most glorified are you.” The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode, and the Prokimenon. The Canons of Pascha, of the Saint and the two Theotokia. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, then the Kathisma of the Saint and that of the Myrrhbearers; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Myrrhbearers, the Minologion, and the Postscript of the Sunday. The Katavasie of Pascha, and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then the 9th Ode of Pascha and as well that of the Saint, then the two Theotokia, as usual. Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saint and of the Myrrhbearers. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Resurrection and 3 of the Saint, Glory, “Spring has dawned.” Now and ever, “It is the day of Resurrection,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_text: 19.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs during this week until Friday, the service is chanted as prescribed in the Menaion, together with the Afterfeast hymns of the Myrrhbearers; that is, at Vespers, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 6 Stichira of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Myrrhbearers. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Myrrhbearers. Dismissal Troparia: **"When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal"** (*Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον*), that of the Saint, and **"Unto the myrrhbearing women"** (*Ταῖς μυροφόροις γυναιξί*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: Ἠτήσατο Ἰωσὴφ κτλ. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον, ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ἀνὰ ἓν τῶν Μυροφόρων ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων κτλ. ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα³ καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα, Τὴν τιμιωτέραν⁴, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῶν Μυροφόρων. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Μυροφόρων, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τοῦ Πάσχα, καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικόν, {μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον,} τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, Κοντάκιον Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 21.    Εἰ τύχοι τῷ Σαββάτῳ τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος, τῇ Παρασκευῇ ἑσπέρας, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλονται τῶν Μυροφόρων Ἰδιόμελα β΄ καὶ τὰ ς΄ Προσόμοια τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Αἱ μυροφόροι γυναῖκες. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα, Τὸν νοερὸν ἀδάμαντα, Καὶ νῦν, Σὲ τὸν ἀναβαλλόμενον τὸ φῶς, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια Ὅτε κατῆλθες, Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ, Δόξα, Ὡς τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐλευθερωτής, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς μυροφόροις γυναιξὶ καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: [Original Note 4]: Μετὰ τὴν Διακαινήσιμον ἑβδομάδα εἰς οἱανδήποτε ἡμέραν ἤθελε τύχει ἡ ἑορτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου (ἐκτὸς δηλονότι τῶν Κυριακῶν) μετὰ τὰ Δοξαστικά, Καὶ νῦν ψάλλονται τῆς προλαβούσης Κυριακῆς ἢ ἑορτῆς, καὶ οὐχὶ τοῦ Πάσχα, ὡς καὶ τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια, τὰ Ἐξαποστειλάρια (καὶ τὰ Κοντάκια, μόνον διὰ τὴν ἑβδομάδα τοῦ Θωμᾶ καὶ τῶν Μυροφόρων)· στιχολογοῦμεν δὲ καὶ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ, καὶ εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως τὸ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν· τὰ αὐτὰ καὶ εἰς τὰς τῶν λοιπῶν Ἁγίων μνήμας μέχρι τῆς Ἀποδόσεως (Ὅρα καὶ ἐν τῇ Προθεωρίᾳ).

units.english_text: 21.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on the Saturday of this week, on Friday evening, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant two Idiomela of the Myrrhbearers and six Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"The myrrhbearing women"** (*Αἱ μυροφόροι γυναῖκες*). Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": **"The spiritual diamond"** (*Τὸν νοερὸν ἀδάμαντα*); "Both now and ever...": **"Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment"** (*Σὲ τὸν ἀναβαλλόμενον τὸ φῶς ὥσπερ ἱμάτιον*, Ps. 103:2 LXX). The Dismissal Troparia: **"When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal"** (*Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον*), **"The noble Joseph"** (*Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ*); "Glory...": **"As the liberator of captives"** (*Ὡς τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐλευθερωτής*); "Both now and ever...": **"Unto the myrrhbearing women"** (*Ταῖς μυροφόροις γυναιξί*); and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 21.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on the Saturday of this week, on Friday evening, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing the two Idiomela of the Myrrhbearers and six Prosomia of the Saint, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, “The myrrhbearing women.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings of the Saint. The Aposticha of the Saint, Glory, “The intellectual diamond,” Now and ever, “You Who puts on light as a garment.” Apolytikia: “When You did descend unto death,” “The noble Joseph,” Glory, “As the liberator of captives,” Now and ever, “Unto the myrrhbearing women”; and the Dismissal.
units.english_text: [Original Note 4]: After Bright Week, on whatever day the Feast occurs (except for Sunday), after the "Glory...", the "Both now and ever..." chanted are of the preceding Sunday or feast, and not that of Pascha, as well as the Dismissal Troparia, the Exapostilaria (and the Kontakia, only for the week of Thomas and that of the Myrrhbearers). We also chant the Magnificat: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*) at Matins, and at "Especially" we chant **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*). The same is chanted on the feasts of the other saints until the Apodosis. (See also the Protheoria).[^326]

units.english_text: 23.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τοῦ Παραλύτου, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ Παραλύτου β΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀνέβη ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Δοξολογία Μ. τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικόν. units.english_text: and that of the Myrrhbearers. At the Praises: 2 Resurrection Stichira: **"Let every breath and all creation glorify Thee"** (*Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ πᾶσα κτίσις*) and **"Let the Jews make answer"** (*Εἰπάτωσαν Ἰουδαῖοι*), and 4 Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"The women came with fear"** (*Μετὰ φόβου ἦλθον γυναῖκες*, look on Tuesday at the Aposticha); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint. And immediately follows the Divine Liturgy, in which we sing the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia of the Myrrhbearers, of the Saint, and of the Patron Saint of the Church; the Kontakion: **"Thou didst say, Rejoice, unto the Myrrhbearers"** (*Τὸ χαῖρε ταῖς Μυροφόροις*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Saint. At "Especially": **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), Dismissal, and the Apodosis of the Feast of the Myrrhbearers⁵.

units.english_text: 23.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on the Sunday of the Paralytic, on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Paralytic, and 4 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"Jesus went up to Jerusalem"** (*Ἀνέβη ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα*). Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Apostichon: **"O Christ, Who by Thy Passion"** (*Ὁ τῷ πάθει σου Χριστέ*), then the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"In Solomon's Porch"** (*Ἐν τῇ στοᾷ τοῦ Σολομῶντος*). The Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Τὸ ἀκατάληπτον, εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν
units.slavonic_text: Τὸ ἀκατάληπτον, εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς, {Δόξα,} Καὶ νῦν, Τὰ ἐπουράνια, εἶτα τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον κτλ. ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Μυροφόρων (περιπτώσει ς΄ § 17). Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Κύριε τὸν Παράλυτον, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.
units.english_text: 26.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Δευτέρᾳ καὶ τῇ Τρίτῃ τῆς ἑβδομάδος ταύτης, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Παραλύτου (ὡς ἐν περιπτώσει Ζ΄ § 19-20). Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ Εὐφραινέσθω τὰ οὐράνια.

units.english_text: 27.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Μεσοπεντηκοστῆς, τῇ Τρίτῃ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια δ΄ καὶ δ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα β΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου. units.english_text: **"The incomprehensible"** (*Τὸ ἀκατάληπτον*). After the 3rd Psalter reading: **"Studiously cultivating the seed"** (*Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς*); {"Glory...",} "Both now and ever...": **"The heavens all rejoiced"** (*Τὰ ἐπουράνια*). Then the Resurrectional Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon, etc., as prescribed on the Sunday of the Myrrhbearers (Situation Six, Paragraph 17). At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"O Lord, the Paralytic"** (*Κύριε τὸν Παράλυτον*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_text: 25.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"** (*Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ*). The Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially": **"The Angel cried out to her that is full of grace... Shine, shine"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*); Communion Hymn: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*); **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 25.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of Pascha. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, the Apolytikion of the Saint, the Apolytikion of the Saint of the Church; the Kontakion “Though You went down into the tomb.” The Apostolos of the Saint and the Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “The Angel cried,” Communion Hymn “Body of Christ,” “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 27.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on Wednesday of Mid-Pentecost, on Tuesday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the 1st Stasis of the Psalter [Pss. 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Prosomia of the Feast and 4 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings: two of the Feast and one of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. The Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Saint, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: Month of April: St. George the Trophy-Bearer (April 23); Situation XI Concl. (§§ 28–29), Situation XII Opening (§§ 30–31) (p. 524)]
units.english_text: Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ὁ πάντων ἐπιστάμενος· εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν Πόθῳ ζέοντι καὶ {Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν,} Ὁ Δεσπότης τῶν ὅλων, εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς, καὶ {Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν,} τὸ ἐν τῇ γ΄ Ὠδῇ τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἑστηκὼς ἐν τῷ μέσῳ, εἶτα οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει, Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ, καὶ ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀθλοφόρου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον τοῦ Ἁγίου, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι Θάλασσαν ἔπηξας, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς Φωτισθέντες ἀδελφοί, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.english_text: 29.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικόν· μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Μεσούσης τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου· Κοντάκιον Τῆς ἑορτῆς τῆς νομικῆς, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων ἡ παρθενία, Κοινωνικὸν Ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: Sessional Hymns: after the 1st Psalter reading [Stichologia]: of the Saint: **"Behold, the springtime of grace has dawned"** (*Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast: **"He Who knoweth all things"** (*Ὁ πάντων ἐπιστάμενος*). After the 2nd Psalter reading: **"Ablaze with desire"** (*Πόθῳ ζέοντι*); {"Glory... Both now and ever...":} **"The Master of all"** (*Ὁ Δεσπότης τῶν ὅλων*). After the 3rd Psalter reading: **"Studiously cultivating the seed"** (*Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς*); {"Glory... Both now and ever...":} the Sessional Hymn of Ode 3 of the Canon of the Feast: **"Standing in the midst"** (*Ἑστηκὼς ἐν τῷ μέσῳ*). The Anavathmoi: the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4, the Prokeimenon: **"The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree"** (*Δίκαιος ὡς φοῖνιξ ἀνθήσει*, Ps. 91:13 LXX). Then **"Let every breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*) and the Matins Gospel of the Saint. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Trophy-Bearer"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀθλοφόρου πρεσβείαις*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50 LXX) and the Idiomelon of the Saint; the Canons of the Feast and of the Saint. The Katavasiai: **"Drowning the prideful Pharaoh"** (*Θάλασσαν ἔπηξας*); then Ode 9 of the Feast and that of the Saint are sung. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Saint, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast, 3 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast: **"Brethren, enlightened"** (*Φωτισθέντες ἀδελφοί*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

units.english_text: 29.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Mid-way in the feast"** (*Μεσούσης τῆς ἑορτῆς*), and that of the Saint; the Kontakion: **"Of the feast of the Law"** (*Τῆς ἑορτῆς τῆς νομικῆς*); the Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel of the Feast. At "Especially": **"Virginity is alien to motherhood"** (*Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων ἡ παρθενία*); Communion Hymn: **"He that eateth My Flesh and drinketh My Blood abideth in Me, and I in him"** (*Ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα*, John 6:56); **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: those of the Saint “Behold, the springtime of grace has dawned,” Glory, Now and ever that of the Feast “He who knows what lies in the hearts of all.” At the Second Stasis “Ablaze with the desire,” and {Glory, Now and ever,} “The Master of all.” At the Third Stasis “Studiously cultivating,” {Glory, Now and ever} the Kathisma of the Third Ode of the Canon of the Feast “Standing in the midst”; the Anavathmi, the First Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “The righteous shall flourish.” Then “Let everything that breathes” and the Matins Gospel of the Saint. Then “Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ,” Psalm 50 read, Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Champion,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the Idiomelon of the Saint; the Canons of the Feast and of the Saint. The Katavasie “Drowning the prideful Pharaoh,” then the 9th Ode of the Feast and that of the Saint are sung. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Saint and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saint, and the Stichira of Pascha “A sacred Pascha,” Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Feast “Brethren, enlightened,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast.
units.english_text: 30.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs during the Afterfeast of this Feast {i.e. of Mid-Pentecost}, except for the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, at Vespers after the 1st Stasis of the Psalter [Pss. 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 6 Stichira of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; the Old Testament Lessons of the Saint. At the Aposticha: the Stichira and "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Afterfeast. The Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 33.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, ἐν τῇ περιπτώσει ταύτῃ ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Μεσοπεντηκοστῆς καταλιμπάνεται⁶ καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῆς Ἀναστασίμου καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος κατὰ τὴν διάταξιν τῆς Κυριακῆς τοῦ Παραλύτου (ἐν περιπτώσει Θ΄ § 23-25), τὰ Δοξαστικά, τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος. Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς Μεσοπεντηκοστῆς. Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, Καθίσματα, εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν Ἀναβλέψασαι τοῦ τάφου, Δόξα, Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀνέστης ὡς Ἀθάνατος. Εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν Ἐκ τῶν ἄνω κατελθών, Δόξα, Πόθῳ ζέοντι, Καὶ νῦν, Ἑκουσίᾳ σου βουλῇ. Εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Κατεπλάγη Ἰωσήφ, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἡ πηγὴ τῆς ζωαρχίας κτλ. (Ὅρα ἐν τῇ Κυριακῇ τοῦ Παραλύτου).

units.english_text: 33.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, in this situation the service of Mid-Pentecost is omitted⁶ and the service of the Saint is chanted together with that of the Resurrection and the Samaritan Woman, according to the order of the Sunday of the Paralytic (Situation Nine, Paragraphs 23–25); the Doxastika: of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and of Mid-Pentecost. At Matins, Sessional Hymns: after the 1st Psalter reading [Stichologia]: **"Having beheld the entrance of the tomb"** (*Ἀναβλέψασαι τοῦ τάφου*); "Glory...": **"Behold, the springtime of grace has dawned"** (*Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού*); "Both now and ever...": **"Thou didst arise as Immortal"** (*Ἀνέστης ὡς Ἀθάνατος*). After the 2nd Psalter reading: **"Descending from on high"** (*Ἐκ τῶν ἄνω κατελθών*); "Glory...": **"Ablaze with desire"** (*Πόθῳ ζέοντι*); "Both now and ever...": **"By Thine own free will"** (*Ἑκουσίᾳ σου βουλῇ*). After the 3rd Psalter reading: **"Studiously cultivating the seed"** (*Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Joseph was struck with amazement"** (*Κατεπλάγη Ἰωσήφ*). Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saint, and of the Samaritan Woman. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"The wellspring of life-giving principle"** (*Ἡ πηγὴ τῆς ζωαρχίας*), etc. (See on the Sunday of the Paralytic).

If the Feast of the Saint occurs on the Sunday of The Samaritan Woman, the Service of Mid-Pentecost is omitted⁶ and the Service of the Saint is chanted together with that of the Resurrection and the Samaritan Woman, according to the order of the Sunday of the Paralytic (Situation Nine, Paragraphs 23 - 25); Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Samaritan Woman. units.slavonic_incipit: Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν περιπτώσει
units.slavonic_text: Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν περιπτώσει ΙΑ΄ § 27-29 διάταξιν. Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον. Ἀντὶ Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου· Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπόλυσις καὶ Ἀπόδοσις.
units.english_text: 36.    Τῇ Πέμπτῃ ἐς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀγαλλιάσθω σήμερον φαιδρῶς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου δίς, καὶ Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού, καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος {Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν,} Ἀγαλλιάσθω Οὐρανός· εἰς τὴν β΄ Πόθῳ ζέοντι καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος {Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν,} Ἐκ φρέατος νάματα (ζήτει τῇ Παρασκευῇ μετὰ τὴν Κυριακήν)· εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς, καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος {Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν} Ὡς τῇ πηγῇ Σαμαρείτιδι (ζήτει τῇ Πέμπτῃ τῆς αὐτῆς ἑβδομάδος κτλ. ὡς διετάχθησαν ἐν περιπτώσει Δ΄ § 11), ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα, Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους τὰ δ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου Προσόμοια, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἡ πηγὴ τῆς ζωαρχίας, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου.

provenance.verbatim_source: 36.    Τῇ Πέμπτῃ ἐς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀγαλλιάσθω σήμερον φαιδρῶς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. units.english_text: 35.    If the Feast of the Saint occurs on the Thursday following the Apodosis of Mid-Pentecost, on Wednesday evening, after the 1st Stasis of the Psalter [Pss. 1–3 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant the 6 Stichira of the Saint; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"At Jacob's well"** (*Παρὰ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ Ἰακώβ*); the Old Testament Lessons; the Aposticha and "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. The Dismissal Troparion of the Saint: **"As the liberator of captives"** (*Ὡς τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐλευθερωτής*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"The mystery hidden from all eternity"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Pentecost, the Service is celebrated according
units.slavonic_text: Pentecost, the Service is celebrated according to the order in Situation Eleven, Paragraphs 27 - 29. In Matins, Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint and the Minologion. Instead of “More honorable,” we chant the 9th Ode of the Feast and that of the Saint; Apostolos and Gospel of the Saint. At “Especially,” “Virginity is alien to mothers,” Communion Hymn of the Feast, Dismissal and Leave-taking.
units.english_text: 36.    On Thursday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"Let heaven and earth radiantly rejoice today"** (*Ἀγαλλιάσθω σήμερον φαιδρῶς*); the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint twice, and **"The mystery hidden from all eternity"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*); the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. Sessional Hymns: after the 1st Psalter reading [Stichologia]: of the Saint: **"Behold, the springtime of grace has dawned"** (*Ἀνέτειλεν ἰδού*); and of the Samaritan Woman: {"Glory... Both now and ever...":} **"Let heaven rejoice"** (*Ἀγαλλιάσθω οὐρανός*, Sessional Hymn after Ode 3 of Sunday Matins). After the 2nd Psalter reading: **"Ablaze with desire"** (*Πόθῳ ζέοντι*); and of the Samaritan Woman: {"Glory... Both now and ever...":} **"Springs of water from the well"** (*Ἐκ φρέατος νάματα*, look on the Friday after the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman in the Pentecostarion). After the 3rd Psalter reading: **"Studiously cultivating the seed"** (*Γεωργήσας ἐμμελῶς*); and of the Samaritan Woman: {"Glory... Both now and ever...":} **"As unto the Samaritan woman at the well"** (*Ὡς τῇ πηγῇ Σαμαρείτιδι*, look on Thursday of this week in the Pentecostarion, etc., as prescribed in Situation Four, Paragraph 11 on the Sunday of Thomas). The Canon of Pascha and that of the Saint; the Katavasiai of Pascha, then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Saint and of the Samaritan Woman. At the Praises: 4 Prosomia of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"The wellspring of life-giving principle"** (*Ἡ πηγὴ τῆς ζωαρχίας*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint.

units.slavonic_incipit: Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς
units.slavonic_text: Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Σημειωτέον ὅτι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ἁγίου δυνατὸν νὰ συμπέσῃ ἐν τῷ Πεντηκοσταρίῳ ἀπὸ τῆς Δευτέρας τῆς Διακαινησίμου μέχρι τῆς Πέμπτης τῆς ἑβδομάδος τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος. (Ὅρα τὸν τοῦ Ἑορτοδρομίου Πίνακα).
units.english_text: 1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Ἀποστόλου τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Διακαινησίμου, ἡ Ἀκολουθία μετατίθεται καὶ ψάλλεται τῇ Τρίτῃ ὡς ἑξῆς. Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ τῆς Διακαινησίμου ἑσπέρας εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου δ΄. Δόξα, Οἱ ἀναξίως ἑστῶτες (ἢ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου ἐὰν ἑορτάζηται), Καὶ νῦν, Πῶς μὴ θαυμάσωμεν. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ Οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ὁ τῷ πάθει σου Χριστέ, καὶ τὰ Στιχηρὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, αὖθις Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: Saint of the Church; the Kontakion
units.slavonic_text: Saint of the Church; the Kontakion “Though You went down into the tomb”; the Apostolos and the Gospel of the Saint. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “In eternal memorial,” “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name” and Dismissal. Note that the Feast of Saint George may occur in the Pentikostarion from the Monday of Bright Week until the Thursday of the Samaritan Woman. (See the Chart of Celebrations).
units.english_text: 1.    If the commemoration of the Apostle occurs on Monday of Bright Week, the service is transferred and is chanted on Bright Tuesday as follows: On Monday evening of Bright Week, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 Stichira of the Apostle; "Glory...": **"We who stand unworthily"** (*Οἱ ἀναξίως ἑστῶτες*, or of the Apostle if the church is dedicated to him); "Both now and ever...": **"Who would not marvel at thee"** (*Πῶς μὴ θαυμάσωμεν*). Little Entrance, **"O Gladsome Light"**, the Prokeimenon: **"Our God is in Heaven and on earth"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ Οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ*, Ps. 113:11 LXX). At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Apostichon: **"O Christ, Who by Thy Passion"** (*Ὁ τῷ πάθει σου Χριστέ*), and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Apostle; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); **"Christ is risen"**, the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostle, again **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 2.    On Tuesday morning, after **"Christ is risen"** and the Great Synapte,⁷ the Canon of Pascha and that of the Apostle; the Katavasia at the conclusion of each Ode and the Small Synapte [Aitesis], as is customary. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe and the Kontakion of Pascha read plainly; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostle and the Menologion. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*) thrice, and Ode 9 of Pascha alone. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Apostle, and again of Pascha. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Apostle, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Apostle; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); **"Christ is risen"** thrice, and immediately follows the Divine Liturgy according to the order of Bright Week: the Epistle of the day and the Gospel of the Apostle, etc.; Communion Hymn: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*); **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal. {This order is[^332]

units.english_text: 4.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ, εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, ὁ Κανὼν τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου (εἰ βούλει). Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου γ΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς κτλ. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς (τοῦ Πάσχα), τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς· Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς, καὶ καθεξῆς τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.english_text: 5.    If the commemoration of Saint Mark occurs on the Sunday of the Myrrhbearers, on Saturday evening, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Myrrhbearers, and 3 of the Apostle; "Glory...": of the Myrrhbearers; "Both now and ever...": **"The shadow of the Law hath passed away"** (*Παρῆλθεν ἡ σκιά*). At the Aposticha: "Glory...": of the Apostle; "Both now and ever...": **"Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment"** (*Σὲ τὸν ἀναβαλλόμενον τὸ φῶς ὥσπερ ἱμάτιον*, Ps. 103:2 LXX). The Dismissal Troparia: **"When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal"** (*Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον*), **"The noble Joseph"** (*Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ*), **"O Holy Apostle"** (*Ἀπόστολε Ἅγιε*), **"Unto the myrrhbearing women"** (*Ταῖς μυροφόροις γυναιξί*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: other Sessional Hymn of the Myrrhbearers, etc. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Apostle, and of the Myrrhbearers. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Apostle, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": the Morning Gospel Doxastikon [Eothinon]; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation is come unto the world"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*). And immediately follows the Divine Liturgy, in which we sing the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Entrance, the three Dismissal Troparia of the Myrrhbearers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostle, the Dismissal Troparion of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"** (*Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ*). The Epistle of the Apostle and the Gospel of the Sunday, etc.; Communion Hymn: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*); **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Resurrection and 3 of the Apostle, and “A sacred Pascha,” Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “It is the day of Resurrection,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” And immediately follows the Liturgy, in which we sing the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of Pascha. After the Entrance, the three Apolytikia of the Myrrhbearers, the Apolytikion of the Apostle, the Apolytikion of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Though You went down into the tomb.” The Apostolos of the Apostle and the Gospel of the Sunday, etc. Communion Hymn “Body of Christ,” “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 8.    At Matins, at "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Sessional Hymns of the day from the Pentecostarion. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), Psalm 50 [LXX], and the Canons of the Myrrhbearers and of the Apostle. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn of the Apostle and that of the Myrrhbearers; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostle and the Menologion. The Katavasiai of Pascha, then **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Apostle and of the Myrrhbearers. At the Praises: the Prosomia of the Apostle; "Glory...": of the Apostle; "Both now and ever...": of the Myrrhbearers; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Myrrhbearers. units.english_text: 11.    Τῇ Τετάρτῃ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον ἅπασα ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς ἑορτῆς ὡς διατάττεται ἐν τῷ Πεντηκοσταρίῳ, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς· τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἀποστόλου κτλ. ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἀποστόλου γ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἀποστόλου (εἰ βούλει), Καὶ νῦν τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἐπίσης καὶ Κοινωνικόν.

units.slavonic_text: Service see above Paragraphs 5 and 6 of the Sunday of the Myrrhbearers (except that, at the Praises, the Now and ever hymn is not “It is the day of Resurrection,” {but is replaced by the Glory Hymn [Doxastikon] of the Praises of the preceeding Sunday, prefaced by Now and ever}); on the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, the Service of Mid-Pentecost is omitted and in its place is sung that of the Apostle.
units.english_text: 11.    On Wednesday at Matins, the entire service of the Feast as prescribed in the Pentecostarion; the Canons of the Feast and of the Apostle. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostle, the Sessional Hymn of the Feast, that of the Apostle, and the other of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast; the Menologion of the Apostle, etc. Then Ode 9 of the Feast. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Apostle, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Apostle; "Glory...": of the Apostle (if desired); "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast. And immediately follows the Divine Liturgy, including the Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel of the Feast, as well as the Communion Hymn of the Feast (*Ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα*).

The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Apostle, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Apostle; "Glory...": of the Apostle (if desired); "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast. And immediately follows the Divine Liturgy, including the Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel of the Feast, as well as the Communion Hymn of the Feast (*Ὁ τρώγων μου τὴν σάρκα*).

units.slavonic_text: 10.    If the Feast of Saint Mark occurs on the Wednesday of Mid-Pentecost, in Vespers, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing the 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Apostle, Glory, Now and ever of the Feast. The Aposticha of the Feast, Glory of the Apostle, Now and ever of the Feast. Apolytikia: of the Feast, of the Apostle, and again of the Feast and the Dismissal. 11.    On Wednesday at Matins, the entire Service of the Feast as prescribed in the Pentikostarion, the Canons of the Feast and of the Apostle. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostle, the Kathisma of the Feast, that of the Apostle and the other of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast; the Minologion of the Apostle, etc. Then the 9th Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Apostle and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Apostle, Glory of the Apostle (if desired), Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast. And immediately follows the Liturgy including the Apostolos of the Saint and the Gospel of the Feast as well as the Communion Hymn of the Feast. On the Leave-taking of the Feast, the same order of the Service of the Apostle is followed. In the Post-feast days of this Feast, the Service of the Apostle is sung according to the order of the Mineon with the hymns of the Post-feast. Note that the Feast of the Apostle may occur in the period of the Pentikostarion from the Tuesday of Bright Week until the Saturday of the week of the Samaritan Woman. (See the Chart of Celebrations).

units.english_text: 3.    On Saturday, following the Midnight Service, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading, and the daily Sessional Hymns from the Pentecostarion. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*), Psalm 50 [LXX], and the Canons of the Feast (Thomas Sunday) and of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Kontakion of the Saint, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saint and that of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and the Menologion of the Saint; the Katavasiai of Pascha and Ode 9 of Thomas Sunday; the Katavasia: **"The Angel cried out"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*). The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saint, and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 hymns of the Feast: **"After Thy awesome Resurrection from the tomb"** (*Μετὰ τὴν ἐκ τάφου σου φρικτήν σου ἔγερσιν*), and 3 hymns of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and in due order[^336]

units.english_text: 5.    If the commemoration of Saint Athanasios occurs on the Sunday of the Paralytic, the Samaritan Woman, or the Blind Man, at Vespers, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 from the Pentecostarion, and 3 of the Saint; "Glory...": from the Pentecostarion; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone (Dogmatikon). At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron of the Tone, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": from the Pentecostarion. The Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: SITUATION THREE
units.english_text: 6.    On Sunday at Matins, the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers, etc.; the Canon of Pascha (and that of the Saint, if desired) with the 2 Theotokia. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Sessional Hymn of the Saint as well as that of the Pentecostarion. Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saint, and of the Sunday. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": from the Pentecostarion; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*), etc. In the Divine Liturgy, after the Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Saint, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"** (*Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ*). The Epistle of the Saint and the Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially": **"The Angel cried out"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα*); Communion Hymn: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*); the Dismissal Troparion **"Christ is risen"**, **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 8.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Ἀποδόσεως τοῦ Πάσχα, τῇ Τρίτῃ ἑσπέρας, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου Προσόμοια δ΄, Δόξα, Τὸν τῷ Πατρὶ συνάναρχον, Καὶ νῦν, Τὴν παγκόσμιον δόξαν. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὸ Στιχηρὸν Τῷ πάθει σου Χριστὲ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, αὖθις Χριστὸς ἀνέστη καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 9.    Τῇ Τετάρτῃ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου, ἐν ἑκάστῃ Ὠδῇ ἡ Καταβασία, τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη καὶ ἡ Αἴτησις ὡς εἴθισται· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ Προλαβοῦσαι τὸν Ὄρθρον καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου χῦμα· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Πάσχα, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ τρίς· μετὰ τὴν ζ΄ καὶ η΄ Ὠδὴν, ἡ Θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Πάσχα, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ αὖθις τὸ τοῦ Πάσχα. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ Λειτουργία. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ Προλαβοῦσαι, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Πάσχα, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, Κοινωνικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 8. The Dismissal Troparion **"Christ is risen"**, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, again **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: SITUATION FIVE
units.english_text: 9.    On Wednesday at Matins, the Canon of Pascha and that of the Saint; at each Ode the Katavasia, **"Christ is risen"**, and the Small Synapte [Aitesis] as customary. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe **"When they who were with Mary came before the dawn"** (*Προλαβοῦσαι τὸν ὄρθρον*) and the Kontakion of the Saint (read plainly); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of Pascha, the Menologion of the Saint, and **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*) thrice; after Odes 7 and 8, Ode 9 of Pascha with its Megalynaria. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saint, and again of Pascha. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Saint, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*), and in due order the Divine Liturgy. After the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion **"Christ is risen"**, the Hypakoe: **"When they who were with Mary"** (*Προλαβοῦσαι*), the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, the Kontakion of Pascha, the Epistle and Gospel of the Saint, the Communion Hymn of Pascha: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*), **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Τῇ Η΄. Τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀποστόλου καὶ
units.slavonic_text: Τῇ Η΄.    Τοῦ ἁγίου Ἀποστόλου καὶ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ Ἰωάννου τοῦ Θεολόγου.
units.english_text: 1.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Μυροφόρων, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τῶν Μυροφόρων β΄ καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Μυροφόρων. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα· εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὸ ἀναστάσιμον τοῦ ἤχου Στιχηρὸν καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν, Σὲ τὸν ἀναβαλλόμενον τὸ φῶς, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια Ὅτε κατῆλθες, Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Ταῖς Μυροφόροις γυναιξὶ καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: ΠΕΡΙΠΤΩΣΕΙΣ
units.english_text: 2.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὸ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἠτήσατο Ἰωσήφ, τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστι, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα κατὰ σειράν, εἰς τὴν β΄ Αἱ Μυροφόροι ὄρθριαι, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ Ἀναπεσὼν ἐν τῷ στήθει, Καὶ νῦν, Τὰ μύρα τῆς ταφῆς, εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ Τὴν μνήμην τιμήσωμεν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερδεδοξασμένη, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα μετὰ τῶν δύο Θεοτοκίων, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τῶν Μυροφόρων· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Μυροφόρων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς· αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, ἡ θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα, εἶτα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ δύο Θεοτοκία, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τῶν Μυροφόρων. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ γ΄, καὶ τὰ Στιχηρὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα, Εὐαγγελιστὰ

units.slavonic_text: 8th.    The Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian.
units.english_text: 1.    If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on the Sunday of the Myrrhbearers, on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Myrrhbearers, and 4 of the Evangelist; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": of the Myrrhbearers. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron of the Tone, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": **"Thou Who coverest Thyself with light as with a garment"** (*Σὲ τὸν ἀναβαλλόμενον τὸ φῶς ὥσπερ ἱμάτιον*, Ps. 103:2 LXX). Dismissal Troparia: **"When Thou didst descend unto death"** (*Ὅτε κατῆλθες πρὸς τὸν θάνατον*), **"The noble Joseph"** (*Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ*), that of the Evangelist: **"O Apostle, beloved of Christ God"** (*Ἀπόστολε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ ἠγαπημένε*), **"Unto the myrrhbearing women"** (*Ταῖς μυροφόροις γυναιξί*), and Dismissal.
