units.slavonic_text: SITUATION ONE
units.english_text: 2.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon [Triadikos Kanon], the Litiya of the Evangelist; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Joseph asked"** (*Ἠτήσατο Ἰωσήφ*); **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion **"The noble Joseph"** (*Ὁ εὐσχήμων Ἰωσήφ*), and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. Sessional Hymns: after the 1st Psalter reading [Stichologia], those of the Resurrection in order; after the 2nd Psalter reading: **"The myrrhbearers having risen early"** (*Αἱ μυροφόροι ὄρθριαι*); "Glory...": of the Evangelist: **"Having reclined upon the bosom of Jesus"** (*Ἀναπεσὼν ἐν τῷ στήθει τοῦ Ἰησοῦ*); "Both now and ever...": **"Bringing myrrh for Thy burial"** (*Τὰ μύρα τῆς ταφῆς*); after the 3rd Psalter reading, the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist: **"Let us honor the memory of the Evangelist"** (*Τὴν μνήμην τιμήσωμεν τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ*); {"Glory...": repeat the same;} "Both now and ever...": **"Most glorified art thou, Virgin Theotokos"** (*Ὑπερδεδοξασμένη ὑπάρχεις, Θεοτόκε Παρθένε*). The Resurrection Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canon of Pascha with the two Theotokia, and the Canon of the Evangelist. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Evangelist, then the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist and that of the Myrrhbearers; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Myrrhbearers, the Menologion, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema]. The Katavasiai of Pascha, and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; Ode 9 of Pascha, then that of the Saint and the two Theotokia. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Evangelist, and of the Myrrhbearers. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Evangelist, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": **"O Evangelist John, equal-to-the-apostles"** (*Εὐαγγελιστὰ Ἰωάννη, ἰσαπόστολε*); "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*)...[^339]

units.english_text: 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὰ γ΄ τῶν Μυροφόρων Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ· Κοντάκιον Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα . . . Φωτίζου, φωτίζου, Κοινωνικὸν Σῶμα Χριστοῦ, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: Ἰωάννη, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὰ γ΄ τῶν Μυροφόρων Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ· Κοντάκιον Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα . . . Φωτίζου, φωτίζου, Κοινωνικὸν Σῶμα Χριστοῦ, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Εἰ τύχοι οἱαδήποτε ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑβδομάδος ταύτης, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν μετὰ τῶν μεθεόρτων τῶν Μυροφόρων. (Ὅρα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ Ἁγίου Γεωργίου § 19-22 καὶ τὴν ὑποσημείωσιν). Εἰ τύχοι ταῖς ἑπομέναις δυσὶ Κυριακαῖς καὶ ταῖς λοιπαῖς τῶν ἑβδομάδων τούτων ἡμέραις, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν διάταξιν τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ ἁγίου Γεωργίου ἐν § 23-26 καὶ 33.

units.slavonic_text: 4.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Μεσοπεντηκοστῆς, τῇ Τρίτῃ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ γ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα, β΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἓν τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 5.    Τῇ Τετάρτῃ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὸ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ὅτε τὸ μέσον τῆς ἑορτῆς ἐπέστη (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα)· τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ δύο τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἀντὶ τῶν

Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 3.    In the Liturgy, we sing the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of Pascha. After the Entrance, the 3 Apolytikia of the Myrrhbearers, the Apolytikion of the Evangelist, and that of the Saint of the Church, Kontakion “Though You did descend into the grave.” Apostolos of the Evangelist and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “The Angel cried out . . . Shine, shine,” Communion Hymn “Body of Christ,” the Apolytikion “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name” and Dismissal. If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on any other day of this week, the Service is sung according to the order of of service of the Mineon with the Post-feast Hymns of the Myrrhbearers. (See the Feast of Saint George Paragraphs 19 - 22 and the footnote). If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on the following two Sundays and the weekdays following those Sundays, the Service is sung according to the order of service of the Feast of Saint George in Paragraphs 23 - 26 and 33.

units.english_text: 4.    If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on the Wednesday of Mid-Pentecost, on Tuesday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the first Stasis [Kathisma] of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Evangelist; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Lessons: 2 of the Feast and 1 of the Evangelist. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, that of the Evangelist, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: Θεοτοκίων. Οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου. Προκείμενον Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ τὸ ΙΑ΄ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τὴν τῶν Ἀποστόλων ἀκρότητα (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν). Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀμφότεροι καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὸ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θάλασσαν ἔπηξας, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_text: Θεοτοκίων. Οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου. Προκείμενον Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ τὸ ΙΑ΄ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τὴν τῶν Ἀποστόλων ἀκρότητα (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν). Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀμφότεροι καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ. Ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὸ ἓν τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θάλασσαν ἔπηξας, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς· Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. 6. Εἰ δὲ τύχοι ἐν τοῖς μεθεόρτοις καὶ τῇ Ἀποδόσει τῆς ἑορτῆς ταύτης, τὴν τῆς Ἀκολουθίας διάταξιν ὅρα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ ἁγίου Γεωργίου, [Ἀπριλίου 23], § 30-34.

units.english_text: ...The Prokeimenon: **"His sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX), and the 11th Matins [Eothinon] Gospel. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*) and Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostle..."** (*Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀποστόλου πρεσβείαις...*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos..."** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου πρεσβείαις...*); the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Thy great mercy..."** [Ps. 50:1 LXX], and the Idiomelon **"O faithful, let us bless the summit of the Apostles"** (*Τὴν τῶν Ἀποστόλων ἀκρότητα*, look for this in the Litiya). Both Canons of the Feast and that of the Evangelist. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Evangelist, the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist and one of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Feast. The Katavasiai: **"Thou didst divide the sea"** (*Θάλασσαν ἔπηξας*); then are sung Ode 9 of the Feast and that of the Evangelist. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Evangelist, and again of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Evangelist; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Evangelist, Glory of the Evangelist, Now and ever of the Feast; Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast. 6. At “Especially,” “Virginity is alien to motherhood,” Communion Hymn of the Feast, “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord” and Dismissal. If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on the Post-feast days or on the Leave-taking of this Feast, see Saint George [April 23] Paragraphs 30-34 for the order of the Service.

units.english_text: 7.    If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on the Sunday of the Blind Man [Sixth Sunday of Pascha], on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Blind Man, and 4 of the Evangelist; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": **"Lord, passing by on the way"** (*Κύριε παράγων ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ*). Little Entrance, the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Evangelist. At the Aposticha: the Stichiron **"Thou Who wast incarnate"** (*Σὲ τὸν σαρκωθέντα*) and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": **"O Sun of Righteousness"** (*Δικαιοσύνης ἥλιε*). The Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Evangelist, the Theotokion **"All thy mysteries are beyond comprehension"** (*Πάντα ὑπὲρ ἔννοιαν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: Month of May: St. John the Apostle and Evangelist (May 8); Situation III Concl. (§§ 8 Concl.–9), Situation IV Opening (§ 10) (p. 550)]
units.english_text: Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν, Ὅλον τὸν βίον ὁ τυφλός, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, τὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀναστασίμων Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον· ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα, ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ τὰ β΄ Θεοτοκία· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τοῦ Τυφλοῦ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Τυφλοῦ, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς, αἱ Καταβασίαι Τῷ Σωτῆρι Θεῷ, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα ἡ θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα ὡς σύνηθες μετὰ τῆς τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῶν β΄ Θεοτοκίων, ὁ Εἱρμὸς Σὲ τὴν ὑπὲρ νοῦν, Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὸ Παράγων ὁ Σωτὴρ ἡμῶν. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ γ΄ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα, Εὐαγγελιστὰ Ἰωάννη, Καὶ νῦν, Τίς λαλήσει τὰς δυναστείας σου, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_text: [English Facing Translation: Month of May: St. John the Apostle and Evangelist (May 8); Situation III Concl. (§§ 8 Concl.–9), Situation IV Opening (§ 10) (p. 551)]
units.english_text: ..."Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": **"The blind man, accounting all his life as though it were night"** (*Ὅλον τὸν βίον ὁ τυφλός*), and the Trinity Hymns **"It is meet in truth"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Evangelist, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. Resurrection Sessional Hymns, those of the Evangelist followed by the Resurrection Theotokia. The Resurrection Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon; the Canon of Pascha, that of the Evangelist, and the 2 Theotokia. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Evangelist, then the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist and that of the Blind Man; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Blind Man, the Menologion of the day, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema]. units.english_text: 10.    If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on the Wednesday of the Apodosis of Pascha, on Tuesday evening, after "Glory to the holy, consubstantial, life-creating, and undivided Trinity" and **"Christ is risen"** as customary, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 6 Stichira of the Octoechos **"Accept our evening prayers"** (*Τὰς ἑσπερινὰς ἡμῶν εὐχάς*) and 4 of the Evangelist; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": **"The universal glory"** (*Τὴν παγκόσμιον δόξαν*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Evangelist. At the Aposticha: the Stichiron **"By Thy Passion, O Christ"** (*Τῷ πάθει σου Χριστέ*) and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); **"Christ is risen"**, the Dismissal Troparion of the Evangelist, then again **"Christ is risen"**, and Dismissal.[^342]

units.english_text: 11.    Τῇ Τετάρτῃ πρωΐ, μετὰ τὸ Δόξα τῇ ἁγίᾳ . . . τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη κτλ. ὡς χθές, καὶ τὴν Μεγάλην Συναπτήν, ψάλλεται τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ ΙΑ΄ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ ἅπαξ, καὶ εὐθὺς Δόξα, Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀποστόλου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τὴν τῶν Ἀποστόλων ἀκρότητα, καὶ μετὰ τὴν ἐκφώνησιν Ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς, ψάλλεται ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ ἀνὰ δ΄ Τροπάρια· εἰς τὸ τέλος ἑκάστης Ὠδῆς, ἡ Καταβασία, τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη γ΄, τὸ Ἀναστὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡ Αἴτησις· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοὴ καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Πάσχα, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, εἶτα τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ ἐκ γ΄ καὶ τὸ Ἀναστὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀκολούθως ἡ ζ΄ καὶ η΄ Ὠδή, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον Σαρκὶ ὑπνώσας, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ αὖθις τὸ Σαρκὶ ὑπνώσας. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ Ὑμνοῦμέν σου Χριστὲ γ΄, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ γ΄ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα, τὸ Χριστὸς ἀνέστη γ΄ καὶ ἄρχεται ἡ Λειτουργία.

units.slavonic_text: [English Facing Translation: Month of May: St. John the Apostle and Evangelist (May 8); Situation IV Concl. (§§ 11–12), Situation V Opening (§ 13 Opening) (p. 553)]
units.english_text: 11.    On Wednesday morning at Matins, after "Glory to the holy, consubstantial, life-creating, and undivided Trinity" and **"Christ is risen"**, etc., as yesterday, and after the Great Synapte [Great Litany], we sing the First Antiphon of Tone 4 [Mode IV], the Prokeimenon: **"His sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX), **"Let every breath praise the Lord"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the 11th Matins [Eothinon] Gospel. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*) once, and immediately "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostle..."** (*Ταῖς τοῦ Ἀποστόλου πρεσβείαις...*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos..."** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου πρεσβείαις...*); the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Thy great mercy..."** [Ps. 50:1 LXX], and the Idiomelon **"O faithful, let us bless the summit of the Apostles"** (*Τὴν τῶν Ἀποστόλων ἀκρότητα*). After the exclamation **"Through the mercy and compassion..."** (*Ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς*), we sing the Canon of Pascha and 4 Troparia from the Canon of the Evangelist. At the end of each Ode, we chant the Katavasia, then **"Christ is risen"** thrice, **"Jesus having risen from the grave"** (*Ἀναστὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς*), and the Small Synapte [Aitesis]. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe and the Kontakion of Pascha; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Evangelist, the Menologion, then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** thrice, and **"Jesus having risen from the grave"**; then follow Odes 7 and 8; then are sung Ode 9 of Pascha with its Megalynaria as well as Ode 9 of the Evangelist. The Exapostilarion: **"Having fallen asleep in the flesh"** (*Σαρκὶ ὑπνώσας*), that of the Evangelist, and again **"Having fallen asleep in the flesh"**. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira: **"We praise Thy saving Passion, O Christ"** (*Ὑμνοῦμέν σου Χριστὲ τὸ σωτήριον πάθος*), 3 of the Evangelist, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": **"It is the day of Resurrection"** (*Ἀναστάσεως ἡμέρα*); **"Christ is risen"** thrice, and the Divine Liturgy begins.

units.english_text: 12.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha; after the Entrance, **"Christ is risen"**, the Hypakoe: **"When they who were with Mary came before the dawn"** (*Προλαβοῦσαι τὸν ὄρθρον*), the Dismissal Troparion of the Evangelist, and the Kontakion: **"Though Thou didst descend into the grave"** (*Εἰ καὶ ἐν τάφῳ*). Instead of the Trisagion Hymn, we chant **"As many as have been baptized into Christ"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε*, Gal. 3:27); the Epistle and Gospel of the Evangelist. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"The Angel cried out . . . Shine, shine"** (*Ὁ Ἄγγελος ἐβόα . . . Φωτίζου, φωτίζου*). Communion Hymn: **"Receive the Body of Christ"** (*Σῶμα Χριστοῦ*); **"Christ is risen"** thrice, and Dismissal.

At the end of each Ode, we chant the Katavasia, then the “Christ is risen” (3 times), the “Having risen from the grave” and the Petition. units.english_text: 13.    If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on Thursday of the Ascension of Our Lord, on Wednesday evening after the Ninth Hour of Pascha, "Blessed is our God" and the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX]. At **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing the Idiomela of the Feast in 6 and of the Evangelist in 4; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast...[^343]

units.english_text: 14.    Τῇ Πέμπτῃ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος. Εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν, τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς, εἰς τὴν β΄ καὶ γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀνὰ μίαν. Οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ἀνέβη ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Γ΄ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Σήμερον ἐν οὐρανοῖς, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀμφότεροι καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον, καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ γ΄, Δόξα, Εὐαγγελιστὰ Ἰωάννη, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.slavonic_text: Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα, δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ἓν τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_text: 15.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν Ἀνέβη ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. units.slavonic_text: 14.    Τῇ Πέμπτῃ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος. Εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν, τὸ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς, εἰς τὴν β΄ καὶ γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τὰ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀνὰ μίαν. Οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ἀνέβη ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Γ΄ Ἑωθινὸν Εὐαγγέλιον, τὸ Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Σήμερον ἐν οὐρανοῖς, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀμφότεροι καὶ ὁ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον, καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ γ΄, Δόξα, Εὐαγγελιστὰ Ἰωάννη, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς. Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. 15. Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Σὲ τὴν ὑπὲρ νοῦν καὶ λόγον, Κοινωνικὸν Ἀνέβη ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ, τὸ Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 14.    On Thursday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Feast and of the Evangelist; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. At the 1st Psalter reading [Stichologia], the Sessional Hymn of the Feast twice; at the 2nd and 3rd Psalter readings [Stichologiai], those of the Evangelist and that of the Feast alternately (one each). The Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4 [Mode IV], the Prokeimenon: **"God is gone up with a shout"** (*Ἀνέβη ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ*, Ps. 46:6 LXX), **"Let every breath praise the Lord"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the 3rd Matins [Eothinon] Gospel. Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*) and Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostles..."** (*Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρεσβείαις...*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos..."** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου πρεσβείαις...*); the Verse: **"Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Thy great mercy..."** [Ps. 50:1 LXX], and the Idiomelon: **"Today on high the heavenly powers"** (*Σήμερον ἐν οὐρανοῖς*). Both Canons of the Feast and that of the Evangelist. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Evangelist, the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist and that of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Feast. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*); then are sung Ode 9 of the Feast with its Megalynaria and that of the Evangelist. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Evangelist, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Evangelist; "Glory...": **"O Evangelist John"** (*Εὐαγγελιστὰ Ἰωάννη*); "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

units.slavonic_incipit: Evangelist, Now and ever of the
units.slavonic_text: Evangelist, Now and ever of the Feast. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon of the day, and the Readings: two of the Feast and one of the Evangelist. The Aposticha of the Feast, Glory of the Evangelist, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Evangelist, and again that of the Feast, and the Dismissal. 14.    On Thursday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Feast and of the Evangelist, Glory of the Evangelist, Now and ever of the Feast; the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos. At the First Stasis [Stichologia,] the Kathisma of the Feast (twice), at the 2nd and 3rd Stases [Stichologie] those of the Evangelist and that of the Feast. The Anavathmi, the First Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “God is gone up in a great shout.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the 3rd Eothinon (Matins) Gospel. Then “Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ,” Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Apostles,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy upon me,” and the Idiomelon “Today the hosts on high”; both Canons of the Feast and that of the Evangelist. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Evangelist, the Kathisma of the Evangelist and that of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Minologion, and the Postscript of the Feast. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud,” then are sung the 9th Ode of the Feast with its Megalynaria and that of the Evangelist. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Evangelist and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Evangelist, Glory, “O Evangelist John,” Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast. 15.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast and the Entrance Hymn “God is gone up in a great shout.” After the Entrance, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Evangelist, and the Kontakion of the Feast; the Apostolos of the Evangelist and the Gospel of the Feast. At “Especially,” “You who are above the human mind and speech,” Communion Hymn “God is gone up in a great shout,” the Apolytikion “You ascended in glory,” “Blessed be the name” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 15.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon]: **"God is gone up with a shout"** (*Ἀνέβη ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ*, Ps. 46:6 LXX). After the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Evangelist, and the Kontakion of the Feast; the Epistle of the Evangelist and the Gospel of the Feast. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"Thee Who art beyond comprehension of mind and word"** (*Σὲ τὴν ὑπὲρ νοῦν καὶ λόγον*). Communion Hymn: **"God is gone up with a shout"** (*Ἀνέβη ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ἀλαλαγμῷ*, Ps. 46:6 LXX); the Dismissal Troparion: **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν*); **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 17.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Ἁγίων Πατέρων, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Ἀναλήψεως καταλιμπάνεται, καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ ἀναστάσιμος Ἀκολουθία, ἡ τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ ἡ τῶν Πατέρων ὡς ἑξῆς. Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ γ΄ καὶ τῶν Πατέρων δ΄. Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα δύο τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ ἓν τῶν Πατέρων. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τῶν Πατέρων τὸ Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίου, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 17.    If the Feast of Saint John the Evangelist occurs on the Sunday of the Holy Fathers, the service of the Ascension is omitted, and the services of the Resurrection, of the Evangelist, and of the Fathers are sung as follows: On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Evangelist, and 4 of the Fathers; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons: 2 of the Evangelist and 1 of the Fathers. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Evangelist; "Both now and ever...": of the Fathers. The Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Evangelist, and of the Fathers the Troparion of the Ascension: **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*) instead of a Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 18.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon [Triadikos Kanon] and the Litiya of the Evangelist; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Of the apostolic traditions"** (*Ἀποστολικῶν παραδόσεων*); the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*), the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Fathers, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. At the first Kathisma [Stichologia], the Resurrection Sessional Hymns; at the second Kathisma [Stichologia], the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist with the Resurrection Sessional Hymns (of which one precedes and the other follows; see the May Menaion for the exact sequence); and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia], the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist and **"O Virgin Theotokos, beseech Thy Son"** (*Θεοτόκε Παρθένε ἱκέτευε τὸν Υἱόν σου*). The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Resurrection Canon, that of the Evangelist, and that of the Fathers. After Ode 3, the Resurrection Kontakion and that of the Fathers read plainly, then the Sessional Hymn of the Evangelist and **"All-shining luminaries"** (*Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι*). After Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Evangelist, the Menologion, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Sunday. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*), and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). units.english_text: 19.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, τῶν Πατέρων, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 20.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Παρασκευῇ τῆς ἑβδομάδος ταύτης, ἐν ᾗ ἀποδίδοται ἡ ἑορτὴ τῆς Ἀναλήψεως, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῆς τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ ψάλλεται ὡς ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς (§ 13-15), ἐξαιρουμένων τῶν τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἀναγνωσμάτων ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ, τῆς Λιτῆς τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Ἐν δὲ τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον λέγονται τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ καὶ Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.english_text: 19.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes of the Tone in 4 and 4 from Ode 6 of the Canon of the Evangelist. The Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon]: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). After the Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Feast, that of the Evangelist, that of the Fathers, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"When for us Thou hadst fulfilled Thy dispensation"** (*Τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*); the Epistle of the Evangelist and the Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); the Dismissal Troparion **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*), and Dismissal.

In the Liturgy, the Typika, the 4 hymns of the Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Evangelist. The Entrance Hymn “O come let us worship . . . who is risen from the dead”; after the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Feast, that of the Evangelist, that of the Fathers, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion “When, for us, You had fulfilled Your dispensation”; Apostolos of the Evangelist and Gospel of the Sunday. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Στιχηρὰ τοῦ Ἁγίου εἰς δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μ. τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ἀκολούθως ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλονται τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικόν. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 3.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, καταλιμπάνεται ἡ Ἀκολουθία τῆς Μεσοπεντηκοστῆς, ψαλλομένου μόνου τοῦ Ἀπολυτικίου ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ καὶ τῷ Ὄρθρῳ, ὡς καὶ μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον ἐν τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ ὡς ἑξῆς· Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα, ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος β΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. units.english_text: 2.    At Matins, the Canon of the Feast and that of the Saints; the Katavasiai of the Feast; **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Exapostilarion of the Saints and that of the Feast. At the Praises: the 4 Stichira of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints. Then follows the Divine Liturgy, in which we chant the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Saints, and of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Feast; the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Unto all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); **"Christ is risen"** (*Χριστὸς ἀνέστη*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman), the Service of the Saints is celebrated together with the Post-feast of Mid-Pentecost as follows: In Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm, at “Lord, I have cried” the 3 Stichira of the Saints {twice each}; Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast, the Readings of the Saints as well as the Aposticha, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikion of the Saints, that of the Feast and Dismissal. 2.    At Matins, the Canon of the Feast and that of the Saints, the Katavasie of the Feast, “More honorable,” the Exapostilarion of the Saints and that of the Feast. At the Praises: the 4 Stichira of the Saint, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Saints. Then follows the Liturgy, in which we chant the Antiphons and Entrance Hymn of Easter. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia of the Feast, of the Saints, of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Feast; Apostolos and Gospel of the Saints. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “To all the earth,” the Apolytikion “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 3.    If the Feast of the Saints occurs on the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, the service of Mid-Pentecost is omitted; only the Dismissal Troparion is sung at Vespers and at Matins, as well as after the Entrance in the Divine Liturgy. The services are performed as follows: On Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 2 of the Samaritan Woman, and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichiron of the Tone and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: Month of May: St. Constantine and Helen (May 21); Situation II Concl. (§§ 4 Concl.–5), Situation III (§ 6), Situation IV (§ 7) (p. 562)]
units.english_text: Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον· ὁ Κανὼν τοῦ Πάσχα, ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ β΄ Θεοτοκία· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Μηνολόγιον, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, αἱ Καταβασίαι τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τοῦ Πάσχα καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῶν β΄ Θεοτοκίων καὶ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, Ἐξαποστειλάριον τοῦ Πάσχα, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα γ΄, τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄ καὶ τὰ Πάσχα ἱερόν. Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς Σαμαρείτιδος, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: ...its Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canon of Pascha, that of the Saints, and the two Theotokia. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Samaritan Woman, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Samaritan Woman; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Menologion, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Samaritan Woman. The Katavasiai of Pascha, and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then are sung Ode 9 of Pascha and that of the Saints with the 2 Theotokia and the Megalynaria. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saints, and of the Samaritan Woman. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Saints, and the Paschal Stichira: **"A sacred Pascha"** (*Πάσχα ἱερόν*); "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Samaritan Woman; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi of the Mode, the Anavathmi, and the Prokimenon. The Canon of Pascha, the Canon of the Saints and the two Theotokia. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Samaritan Woman, then the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Samaritan Woman; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Minologion, and the Postscript of the Samaritan Woman. The Katavasie of Pascha, and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then the 9th Ode of Pascha, then the 9th Ode of the Saints, and the 2 Theotokia with the Megalynaria. The Exapostilaria: of Pascha, of the Saints, and of the Samaritan Woman. At the Praises: 3 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Saints, and the Stichira “A sacred Pascha,” Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Samaritan Woman, Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 5.    In the Liturgy, we sing the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of Pascha. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Feast, of the Saints, of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion of Easter. Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “The Angel cried out . . . Shine, shine,” Communion Hymn of Easter, the Apolytikion “Christ is risen,” “Blessed be the name” and Dismissal. If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the Leave-taking of Mid-Pentecost, see the Feast of Saint George, Paragraph 31 for the order of the service.

Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Ἁγίων Πατέρων, (ἡ ἀκολουθία τῆς Ἀναλήψεως καταλιμπάνεται, καὶ ἡ ἀκολουθία ἡ ἀναστάσιμος, τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τῶν Πατέρων ψάλλονται ὡς ἑξῆς·) τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, τῶν Πατέρων γ΄, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. Δόξα, Τὰς μυστικὰς σήμερον, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον, καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα, δύο τῶν Πατέρων, καὶ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Πατέρων, τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς (τῆς Ἀναλήψεως).

units.slavonic_text: SITUATION FIVE
units.english_text: 10.    If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the days of the Afterfeast of the Ascension, the service is celebrated as prescribed in the Menaion together with the Afterfeast hymns. At the Ninth Ode we chant **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). In the Divine Liturgy, at the Little Entrance: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, Who wast taken up in glory"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἐν δόξῃ ἀναληφθείς*); the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints are read; Communion Hymn: **"Unto all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); and the Dismissal Troparion **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*).

units.slavonic_text: 8.    If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the Wednesday of the Leave-taking of Easter, see the Feast of the Theologian, Paragraphs 10 - 12, for the order of service.
units.english_text: 11.    If the Feast of the Saints occurs on the Sunday of the Holy Fathers, (the service of the Ascension is omitted, and the services of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and of the Fathers are sung as follows:) On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 of the Fathers, and 3 of the Saints. "Glory...": of the Fathers: **"Let us acclaim today the mystical trumpets of the Spirit"** (*Τὰς μυστικὰς σήμερον*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings: 2 of the Fathers and 1 of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Fathers. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saints, and of the Feast [of the Ascension].

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: Month of May: St. Constantine and Helen (May 21); Situation VIII Concl. (§§ 12 Concl.–13), Situation IX Opening (§ 14) (p. 566)]
units.english_text: 12.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀποστολικῶν παραδόσεων, καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Πατέρων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίαν, ἀνὰ ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον, τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, εἰς τὴν γ΄ Στιχολογίαν τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος κανών, ὁ τῶν Πατέρων, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Οἶκος, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῶν Πατέρων Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι. ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Κυριακῆς. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Πατέρων, τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς.

Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, τῶν Πατέρων γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. Δόξα τῶν Πατέρων, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 13.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Ἀντίφωνα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Εἰσοδικόν, Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῆς ἑορτῆς τῶν Πατέρων, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν· Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς· εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ, Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: ...of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": **"Of the apostolic traditions"** (*Ἀποστολικῶν παραδόσεων*), and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Fathers, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. At the first and second Kathisma [Stichologia], one Resurrection Sessional Hymn, one of the Saints, and the Theotokion; and at the third Kathisma [Stichologia], the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and the Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Resurrection Canon, that of the Fathers, and that of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Fathers **"All-shining luminaries"** (*Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Sunday Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Sunday. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*), and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saints, and of the Feast [of the Ascension].

units.slavonic_text: of the Saints, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever, “Of the apostolic traditions,” and the “It is meet”; the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Fathers and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos. At the 1st and 2nd Stasis [Stichologia] the Kathismata of the Resurrection, then that of the Saints followed by the Theotokion; and in the 3rd Stasis, the Kathisma of the Saints and the Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi of the Mode, the Anavathmi and the Prokimenon. The Canon of the Resurrection, that of the Fathers, and that of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Fathers “All-shining luminaries”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers, the Minologion of the Saints, and the Postscript of the Sunday. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud,” and the entire order of the Matins Gospel; then we chant “More honorable.” The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saints and of the Feast. At the Praises: 2 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of the Fathers, and 3 Stichira of the Saints, Glory of the Fathers, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 13.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast, the Entrance Hymn “O come let us worship . . . who is risen from the dead”; after the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Fathers, that of the Saints, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion “When, for us, You had fulfilled Your dispensation.” Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise the Lord,” the Apolytikion “You ascended in glory,” “Blessed be the Name” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 13.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast; Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon]: **"O come, let us worship and fall down before Christ; save us, O Son of God, Who art risen from the dead"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν . . . ὁ ἀναστὰς ἐκ νεκρῶν*). After the Little Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Fathers, that of the Saints, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"When for us Thou hadst fulfilled Thy dispensation"** (*Τὴν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*); the Epistle of the Saints and the Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord from the heavens"** (*Αἰνεῖτε*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); the Dismissal Troparion **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 14.    If the Feast (May 21) occurs on the Saturday of Souls, the service of the Saints is celebrated in anticipation on Friday together with the service of the Ascension as follows: On Thursday evening, after the first Kathisma [Stichologia] of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 6 Idiomela of the Feast and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings of the Saints. The Aposticha of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Saints, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.[^350]

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: Month of May: St. Constantine and Helen (May 21); Situation IX Concl. (§§ 15–16), Situation X Opening (§ 17 Opening) (p. 568)]
units.english_text: 15.    Τῇ Παρασκευῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου ὡς καὶ τὸ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Κύριε τὸ μυστήριον (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου, Πᾶσα Πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν θεοστέπτων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς Κωνσταντίνου ἡ μνήμη (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς· εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, καὶ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ Στίχου Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. units.english_text: 15.    On Friday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Saints, "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"O Lord, Who didst fulfill the mystery"** (*Κύριε τὸ μυστήριον*; look for this in the Litiya); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos of the Saints. The Sessional Hymns of the Saints and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia. The Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"I have raised up one chosen out of My people"** (*Ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου*, Ps. 88:20 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Saints; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the God-crowned ones"** (*Ταῖς τῶν θεοστέπτων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Today the memory of the pious Constantine"** (*Τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς Κωνσταντίνου ἡ μνήμη*; look for this in the Litiya). The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*); then we sing the Ninth Ode of the Feast with its Megalynaria, and that of the Saints with the Verse: **"Holy saint of God"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ*). The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomoia of the Feast and 3 of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints.

units.english_text: 16.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of the Feast [of the Ascension]. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Saints, of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Feast; the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"Thee Who art beyond mind and word"** (*Σὲ τὴν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*); Communion Hymn of the Feast; the Dismissal Troparion **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"Thee Who art beyond mind and word"** (*Σὲ τὴν ὑπὲρ νοῦν*); Communion Hymn of the Feast; the Dismissal Troparion **"Thou hast ascended in glory, O Christ our God"** (*Ἀνελήφθης ἐν δόξῃ*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 15.    On Friday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti and the Glory of the Saints, Now and ever, “O Lord, having fulfilled the mystery” (look for this in the Liti); the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Saints, and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos of the Saints. The Kathismata of the Saints and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia. The Anavathmi, the 1st Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “I have raised a chosen one from among my people.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Matins Gospel of the Saints, Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the God-crowned ones,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the Idiomelon “Today, the memory of the pious Constantine” (look for this in the Liti). The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, and the Minologion. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud”; then we sing the 9th Ode of the Feast with its Megalynaria, and that of the Saints with the Verse “Holy One of God.” The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saints. Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast, Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Saints. 16.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of the Feast [of the Ascension]. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Feast, of the Saints, of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion of the Feast. Apostolos and Gospel of the Saints. At “Especially,” “You who are above the human mind and speech,” Communion Hymn of the Feast, the Apolytikion “You ascended in glory,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord” and Dismissal. On Friday evening and Saturday morning, the Service of the Saturday of the Souls is chanted as prescribed in the Pentikostarion. If the Parish Church is dedicated to Saint Constantine, before the Liturgy, the Apolytikion of the Saints is sung and the Blessing of the Loaves [Artoclasia] is performed with the “The rich became poor,” the Apolytikion “Out of the depths of wisdom,” and the Liturgy as usual.

units.english_text: 18.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· εἰς τὴν α΄ στιχολογίαν Καθίσματα τῆς ἑορτῆς πρῶτον, εἶτα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ αὖθις τῆς ἑορτῆς· εἰς τὴν β΄ καὶ γ΄ λέγομεν ἀνὰ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθόν, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα· Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε, οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς· αἱ Καταβασίαι διπλαῖ, καὶ ἡ θ΄ Ὠδή, τὸ α΄ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Ἁγίου· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.english_text: 18.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. At the first Kathisma [Stichologia]: the Sessional Hymns of the Feast first, then those of the Saints, and again those of the Feast; at the second and third Kathisma [Stichologia], we chant one of the Saints followed by one of the Feast. The Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Thy good Spirit shall lead me into the land of uprightness"** (*Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθόν*, Ps. 142:10 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Feast; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostles"** (*Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Sticheron: **"O Heavenly King, the Comforter"** (*Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε*). The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Feast; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Feast. Both [double] Katavasiai and the Ninth Ode. The Exapostilaria: first of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the other of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomoia of the Feast and 3 of the Saints; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"O Heavenly King, the Comforter"** (*Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast.

units.slavonic_text: “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings: 2 of the Feast and 1 of the Saints. The 3 Aposticha Idiomela of the Feast; Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast. The Apolytikia: of the Feast, of the Saints and again of the Feast and Dismissal 18.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Feast, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos. At the 1st Stasis [Stichologia]: the Kathismata of the Feast, then those of the Saints and again those of the Feast; at the 2nd and 3rd Stasis, we chant one of the Saints followed by one of the Feast; the Anavathmi, the 1st Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “Your good Spirit.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Matins Gospel of the Feast, Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Apostles,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the “Heavenly King.” The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Minologion of the Saints, and the Postscript of the Feast. Both [double] Katavasie and the 9th Ode. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints and the other of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Saints. Glory, Now and ever, “Heavenly King,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast. 19.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of the Feast {of Pentecost}. After the Entrance, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagios Hymn, we chant “As many as have been baptized”; Apostolos and Gospel of the Feast. At “Especially,” “You who without experience of corruption,” Communion Hymn of the Feast “Your good Spirit,” the Apolytikion “Blessed are You, O Christ,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord,” and Dismissal, and immediately the Vespers of the Kneeling [Gonyklisia].
units.english_text: 19.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of the Feast [of Pentecost]. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagion Hymn, we chant **"As many of you as have been baptized into Christ"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστόν*); Epistle and Gospel of the Feast. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], the Heirmos: **"Without experience of corruption"** (*Μὴ τῆς φθορᾶς*); Communion Hymn of the Feast: **"Thy Holy Spirit"** (*Τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ Ἅγιον*, Ps. 142:10 LXX); the Dismissal Troparion **"Blessed art Thou, O Christ our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Χριστέ*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), Dismissal, and immediately the Vespers of Genuflection [Gonyklisia].

units.english_text: 21.    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· τὰ Καθίσματα τῆς α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίας τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἐν τῇ γ΄ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν Χριστέ (ζήτει τῇ Κυριακῇ τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς). Οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν θεοστέπτων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς Κωνσταντίνου ἡ μνήμη. Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς Τὸ Πανάγιον Πνεῦμα· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς Δευτέρας τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος. Αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, καὶ ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα Ἐν τοῖς Προφήταις ἀνήγγειλας, καὶ γ΄ Προσόμοια [τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς], τοῦ Ἁγίου, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου Ὁ τῶν Ἀνάκτων Ἄναξ, Καὶ νῦν, Γλῶσσαί ποτε, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός.

units.english_text: 21.    On Monday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast. The Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns: at the first and second Kathisma [Stichologia], the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Feast; at the third Kathisma [Stichologia], one Sessional Hymn of the Saints followed by **"After Thy resurrection, O Christ"** (*Μετὰ τὴν ἔγερσιν Χριστέ*; see the Sunday of Pentecost). The Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"I have raised up one chosen out of My people"** (*Ὕψωσα ἐκλεκτὸν ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ μου*, Ps. 88:20 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Saints; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the God-crowned ones"** (*Ταῖς τῶν θεοστέπτων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Today the memory of the pious Constantine"** (*Τοῦ εὐσεβοῦς Κωνσταντίνου ἡ μνήμη*). The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Sessional Hymn of the Saints and that of the Feast: **"The All-Holy Spirit"** (*Τὸ Πανάγιον Πνεῦμα*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion of the Saints, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Monday of the Holy Spirit. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*), and the Ninth Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints, and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Idiomela of the Feast: **"In the prophets Thou didst announce"** (*Ἐν τοῖς Προφήταις ἀνήγγειλας*), and 3 Prosomoia of the Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints: **"The King of Kings"** (*Ὁ τῶν Ἀνάκτων Ἄναξ*); "Both now and ever...": **"Tongues in days of old were confounded"** (*Γλῶσσαί ποτε*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Blessed art Thou, O Christ our God"** (*Εὐλογητὸς εἶ Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός*).

units.slavonic_text: Feast; Glory of the Saints, Now and ever, “Come, O you peoples.” The Apolytikia: of the Feast, of the Saints and again of the Feast and Dismissal. 21.    On Monday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Saints, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Feast. The Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast, and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata: at the 1st and 2nd Stasis, the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast; at the 3rd Stasis, one Kathisma of the Saints followed by “After You had risen from the tomb” (see the Sunday of Pentecost). The Anavathmi, the 1st Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “I have raised a chosen one from among my people.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Matins Gospel of the Saints, Psalm 50 (read), Glory, “Through the intercessions of the God-crowned ones,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “O God, have mercy on me” and the Idiomelon “Today, the memory of the pious Constantine.” The Canons of the Feast and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, the Kathisma of the Saints and that of the Feast “The All-holy Spirit”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Minologion of the Saints, and the Postscript of the Monday of the Holy Spirit. The Katavasie “Covered by a divine cloud,” and the 9th Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Saints and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast “In the prophets You announced” and 3 of the Saints. Glory of the Saints “The King of Kings,” Now and ever, “Tongues in days of old,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion “Blessed are You, O Christ our God.” 22.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of the Feast {of Pentecost}. After the Entrance, the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagios Hymn we chant “As many as have been baptized,” Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the day. At “Especially,” “Hail, O Queen,” Communion Hymn of the Feast “Your good Spirit,” “We have seen the [true] light,” “Blessed be the name of the Lord” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 22.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of the Feast [of Pentecost]. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Saints, and the Kontakion of the Feast. Instead of the Trisagion Hymn, we chant **"As many of you as have been baptized into Christ"** (*Ὅσοι εἰς Χριστόν*); the Epistle of the Saints and the Gospel of the day. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], the Heirmos: **"Hail, O Queen"** (*Χαίροις Ἄνασσα*); Communion Hymn of the Feast: **"Thy good Spirit shall lead me"** (*Τὸ Πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθόν*, Ps. 142:10 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), **"Blessed be the name of the Lord"** (*Εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 112:2 LXX), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 24.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν τῇ Ἀποδόσει τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς, ἡ ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς ψάλλεται ἀπαραλλάκτως ὡς ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἡμέρᾳ· ἀλλ’ ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ λέγονται μόνα τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου. Ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ (ὅρα τὴν διάταξιν ἐν τῇ Ἀποδόσει τῆς ἑορτῆς τῆς Ἀναλήψεως § 15, 16), αἱ Καταβασίαι τῆς ἑορτῆς διπλαῖ, ἐν δὲ τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς.

units.english_text: 25.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Κυριακῇ τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου γ΄. Δόξα, Μαρτύρων θεῖος χορός, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον, τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα δύο ἐκ τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου καὶ ἓν τοῦ Ἁγίου. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Ἁγίων Δεῦτε πιστοί, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: ΙΓ΄.
units.english_text: 26.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμὸν ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῶν Ἁγίων, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου Τῇ νῦν πανηγύρει, καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος· Καθίσματα εἰς τὴν α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίαν τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, τὰ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῶν Θεοτοκίων τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου· εἰς τὴν γ΄ τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου αὐτοῦ, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος κανών, ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον

In the Divine Liturgy, the Epistle and Gospel of the Saints, and the Communion Hymn of the Feast.

units.slavonic_text: Entrance, “O come let us worship . . . Save us, O Good Comforter.” At “Especially,” “It is meet,” the Communion Hymn of the Saints {“To all the earth,”} and “We have seen the [true] light,” etc.
units.english_text: 25.    If the Feast [May 21] occurs on the Sunday of All Saints, in Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, 3 Stichira of All Saints, and 3 Prosomoia of the Saints; "Glory...": **"O divine choir of Martyrs"** (*Μαρτύρων θεῖος χορός*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings: 2 from the Pentecostarion and 1 of the Saints. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of All Saints: **"Come, O ye faithful"** (*Δεῦτε πιστοί*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of All Saints, of the Saints, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: SITUATION THIRTEEN
units.english_text: 26.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon [Triadikos Kanon], the Litiya of All Saints; "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Pentecostarion: **"Unto the present festival"** (*Τῇ νῦν πανηγύρει*), and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*). Then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. units.slavonic_text: καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἁγίων Πάντων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου· αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τοῦ Ἁγίου Κωνσταντίνου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς τῆς φύσεως. Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Ἐὰν δὲ ἡ τοῦ Ἁγίου μνήμη τύχῃ ἐν ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἔξω τοῦ Πεντηκοσταρίου, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται ὡς ἐστι διατεταγμένη ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ. units.slavonic_text: 27.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes: 4 of the Mode and 4 of the 6th Ode of the Pentikostarion. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of All-Saints, that of Saint Constantine [and Helen], that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “As the first fruits of nature,” Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Rejoice, O righteous ones, in the Lord,” “We have seen the [true] Light,” and Dismissal. If the Feast of the Saints [May 21] occurs on a day outside the period of the Pentikostarion, the Service is chanted as prescribed in the Mineon. Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” Kontakion “Protection of all Christians” and Communion Hymn “To all the earth.” Note that the Feast of Saint Constantine [and Helen] can occur in the period of the Pentikostarion from the Saturday of the Week of the Paralytic until the Sunday of All-Saints; outside of the Pentikostarion period, on the other hand, until the Thursday after the Sunday of All-Saints. (See the Chart of Celebrations).
units.english_text: Note that the commemoration of Saint Constantine can fall within the Pentecostarion from Saturday of the Week of the Paralytic until the Sunday of All Saints; outside of the Pentecostarion, on the other hand, until Thursday of the first week after the Sunday of All Saints. (See the Calendar Table of Feasts).

provenance.verbatim_source: Note that the commemoration of Saint Constantine can fall within the Pentecostarion from Saturday of the Week of the Paralytic until the Sunday of All Saints; outside of the Pentecostarion, on the other hand, until Thursday of the first week after the Sunday of All Saints. (See the Calendar Table of Feasts).

units.english_text: διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου. Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Προσόμοια τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ Προδρόμου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου. Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς
units.slavonic_text: διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου. Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Προσόμοια τῆς ἑορτῆς γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τοῦ Προδρόμου, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ἡ Λειτουργία, ἐν ᾗ ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἀντίφωνα καὶ τὸ Εἰσοδικὸν τοῦ Πάσχα. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς τοῦ Προδρόμου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Χριστὸς ἀνέστη καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_text: 4.    Εἰ τύχοι τῇ Τετάρτῃ τῆς Ἀποδόσεως τοῦ Πάσχα, τὴν διάταξιν ὅρα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ Θεολόγου § 10-12.

units.english_text: ...order of the Menaion. The Canons of the Feast and of the Forerunner; the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai of the Feast, and the Ninth Ode of the Feast and of the Forerunner. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner, and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomoia of the Feast and 3 of the Forerunner; "Glory...": of the Forerunner; "Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast; and the Divine Liturgy, in which we sing the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn [Eisodikon] of Pascha. After the Little Entrance, we chant the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Feast; the Epistle and Gospel of the Forerunner. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"Virginity is alien to mothers"** (*Ἀλλότριον τῶν μητέρων*); Communion Hymn of the Feast; the Dismissal Troparion **"Christ is risen"** (*Χριστὸς ἀνέστη*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: of the Feast and of the Forerunner, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner and the Minologion. The Katavasie of the Feast and the 9th Ode of the Feast and of the Forerunner. The Exapostilarion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner and again that of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Prosomia of the Feast and 3 of the Forerunner, Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever of the Feast; Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Feast; and the Liturgy, in which we sing the Antiphons and the Entrance Hymn of Easter. After the Entrance, we chant the Apolytikion of the Feast, that of the Forerunner, that of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion of the Feast; Apostolos and Gospel of the Forerunner. At “Especially,” “Virginity is alien to motherhood,” Communion Hymn of the Feast, the Apolytikion “Christ is risen,” and Dismissal.

Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, καὶ καθεξῆς ἡ τάξις τῆς Γονυκλισίας, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα καὶ τὸ Δοξαστικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Προδρόμου, αὖθις τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: ΣΤ΄.
units.english_text: 9.    Τῇ Δευτέρᾳ πρωΐ, εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ Καθίσματα τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ τὰ τῆς ἑορτῆς, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαβίδ, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Προδρόμου, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα τοῦ Προδρόμου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τοῦ Μηναίου). Οἱ Κανόνες τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ Προδρόμου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα Τὸ πανάγιον πνεῦμα, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Μηνολόγιον καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῆς ἑορτῆς, αἱ Καταβασίαι Θείῳ καλυφθείς, καὶ ἡ Θ΄ Ὠδὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τοῦ Προδρόμου καὶ τὸ ἕτερον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα γ΄ καὶ τοῦ Προδρόμου Προσόμοια γ΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Προδρόμου, Εὐαγγέλιον καὶ Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς.
