units.english_text: 8.    If the feast falls on the Sunday of Pentecost, the service of the Forerunner is transferred and celebrated on the Monday of the Holy Spirit as follows: On Sunday at the Vespers of Genuflection [Gonyklisia], after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 3 Idiomela of the Feast: **"Strange marvels were seen today"** (*Παράδοξα σήμερον*), and 3 Prosomoia of the Forerunner; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast: **"O Heavenly King, the Comforter"** (*Βασιλεῦ οὐράνιε*), and the rest of the order of Genuflection [Gonyklisia]. The Aposticha and the Doxastikon of the Feast. The Dismissal Troparia: of the Feast, of the Forerunner, and again that of the Feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: SITUATION SIX
units.english_text: 9.    On Monday morning, at "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; the Psalter reading; the Sessional Hymns of the Saint and those of the Feast; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"There will I bring forth a horn for David"** (*Ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαβίδ*, Ps. 131:17 LXX); then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel of the Forerunner; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of Thy Forerunner"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"The treasury of divine thoughts"** (*Ἡ τῶν θείων ἐννοιῶν*; look for this in the Aposticha of the Menaion). The Canons of the Feast and of the Forerunner. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn of the Feast: **"The All-holy Spirit"** (*Τὸ πανάγιον πνεῦμα*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, the Menologion of the Forerunner, and the Synaxarion [Hypomnema] of the Monday of the Holy Spirit. The Katavasiai: **"Covered by a divine cloud"** (*Θείῳ καλυφθείς*), and the Ninth Ode of the Feast. The Exapostilaria: of the Feast, of the Forerunner, and the other one of the Feast. At the Praises: 3 Idiomela of the Feast and 3 Prosomoia of the Forerunner; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast. In the Divine Liturgy: the Epistle of the Forerunner, and the Gospel and Communion Hymn of the Feast.[^357]

units.english_text: 12.    If the feast falls on a Sunday outside the period of the Pentecostarion, at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner; "Glory...": of the Forerunner; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Forerunner; "Both now and ever...": **"O new wonder"** (*Ὢ θαύματος καινοῦ*; see the Theotokion "Both now and ever" of the Saturday Aposticha of Tone 2). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 10.    If the Feast [May 25] occurs on the days of the Post-feast of the Ascension or Pentecost, the Service is celebrated as prescribed in the Mineon together with the Post-feast hymns of the occurring feast.
units.english_text: 13.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Forerunner, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns and one of the Forerunner with its Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Forerunner. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner, then the Sessional Hymn of the Forerunner with its Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Menologion of the Saint of the day. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner; "Glory...": the Sunday Gospel Sticheron [Eothinon]; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology...[^358]

units.slavonic_text: ΜΗΝ ΙΟΥΝΙΟΣ
units.english_text: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα, ψάλλομεν τὰ Ἰδιόμελα Λύει τοῦ Ζαχαρίου τὴν σιωπὴν εἰς η΄, Δόξα, Σήμερον τοῦ φωτὸς ὁ λύχνος, Καὶ νῦν, Ἡ Ἐλισάβετ συνέλαβε, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Ἠσαΐου νῦν τοῦ προφήτου, Καὶ νῦν, Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Προφῆτα καὶ Πρόδρομε, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. units.slavonic_text: and “Today salvation.” 14.    In the Liturgy, we sing the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Forerunner. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion “Protection of all Christians”; Apostolos of the Forerunner and Gospel of the Sunday, Communion Hymn “Praise,” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal. Note that the 3rd Finding of the Sacred Head of the Forerunner may occur in the period of the Pentikostarion, from the Wednesday of the Leave-taking of Mid-Pentecost until the Sunday of All-Saints, and occasionally until the Monday of the second week after Pentecost. (See the Chart of Celebrations).

units.slavonic_text: MONTH OF JUNE
units.english_text: 1.    At Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the first Kathisma [Stasis] of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing the Idiomela: **"He unties the silence of Zacharias"** (*Λύει τοῦ Ζαχαρίου τὴν σιωπὴν*) to 8; "Glory...": **"Today the lamp of the Light"** (*Σήμερον τοῦ φωτὸς ὁ λύχνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"Elizabeth conceived"** (*Ἡ Ἐλισάβετ συνέλαβε*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Idiomela; "Glory...": **"Of Isaiah the prophet now"** (*Ἠσαΐου νῦν τοῦ προφήτου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Behold Elizabeth"** (*Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"O Prophet and Forerunner"** (*Προφῆτα καὶ Πρόδρομε*), and the Theotokion: **"The mystery hidden from all ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: The 24th The Nativity of the Honorable and Glorious Prophet and Forerunner John the Baptist.
units.english_text: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya, then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion twice and the Theotokion once; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns in order; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; and the Prokeimenon: **"And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Most High"** (*Καὶ σὺ παιδίον προφήτης Ὑψίστου κληθήσῃ*, Lk. 1:76); then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of Thy Forerunner"** (*Ταῖς τοῦ σοῦ Προδρόμου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"He who was sanctified from his mother's womb"** (*Ὁ ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἁγιασθείς*). Both Canons with the Verse: **"Holy saint of God, intercede for us"** (*Ἅγιε τοῦ Θεοῦ, πρέσβευε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν*)...[^359]

units.english_text: ἡμῶν· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Ἀστὴρ ἀστέρων Πρόδρομος, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomoia: **"O, of the strange wonder!"** (*Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος*); "Glory...": **"The Forerunner, the star of stars"** (*Ἀστὴρ ἀστέρων Πρόδρομος*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” then we sing “More honorable”; the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the four Prosomia “O, of the wondrous miracle!” Glory, “The Forerunner, the star of stars,” Now and ever, “O Theotokos, you are the [true] vine,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion.
units.english_text: 4.    If the feast of the Forerunner occurs on a Saturday, on the evening of the same day at Vespers, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner (those of Small Vespers); "Glory...": **"Elizabeth conceived"** (*Ἡ Ἐλισάβετ συνέλαβε*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Look at Elizabeth"** (*Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ*). The Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, that of the Forerunner, the Theotokion, Dismissal, and the Apodosis of the Feast.

units.english_text: 5. Both now and ever...": **"Look at Elizabeth"** (*Βλέπε τὴν Ἐλισάβετ*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν εἰς ς΄, Δόξα, Τῷ τριττῷ τῆς ἐρωτήσεως, Καὶ νῦν, [Ὁ] διὰ σὲ θεοπάτωρ, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἄμπελος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, τὸ Θεοτοκίον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 7.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ β΄ Κανόνος τοῦ Προδρόμου. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τοῦ Προδρόμου, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ Κοντάκιον Προστασία [τῶν Χριστιανῶν]. Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Προδρόμου. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: Forerunner and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Forerunner and the Minologion. The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then, after the “More honorable,” we sing the Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forerunner, Glory of the Forerunner, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_text: 1.    At Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the first Kathisma [Stasis] of the Psalter, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant the 3 Prosomoia: **"With what garlands of praise"** (*Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν*) doubled to 6; "Glory...": **"By His threefold questioning"** (*Τῷ τριττῷ τῆς ἐρωτήσεως*); "Both now and ever...": **"David, the ancestor of God"** (*Ὁ διὰ σὲ θεοπάτωρ*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela; "Glory...": **"A joyful feast"** (*Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"First in prominence among the Apostles"** (*Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι*), the Theotokion: **"The mystery hidden from all ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 7.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the 4 hymns of the Beatitudes of the Mode, and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Second Canon of the Forerunner. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Forerunner, of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Protector [of all Christians,”] Apostolos and Gospel of the Forerunner. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “In [eternal] memorial,” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya, then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion twice and the Theotokion once; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns in order; the Anavathmoi: the first Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostles"** (*Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"O Peter, pinnacle of the Apostles"** (*Πέτρε κορυφαῖε*; look for this in the Litiya). Both Canons. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe: **"What prison held thee not"** (*Ποία φυλακή*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ...*)[^361]

units.english_text: 4.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἀποστόλων ς΄, Δόξα τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα τῶν Ἀποστόλων. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος, Καὶ νῦν, Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἀποστόλων, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ, εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ψάλλεται ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα, ἓν Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ ἓν τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· ἐν δὲ τῇ γ΄ Στιχολογίᾳ τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, ὁ ἀναστάσιμος Κανὼν καὶ οἱ δύο τῶν Ἀποστόλων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος, (εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου)· {Οἱ ὕμνοι ἐντὸς παρενθέσεως δὲν ψάλλονται ἐδῶ ἀλλὰ μόνον ἡ Ὑπακοὴ - μία παράβλεψις τοῦ Βιολάκη}· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἀποστόλων δ΄· Δόξα, Ἡ πάνσεπτος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: 4. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Lessons of the Apostles. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": **"A joyful feast"** (*Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"My Creator and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*). units.slavonic_text: 3.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes, 4 hymns from the 3rd Ode of the First Canon and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Second Canon. After the Entrance, the Apolytikion “First in prominence among the Apostles,” that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Protector of all Christians,” Apostolos and Gospel of the Apostles. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “To all the earth,” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon is chanted, the Litiya of the Apostles, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Apostles, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns: one of the Resurrection and one of the Apostles with the Theotokion; and in the third Stasis [Stichologia], that of the Apostles and the Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: that of the Resurrection and both Canons of the Apostles. After Ode 3, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (then the Sessional Hymn of the Apostles with the Theotokion) {the hymns in parentheses are not chanted here, but only the Hypakoe—an editorial oversight of Violakis}; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostles, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Apostles with the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Apostles; "Glory...": **"The all-venerable celebration of the Apostles"** (*Ἡ πάνσεπτος τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).[^362]

After Ode 3, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos (then the Sessional Hymn of the Apostles with the Theotokion) {the hymns in parentheses are not chanted here, but only the Hypakoe—an editorial oversight of Violakis}; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostles, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). units.english_text: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλονται τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν [εἰς ς΄] καὶ γ΄ Προσόμοια τῶν ΙΒ΄ Ἔδωκας καυχήματα. Δόξα, Ἡ πάνσεπτος, τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ τῶν Αἴνων Ὁ οὐρανόθεν τὴν χάριν, Δόξα, Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ὡς τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, Δόξα, Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι, Καὶ νῦν, Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικόν, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμός, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ δύο τῆς α΄ καὶ β΄ Στιχολογίας Καθίσματα τῶν Ἀποστόλων μετὰ τῶν Θεοτοκίων, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα καὶ οἱ δύο Κανόνες· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἀποστόλων καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν ΙΒ΄, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ δ΄ Προσόμοια Ἡ κορυφαία κρηπὶς τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Δόξα, Ἣν διήλθετε κτίσιν φωτίσαντες, Καὶ νῦν, Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι.

units.english_text: 1.    At Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant the 3 Idiomela: **"With what garlands of praise"** (*Ποίοις εὐφημιῶν*, doubled to 6) and 3 Prosomoia of the Twelve Apostles: **"Thou hast given as boasts to Thy Church"** (*Ἔδωκας καυχήματα*); "Glory...": **"The all-venerable celebration of the Apostles"** (*Ἡ πάνσεπτος τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Both now and ever...": **"Who would not call Thee blessed"** (*Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the 3 Stichira of the Praises: **"The grace from Heaven"** (*Ὁ οὐρανόθεν τὴν χάριν*); "Glory...": **"A joyful feast"** (*Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the vine"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"As the first in prominence among the Apostles"** (*Ὡς τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι*); "Glory...": **"O Holy Apostles"** (*Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι*); "Both now and ever...": **"Thou who didst intercede for us"** (*Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν*), and Dismissal.

The Dismissal Troparion: **"As the first in prominence among the Apostles"** (*Ὡς τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι*); "Glory...": **"O Holy Apostles"** (*Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι*); "Both now and ever...": **"Thou who didst intercede for us"** (*Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 6.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Second Canon of the Apostles. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Apostles, of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Protector of all Christians,” Apostolos and Gospel of the Apostles. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “To all the earth,” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 2.    At Matins, after the Midnight Office [Mesonyktikon], Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"O Holy Apostles"** (*Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι*), and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading; the Sessional Hymns of the first and second Stasis [Kathismata] of the Apostles with their Theotokia; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly, and the two Canons. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn with its Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostles, and the Menologion of the Twelve Apostles. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); the Exapostilarion and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the 4 Prosomoia: **"The chief foundation of the Apostles"** (*Ἡ κορυφαία κρηπὶς τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Glory...": **"Illuminating creation which you traversed"** (*Ἣν διήλθετε κτίσιν φωτίσαντες*); "Both now and ever...": **"Sovereign Lady, accept"** (*Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion: **"O Holy Apostles"** (*Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι*).

units.english_text: 4.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄ Ἔδωκας καυχήματα, Δόξα, Ἡ πάνσεπτος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος, Καὶ νῦν, Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν ΙΒ΄. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_text: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ, εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν ΙΒ΄ καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, ὁ ἀναστάσιμος Κανὼν καὶ ὁ τῶν ιβ΄ Ἀποστόλων· ἀπὸ γ΄, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἀποστόλων, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν ΙΒ΄, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τῶν Ἀποστόλων, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἀποστόλων δ΄, Δόξα, Ἣν διήλθετε κτίσιν φωτίσαντες, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: 4.    If the feast of the Apostles occurs on a Sunday, at Vespers on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 6 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saints: **"Thou hast given as boasts to Thy Church"** (*Ἔδωκας καυχήματα*); "Glory...": **"The all-venerable celebration of the Apostles"** (*Ἡ πάνσεπτος τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": **"A joyful feast"** (*Ἑορτὴ χαρμόσυνος*); "Both now and ever...": **"My Creator and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, the Dismissal Troparion **"O Holy Apostles"** (*Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι*), the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: {which appears to have been omitted in error}. Apostolos and Gospel of the 12 Apostles. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “To all the earth,” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Twelve Apostles, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order, the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Twelve Apostles. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Apostles, then the Sessional Hymn of the Apostles and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the Twelve Apostles. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Apostles, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Apostles; "Glory...": **"Illuminating creation which you traversed"** (*Ἣν διήλθετε κτίσιν φωτίσαντες*); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: 4.    If the Feast of the Apostles occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saints, “You gave as the boastings of your church,” Glory, “The revered celebration of the Apostles,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, “A joyful feast,” Now and ever, “My creator and savior.” The Apolytikion of the Resurrection, the Apolytikion “O Holy Apostles,” the Theotokion, and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and the 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Second Canon of the Apostles. After the Little Entrance, the Resurrection Dismissal Troparion, the Dismissal Troparion **"O Holy Apostles"** (*Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι*), that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*). Epistle and Gospel of the Twelve Apostles. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth"** (*Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν*, Ps. 18:5 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τῶν Ἁγίων ἐν πάσῃ ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου. Εἰ τύχοι ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα, ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄· Δόξα τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου· Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά· Δόξα τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν, Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἁγίων, τὸ Θεοτοκίον, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_text: 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον· Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ ὁ τῶν Ἁγίων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Ἁγίων, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Ἁγίων, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων δ΄. Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    If the commemoration of the Saints occurs on any day except Sunday, the Service is sung according to the order of the Mineon. At the Glory of the Aposticha, Now and ever, “O Theotokos, you are the [true] vine . . . with the Unmercenaries.” 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saints. Glory of the Saints, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saints, Now and ever, “My creator and savior.” The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, the Theotokion, and Dismissal. 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet,”: then the Trisagion, the Ypakoi of the Mode and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and the Theotokion, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Saints. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Kathisma of the Saints and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Saints. The Katavasia “I shall open my mouth” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrec- tion, of the Saints and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saints, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 4.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Saints. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Protection of all Christians”; Apostolos of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Hypakoe of the Tone, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and the Theotokion; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns, the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Saints. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saints, then the Sessional Hymn and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the Saints. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saints; "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: The 2nd    The Deposition of the Honorable Robe of theTheotokos, at Vlacherne.
units.english_text: 4.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saints. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saints, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*); Epistle of the Saints and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν
units.slavonic_text: Κυριακῆς, ἡ Ἀκολουθία ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν, ἐν δὲ τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ Ψαλτήριον οὐ στιχολογεῖται. 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου δ΄· Δόξα, Φρένα καθάραντες καὶ νοῦν, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου· Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά· Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὡς στέφανον ὑπέρλαμπρον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ Θεοτόκε Ἀειπάρθενε, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.
units.english_text: 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Θεοτόκε ἀειπάρθενε, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, Καθίσματα, Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου Τῆς σεπτῆς ἐσθῆτός σου, καὶ αὖθις Καθίσματα Ἀναστάσιμα β΄, καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου Ἑορτάζει σήμερον, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον· Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ ὁ τῆς Θεοτόκου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα Οἱ τῶν θαυμάτων ποταμοί· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τὸ τῆς Θεοτόκου. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄, καὶ τῆς Θεοτόκου δ΄. Δόξα, τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_text: Sunday, the Service is sung according to the order of the Mineon; in Vespers the Psalter is not read. 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Theotokos. Glory of the Theotokos “Cleansing the thoughts and the mind,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever, “As a shining crown” The Apolytikion of the Resurrection, that of the Theotokos “O ever-virgin Theotokos,” and Dismissal. 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, “O ever-virgin Theotokos,” and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikion of the Resurrection (twice), and that of the Theotokos (once) then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Kathismata: 2 of the Resurrection and that of the Theotokos “Of your venerable robe”; and again 2 of the Resurrection and that of the Theotokos “Today, the world celebrates.” The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Theotokos. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, then the Kathisma “The rivers of miracles”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Theotokos. The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrec- tion and of the Theotokos. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Theotokos, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 4. In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Theotokos. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Theotokos, of the Saint of the Church, and Kontakion “A vesture to all the faithful” (this is from the Sixth Ode of the Canon). Apostolos of the Theotokos (see November 21) and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, **"O Ever-Virgin Theotokos"** (*Θεοτόκε ἀειπάρθενε*), and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection twice, and that of the Theotokos once; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Sessional Hymns: 2 of the Resurrection and that of the Theotokos: **"Of Thy venerable robe"** (*Τῆς σεπτῆς ἐσθῆτός σου*); and again 2 of the Resurrection and that of the Theotokos: **"Today the world celebrates"** (*Ἑορτάζει σήμερον*). The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Theotokos. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, then the Sessional Hymn: **"The rivers of miracles"** (*Οἱ τῶν θαυμάτων ποταμοί*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Menologion of the Theotokos. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and of the Theotokos. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Theotokos; "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: Τῇ Ζ΄.    Τῆς ἁγίας Μάρτυρος Κυριακῆς.
units.english_text: 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄· Δόξα τῆς Ἁγίας, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου· Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά· Δόξα τῆς Ἁγίας, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτοκίον ἐκ τῆς Ὀκτωήχου, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῆς Ἁγίας, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

provenance.verbatim_source: 2. units.english_text: 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, τὸ Τρισάγιον, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον· Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ Θεοτοκίον, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄ (τὰ τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ). Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον Σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    If the commemoration of the Saint occurs on any day except Sunday, her Service, together with that of the Righteous Thomas of Malea, is sung according to the order of the Mineon. 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saint. Glory of the Saint, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever the Theotokion from the Oktoichos. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dis- missal. 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Ypakoi of the Mode and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and the Theotokion, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion; the Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint (those of Vespers), Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 4.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode {and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Saint.} After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, of the Saint of the Church, and Kontakion “Protection of all Christians,” Apostolos of the Saint and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet.” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Hypakoe of the Tone, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and the Theotokion; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns, the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn of the Saint and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint (those of Vespers); "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: [Original Greek Text: Month of July: Holy Great-Martyr Euphemia (July 11); Heading, §§ 1–3, Patriarchal Note (p. 602)]
units.english_text: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν Α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ ἕξ Προσόμοια τῆς Ἁγίας ὡς καὶ τὸ Δόξα [τῆς Ἁγίας], Καὶ νῦν, Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα (ζήτει Ἰουλίου ΚΖ΄). Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια καὶ τὸ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος . . . μετὰ τῆς ἀθληφόρου, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Λίαν εὔφρανας, Καὶ νῦν, Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τοῦ Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον, καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὑπομένων ὑπέμεινα τὸν Κύριον καὶ προσέσχε μοι, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα· Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς ἀθληφόρου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Σωτῆρος, ὁ Κανὼν τῆς Θεοτόκου Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον Οὐ σιωπήσομεν· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Πᾶσα γλῶσσα κινείσθω, Καὶ νῦν, Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον.

units.slavonic_text: Τῇ ΙΑ΄.    Τῆς ἁγίας Μεγαλομάρτυρος καὶ πανευφήμου Εὐφημίας.
units.english_text: 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς Ἁγίας. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἁγίας, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν, Ἀπόστολος Ἀδελφοὶ συνεργοῦντες παρακαλοῦμεν (ζήτει Κυριακῇ ΙΣΤ΄), καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον Τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ, ἠρώτα τις τῶν Φαρισαίων (ζήτει τῇ β΄ τῆς Δ΄ ἑβδομάδος τοῦ Λουκᾶ). Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν Α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ ἕξ Προσόμοια τῆς Ἁγίας ὡς καὶ τὸ Δόξα [τῆς Ἁγίας], Καὶ νῦν, Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα (ζήτει Ἰουλίου ΚΖ΄). Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια καὶ τὸ Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος . . . μετὰ τῆς ἀθληφόρου, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Λίαν εὔφρανας, Καὶ νῦν, Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τοῦ Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον, καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ Ἀντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Ὑπομένων ὑπέμεινα τὸν Κύριον καὶ προσέσχε μοι, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα· Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς ἀθληφόρου, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Σωτῆρος, ὁ Κανὼν τῆς Θεοτόκου Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον Οὐ σιωπήσομεν· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Πᾶσα γλῶσσα κινείσθω, Καὶ νῦν, Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον. 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῆς Ἁγίας. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἁγίας, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν, Ἀπόστολος Ἀδελφοὶ συνεργοῦντες παρακαλοῦμεν (ζήτει Κυριακῇ ΙΣΤ΄), καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον Τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ, ἠρώτα τις τῶν Φαρισαίων (ζήτει τῇ β΄ τῆς Δ΄ ἑβδομάδος τοῦ Λουκᾶ). Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Αὕτη ἡ τάξις τελεῖται ἐν τῇ Μεγάλῃ Ἐκκλησίᾳ, ἔνθα κεῖται τὸ ἱερὸν τῆς ἁγίας λείψανον ἐν τῷ Παρεκκλησίῳ τῆς Παμμακαρίστου.

units.english_text: 1.    In Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the First Stasis of the Psalter [Kathisma 1, Pss. 1–8 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant the 6 Prosomoia Stichira and the "Glory..." {of the Saint}; "Both now and ever...": **"Who would not call Thee blessed"** (*Τίς μὴ μακαρίσει σε*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings (these are found on July 27). At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomoia Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the vine... with the prize-bearer"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος . . . μετὰ τῆς ἀθληφόρου*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Thou didst greatly gladden"** (*Λίαν εὔφρανας*); "Both now and ever...": **"Thou who didst intercede for us"** (*Σὲ τὴν μεσιτεύσασαν*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion twice and the Theotokion once; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Sessional Hymns in order; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"I waited patiently for the Lord, and He inclined unto me"** (*Ὑπομένων ὑπέμεινα τὸν Κύριον καὶ προσέσχε μοι*, Ps. 39:2 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel; Psalm 50 [LXX] read plainly; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the prize-bearer"** (*Ταῖς τῆς ἀθληφόρου*); "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Standing at the right hand of the Savior"** (*Ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Σωτῆρος*). The Canon of the Theotokos: **"Traversing the deep water"** (*Ὑγρὰν διοδεύσας*) and that of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Sessional Hymn of the Saint and the Theotokion: **"We shall not be silent"** (*Οὐ σιωπήσομεν*); after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*); then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilarion of the Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the 3 Prosomoia Stichira of the Saint in 4 [repeating the first one]; "Glory...": **"Let every tongue be stirred"** (*Πᾶσα γλῶσσα κινείσθω*); "Both now and ever...": **"Sovereign Lady, accept"** (*Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

units.english_text: 3.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes from the Third and Sixth Odes of the Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Saint, of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*). Epistle of the Saint: **"Brethren, working together with Him, we entreat you"** (*Ἀδελφοί, συνεργοῦντες παρακαλοῦμεν*, 2 Cor. 6:1; see the 16th Sunday), and the Gospel of the Saint: **"At that time, one of the Pharisees asked Him"** (*Τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ, ἠρώτα τις τῶν Φαρισαίων*, Luke 7:36; see Tuesday of the 4th Week of Luke). At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be"** (*Εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον*, Ps. 111:6 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    In Vespers after the Introductory Psalm and the First Stasis of the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing the 6 Stichira and well as the Glory {of the Saint}, Now and ever, “Who cannot but bless you.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon, and the Readings (these are found on the 27th of the month). At the Aposticha: the 3 Prosomia Stichira and the Glory, Now and ever, “Theotokos, you are the [true] vine . . . with the Champion,” the Apolytikion “You delighted much.” Now and ever, “You, the intercessor,” and Dismissal. 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Saint and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikion (twice) and the Theotokion, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Kathismata in order, the Anavathmi, the First Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “I waited patiently for the Lord.” Then “Let everything that breathes,” and the Gospel, the Psalm 50 read; Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Champion,” Now and Ever, “Through the interces- sions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “Have mercy on me, O God” and the Idiomelon “Standing at the right of the Savior.” The Canon of the Theotokos “Traversing the waters” and that of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion “We shall not be silent”; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Minologion; the Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” then we sing “More honorable.” The Exapostilarion of the Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: the 3 Stichira of the Saint in 4, [repeating the first one] Glory, “Every tongue is moved,” Now and ever, “Lady, accept,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion. 3.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes of the 3rd and 6th Ode of the Canon of the Saint. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Saint, of the Saint of the Church, and Kontakion “Protection of all Christians.” Apostolos of the Saint “Brethren, working together, we plead” (see the 16th Sunday), and the Gospel of the Saint “At that time one of the Pharisees asked” (see Tuesday of the 4th Week of Luke). At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “In eternal memorial,” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal. This is the order celebrated at the Great Church, where the Holy Relics of the Saint are kept in the Chapel of the All-blessed.

units.english_text: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον, καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὸ τῆς γ΄ στιχολογίας Κάθισμα τῆς Ἁγίας μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοὴ τοῦ ἤχου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα τῆς Ἁγίας μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τὸ τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄. Δόξα τῆς Ἁγίας (μόνον ἐν τῷ πατριαρχικῷ ναῷ) (ἐννοεῖται ὅτι εἰς ἄλλα μέρη ψάλλεται τὸ Ἑωθινόν. Ὅταν ἡ 11η Ἰουλίου ἔπεσε τὸ 1993 εἰς Κυριακήν, ἡ τάξις τοῦ Πατριαρχείου ὑπέδειξε τὸ Ἑωθινόν). Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: 4.    If the feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon, and the Old Testament Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": **"My Creator and Redeemer"** (*Ὁ ποιητὴς καὶ λυτρωτής μου*). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon, the Litiya of the Saint, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as in Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns and the Sessional Hymn of the Saint with its Theotokion after the third Stasis [Stichologia]. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe of the Tone, the Anavathmoi, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saint with the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint; "Glory...": of the Saint (only in the Patriarchal Church; elsewhere the Eothinon Doxastikon is chanted instead. When July 11 fell on a Sunday in 1993, the Patriarchal typikon rubric indicated the Eothinon Doxastikon); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: 4.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saint. Glory of the Saint, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, “My creator and savior.” The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, the Theotokion, and Dismissal. 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Saint, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Saint and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Kathismata and the Third Stasis [Stichologia] of the Saint with its Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, and the Minologion. The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint, Glory of the Saint (only in the Church of the Patriarchate). {This means that elsewhere the Eothinon is done instead. When the 11th of July fell on a Sunday in 1993, the order of service of the Patriarchate indicated the Eothinon}. Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_text: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Saint. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*). Epistle of the Saint and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 2.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Πατέρων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον, καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῶν Πατέρων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῶν Πατέρων, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Πατέρων καὶ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Πατέρων δ΄. Δόξα, Τῶν Ἁγίων Πατέρων ὁ Χορός, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_incipit: εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ
units.slavonic_text: εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ἓξ καὶ τῶν Πατέρων δ΄. Δόξα, Τὰς μυστικὰς σήμερον, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου· Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα· Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά· Δόξα, τῶν Πατέρων, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀσπόρως ἐκ θείου Πνεύματος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τὸ τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 2.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Πατέρων καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον, καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τῶν Πατέρων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον καὶ ὁ Οἶκος, εἶτα τὸ Κάθισμα Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι καὶ τὸ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Πατέρων, τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸ Ὑπόμνημα τῶν Πατέρων, αἱ Καταβασίαι Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου. Εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Πατέρων καὶ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῶν Πατέρων δ΄. Δόξα, Τῶν Ἁγίων Πατέρων ὁ Χορός, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 3.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τῶν Πατέρων. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τῶν Πατέρων, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Πατέρων. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν. Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ Ἀπόλυσις.

units.english_text: 2.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Fathers, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as in Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order, the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Fathers. After Ode 3, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos are read, then the Sessional Hymn of the Fathers: **"Most radiant beacons"** (*Φωστῆρες ὑπέρλαμπροι*), and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers, the Menologion of the day, and the Synaxarion Note of the Fathers. The Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Fathers; "Glory...": **"The choir of the Holy Fathers"** (*Τῶν Ἁγίων Πατέρων ὁ Χορός*); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Fathers, Glory, “Let us extol today those mystical trumpets,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrec- tion Stichira, Glory of the Fathers, Now and ever, “Without seed, by the divine Spirit.” The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, the Theotokion and Dismissal. 2.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Fathers and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia, as in Vespers, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Fathers. After the 3rd Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos read, then the Kathisma of the Fathers “Greatly shining luminaries,” and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers, the Minologion of the day and the Postscript of the Fathers. The Katavasie “I shall open my mouth,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Fathers, Glory, “The chorus of the Holy Fathers,” Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 3.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Fathers. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Fathers, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Protection of all Christians.” Apostolos and Gospel of the Fathers. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 3.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Fathers. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν Χριστιανῶν*). Epistle and Gospel of the Fathers. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: The 17th    The Holy Great Martyr Marina.
units.english_text: 1.    If the commemoration of the Martyr occurs on any other day except Sunday, the service is chanted according to the order in the Menaion; at the "Glory..." of the Aposticha: "Both now and ever...": **"O Theotokos, Thou art the true vine... with the prize-bearer"** (*Θεοτόκε σὺ εἶ ἡ ἄμπελος . . . μετὰ τῆς ἀθληφόρου*).

units.english_text: τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, Δόξα τῆς Ἁγίας, Καὶ νῦν τῶν Πατέρων, Ἀπολυτίκια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Πατέρων, τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Τριαδικὸν κανόνα, ψάλλεται καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς Ἁγίας. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, τῶν Πατέρων καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος Ἀναστάσιμα, εἶτα Κάθισμα τῶν Πατέρων, τῆς Ἁγίας, καὶ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῶν Πατέρων, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Πατέρων, τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, τῶν Πατέρων, τῆς Ἁγίας καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῶν Πατέρων καὶ Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε.

units.english_text: ...the Aposticha: "Glory...": of the Saint; "Both now and ever...": of the Fathers. The Dismissal Troparia: that of the Resurrection, that of the Fathers, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion. On Sunday at Matins, after the Trinity Canon, the Litiya of the Saint is also chanted. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as in Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns, the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, and of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, then the Sessional Hymn of the Fathers, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers. The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saint, and the Theotokion. In the Divine Liturgy, after the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saint, and that of the Patron Saint of the Church; Epistle and Gospel of the Fathers, and Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX).

The Resurrection Sessional Hymns, the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, and of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, then the Sessional Hymn of the Fathers, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers. The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saint, and the Theotokion. In the Divine Liturgy, after the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saint, and that of the Patron Saint of the Church; Epistle and Gospel of the Fathers, and Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX).

units.slavonic_text: At the Aposticha: Glory of the Saint, Now and ever of the Fathers. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saint, and the Theotokion. On Sunday at Matins, after the Triadic Canon, we sing the Liti of the Saint. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia, as in Vespers, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection, that of the Fathers, and that of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, then the Kathisma of the Fathers, that of the Saint, and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Fathers. Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saint and the Theotokion. In the Liturgy, after the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Fathers, of the Saint, of the Saint of the Church; Apostolos and Gospel of the Fathers and Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord].”

Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τῆς Ἁγίας δ΄, Δόξα τῆς Ἁγίας, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, Τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. units.slavonic_incipit: τῶν Ἀποστίχων, Καὶ νῦν, Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι.
units.slavonic_text: τῶν Ἀποστίχων, Καὶ νῦν, Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι. Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, Καταβασίαι Χοροὶ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ Κοντάκιον εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους μετεμορφώθης, Κοινωνικὸν Εἰς μνημόσυνον 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον καὶ τὰ Ἀναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα τοῦ Ἁγίου, Καὶ νῦν, Ἀνύμφευτε Παρθένε, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου, τὸ Θεοτοκίον καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ Ἀπολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ τὸ τελευταῖον τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τοῦ Θεοτοκίου, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Ἁγίου· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τοῦ Ἁγίου· εἶτα Κάθισμα τοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ Θεοτοκίον· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χοροὶ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Θεοτοκίον. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου δ΄, Δόξα, τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 4.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ δ΄ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ Ἁγίου. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον, τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Κοντάκιον Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους μετεμορφώθης, Ἀπόστολος τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς καὶ Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε.
units.english_text: 3.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς Κανών, ἡ Λιτὴ τοῦ Ἁγίου, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. units.slavonic_text: Ἐὰν ἡ ΛΑ΄ Ἰουλίου τύχῃ ἐν Κυριακῇ, ἡ Προεόρτιος τῆς Προόδου τοῦ Σταυροῦ Ἀκολουθία καταλιμπάνεται, μὴ ὑπάρχοντος ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ Κανόνος προεορτίου, καὶ τοῦτο ἐν τοῖς ἱεροῖς Ναοῖς τῶν πόλεων. Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἱεραῖς Μοναῖς ἐξακολουθήτωσαν αἱ Τυπικαὶ αὐτῶν ἀρχαῖαι διατάξεις.

units.english_text: ...Doxastikon of the Aposticha: "Both now and ever...": **"Sovereign Lady, accept"** (*Δέσποινα πρόσδεξαι*). units.slavonic_text: Glory of the Aposticha, Now and ever, “Lady, accept.” In Matins, the Katavasie “The choruses of Israel,” and Kontakion in the Liturgy “You were transfigured upon the mountain,” Communion Hymn “In eternal memorial.” 2.    If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, in Vespers on Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Saint. Glory of the Saint, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the Resurrec- tion Stichira, Glory of the Saint, Now and ever, “Unwedded Virgin.” The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, the Theotokion and Dismissal. 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, the Liti of the Saint, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Saint and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord” the Apolytikia as in Vespers; then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and the last Kathisma of the Saint with the Theotokion, the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Saint. After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, then the Kathisma of the Saint and the Theotokion; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Saint. The Katavasie “The choruses of Israel,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honor- able.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saint and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.”
units.english_text: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon, the Litiya of the Saint, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as in Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order, and the last Sessional Hymn of the Saint with its Theotokion. The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Saint. After Ode 3, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Saint, then the Sessional Hymn of the Saint and the Theotokion; after Ode 6, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion. The Katavasiai: **"The choirs of Israel"** (*Χοροὶ Ἰσραήλ*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection, of the Saint, and the Theotokion. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Saint; "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τοῦ Σταυροῦ Προσόμοια γ΄ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων γ΄, Δόξα, Οἱ ἅγιοι Μακκαβαῖοι, Καὶ νῦν, Ὅνπερ πάλαι Μωϋσῆς, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας, τὰ Ἀπόστιχα τοῦ Σταυροῦ, ὧν οἱ Στίχοι Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν . . . καὶ Ὁ δὲ θεὸς Βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν . . . . Δόξα τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν τοῦ Σταυροῦ, Ἀπολυτίκιον Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν Ἁγίων, Σῶσον Κύριε τὸν λαόν σου ἅπαξ, καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ἑξάψαλμον, εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων δίς, καὶ τοῦ Σταυροῦ ἅπαξ, τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ Καθίσματα, οἱ Κανόνες τοῦ Σταυροῦ καὶ τῶν Ἁγίων κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῷ Μηναίῳ διάταξιν, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, καὶ ἡ Καταβασία Μυστικὸς εἶ θεοτόκε παράδεισος, Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῶν Ἁγίων καὶ τοῦ Σταυροῦ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Δόξα τῶν Ἁγίων, Καὶ νῦν τοῦ Σταυροῦ, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τῶν Ἁγίων. Σημ. Τὸ Ἱεροσολυμιτικὸν Τυπικὸν διατάττει καὶ κατ᾿ αὐτὴν τὴν ἡμέραν μετὰ τὴν Δοξολογίαν νὰ τελῆται ἡ Πρόοδος τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ κατὰ τὴν τάξιν τῆς γ΄ Κυριακῆς τῶν Νηστειῶν. Ἐὰν γίνηται Πρόοδος τοῦ Σταυροῦ, λέγεται ἀντὶ τοῦ Τρισαγίου Τὸν Σταυρόν σου.

units.slavonic_text: [English Facing Translation: Month of August: The Seven Holy Maccabees and the Procession of the Cross (August 1, Heading, §§ 1–3, § 4 Opening) (p. 617)]
units.english_text: 1.    At Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 3 Prosomoia Stichira of the Cross and 3 of the Saints; "Glory...": **"The Holy Maccabees"** (*Οἱ ἅγιοι Μακκαβαῖοι*); "Both now and ever...": **"Whom Moses prefigured of old"** (*Ὅνπερ πάλαι Μωϋσῆς*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the Stichira of the Cross, with the Verses: **"Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool, for He is holy"** (*Ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν...*, Ps. 98:5 LXX), and **"God is our King before the ages; He hath wrought salvation in the midst of the earth"** (*Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς Βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν...*, Ps. 73:12 LXX); "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Cross. Dismissal Troparia: **"The sufferings of the Saints"** (*Τὰς ἀλγηδόνας τῶν Ἁγίων*), and **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον Κύριε τὸν λαόν σου*) once, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 2.    At Matins, after the Six Psalms, at "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints twice, and that of the Cross once; then the Psalter reading and the Sessional Hymns. The Canons of the Cross and of the Saints according to the order in the Menaion. Katavasiai: **"Inscribing the Cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*); then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), and the Katavasia: **"Thou art a mystical paradise, O Theotokos"** (*Μυστικὸς εἶ Θεοτόκε παράδεισος*). Exaposteilaria of the Saints and of the Cross. At the Praises: "Glory...": of the Saints; "Both now and ever...": of the Cross; Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints.
