units.slavonic_text: The 1st        The Seven Holy Maccabees and the Procession of the Honorable and Life-creating Cross.
units.english_text: 3.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes, with Troparia from the Third Ode of the First Canon and from the Sixth Ode of the Second Canon. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον Κύριε*), of the Saints, of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross"** (*Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ*). Epistle: **"Brethren, all the Saints"** (*Οἱ Ἅγιοι Πάντες*, see Sunday of All Saints, Heb. 11:33–12:2 LXX), and Gospel (see September 15, Matt. 10:16–22). At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"The light of Thy countenance is signed upon us, O Lord"** (*Ἐσημειώθη ἐφ᾿ ἡμᾶς τὸ φῶς τοῦ προσώπου σου, Κύριε*, Ps. 4:7 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    In Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm, at “Lord, I have cried” we chant 3 Prosomia {Stichira} of the Cross and 3 of the Saints. Glory, “The Holy Maccabees,” Now and ever, “Whom Moses long ago.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon of the day. The Aposticha of the Cross with the Verses “Exalt the Lord our God” and “God is our King,” Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Cross. Apolytikia: “The sufferings of Your Saints,” “O Lord, save Your people” (once), and Dismissal. 2.    In Matins, after the Exapsalmos, at “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikion of the Saints (twice) and that of the Cross (once) then the Psalter. The Kathismata, the Canons of the Cross and of the Saints, according to the order of service in the Mineon. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” then “More honorable” and the Katavasia “O Theotokos, you are a mystical paradise.” Exapostilaria of the Saints and of the Cross. At the Praises: Glory of the Saints, Now and ever of the Cross. Great Doxology and the Apolytikion of the Saints. Note: The Jerusalem Typikon {also} directs that on this day, following the Doxology, the Procession of the Holy Cross should be performed according to the order of service of the Third Sunday of Lent. If the Procession is done, then, instead of the Trisagios Hymn, we sing “Your Cross [we venerate].” 3.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and the Beatitudes, Hymns from the 3rd Ode of the First Canon and Hymns from the 6th Ode of the Second Canon. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: “Save, O Lord, [Your people],” of the Saints, of the Saint of the Church and the Kontakion “Lifted up on the Cross.” Apostolos “Brethren, all the Saints” [See Sunday of All-Saints, Hebrews 11:33 - 12:2] and Gospel (see September 15, {Matthew 10:16- 22}}). At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “[The light of Your countenance was} marked on us,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal. 4. units.english_text: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον Σῶσον Κύριε τὸν λαόν σου καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἀπολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὰ τοῦ Σταυροῦ ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, καὶ ἀντὶ Θεοτοκίων τὰ τοῦ Σταυροῦ, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ τοῦ Σταυροῦ, οὗ ὁ Στίχος Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν δόξα σοι· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ Κοντάκιον Ὁ Ὑψωθείς, καὶ τὸ Κάθισμα Ὁ Σταυρός σου Κύριε ἡγίασται ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ τὸ τοῦ Σταυροῦ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τοῦ Σταυροῦ δ΄. Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: ...**"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 6 Stichira of the Resurrection and 4 of the Cross (the service of the Saints is chanted at Compline); "Glory...": of the Cross; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Cross. Dismissal Troparia: that of the Resurrection, that of the Cross once, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion **"Save, O Lord, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον Κύριε τὸν λαόν σου*), and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection twice, and that of the Cross once; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order, and the Sessional Hymns of the Cross in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Cross, whose refrain verse is: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν δόξα σοι*). After Ode 3, the Kontakion: **"Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross"** (*Ὁ Ὑψωθείς*), and the Sessional Hymn: **"Thy Cross, O Lord, is hallowed"** (*Ὁ Σταυρός σου Κύριε ἡγίασται*) once; after Ode 6, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the Saints. Katavasiai: **"Inscribing the Cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exaposteilaria: of the Resurrection and of the Cross. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Cross; "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Cross (the Service of the Saints is celebrated at Compline). Glory of the Cross, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Cross. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Cross (once), and Dismissal. 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion “Save, O Lord [Your people],” and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Resurrec- tion Apolytikion (twice) and that of the Cross (once), then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and the Kathismata of the Cross in place of the Theotokia. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrec- tion and of the Cross whose verse is “Glory to You, our God, glory to You.” After the 3rd Ode, the Kontakion “Lifted up on the Cross,” the Kathisma of the Cross “Your Cross, Lord, was sanctified” (once); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Saints. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and of the Cross. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Cross, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 6.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Cross. After the Entrance, the Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Cross, of the Saint of the Church and Kontakion “You were transfigured upon the mountain.” Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Cross. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, of the Cross, and that of the Patron Saint of the Church; Kontakion: **"Thou wast transfigured upon the mountain"** (*Ἐπὶ τοῦ Ὄρους μετεμορφώθης*); Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: Ὁ Πατριάρχης (ἢ ὁ Προϊστάμενος) τὸν ψαλμὸν Κύριε εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου χῦμα, εἶτα ψάλλεται ὑπὸ τῶν Χορῶν εἰς ἦχον δ΄ τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος τετράκις Τῇ Θεοτόκῳ ἐκτενῶς νῦν προσδράμωμεν . . . (Δόξα) τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, Καὶ νῦν, Οὐ σιωπήσωμέν ποτε Θεοτόκε καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα· εἶτα ψάλλεται ὁ Κανὼν τῆς μικρᾶς Παρακλήσεως ἄνευ τῶν Εἱρμῶν, ἀλλ᾿ εὐθὺς Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε σῶσον ἡμᾶς . . . Πολλοῖς συνεχόμενος πειρασμοῖς ἀνὰ δ΄ Τροπάρια ἐν ἑκάστῃ Ὠδῇ· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, Διάσωσον ἀπὸ κινδύνων, καὶ Ἐπίβλεψον ἐν εὐμενείᾳ, ὁ Ἱερεὺς Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον τετράκις ἀνὰ τρίς, εἶτα τὸ Πρεσβεία θερμὴ καὶ ἄρχεται ὁ β΄ Χορὸς τῆς δ΄ Ὠδῆς· μετὰ τὴν ς΄ Ὠδὴν τὸ Διάσωσον ἀπὸ κινδύνων, καὶ τὸ Ἄχραντε ἡ διὰ λόγου, καὶ αὖθις ὑπὸ τοῦ Ἱερέως ἡ Ἐκτενὴς Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεός, εἶτα τὸ Κοντάκιον Προστασία τῶν χριστιανῶν καὶ εὐθὺς οἱ Χοροὶ τὸ Προκείμενον Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου, Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, Δόξα, Πάτερ, Λόγε, Πνεῦμα, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος, Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Μὴ καταπιστεύσῃς με . . . Οὐδεὶς προστρέχων ἐπὶ σοὶ . . . Μεταβολὴ τῶν θλιβομένων καὶ ὁ Ἱερεὺς Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου, οἱ Χοροὶ τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον ιβ΄, ὁ Ἱερεὺς Ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς καὶ ψάλλεται ἡ ζ΄, η΄ καὶ θ΄ Ὠδὴ τοῦ Κανόνος. Μετὰ τὴν θ΄ Ὠδὴν ἐπισυνάπτονται καὶ τὰ Μεγαλυνάρια Ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὡς ἀληθῶς . . . τὴν Ὑψηλοτέραν τῶν οὐρανῶν κτλ. ὅταν δὲ ψάλληται τὸ Ἄλαλα τὰ χείλη τῶν ἀσεβῶν, ὁ Πατριάρχης ἀσπάζεται τὴν εἰκόνα τῆς Θεοτόκου καὶ ἐπιστρέφων (εἰς τὸν θρόνον) εὐλογεῖ τὸν λαόν, τῶν Χορῶν ψαλλόντων Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη· εἶτα ψάλλονται καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ Μεγαλυνάρια Ψάλλομεν προθύμως σοι τὴν Ὠδήν, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ καὶ τὸ Πᾶσαι τῶν Ἀγγέλων αἱ στρατιαί, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον τοῦ Ἁγίου Βασίλειον διάδημα, καὶ Θεοτοκίον Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον, ὁ Ἱερεὺς αὖθις Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς κτλ. ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τοῦ διαφυλαχθῆναι ... καὶ οἱ Χοροὶ τὸ Κύριε ἐλέησον, ὁ Πατριάρχης Ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν ὁ Θεός, ὁ Ἱερεὺς Σοφία,

units.english_text: The Patriarch (or the Superior) reads Psalm 142 [LXX] **"O Lord, hear my prayer"** (*Κύριε εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου*) in a low voice [recto tono]; then the Choirs chant "God is the Lord" four times in Tone 4, with **"Unto the Theotokos let us now run earnestly"** (*Τῇ Θεοτόκῳ ἐκτενῶς νῦν προσδράμωμεν*); "Glory...": the Dismissal Troparion of the Patron Saint of the Church; "Both now and ever...": **"Never will we be silent, O Theotokos"** (*Οὐ σιωπήσωμέν ποτε Θεοτόκε*); and Psalm 50 [LXX] is read in a low voice. Then the Canon of the Small Paraklesis is chanted without the Heirmoi, beginning immediately with: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"** (*Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε σῶσον ἡμᾶς*), **"Held captive by many temptations"** (*Πολλοῖς συνεχόμενος πειρασμοῖς*), with 4 Troparia in each Ode. After Ode 3: **"Deliver from dangers"** (*Διάσωσον ἀπὸ κινδύνων*), and **"Look down with loving-kindness"** (*Ἐπίβλεψον ἐν εὐμενείᾳ*); the Priest says the Litany: **"Have mercy on us, O God"** (*Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεός*), and the Choirs respond with **"Lord, have mercy"** (*Κύριε ἐλέησον*) four times in groups of three; then the Sessional Hymn: **"Fervent advocate"** (*Πρεσβεία θερμή*), and the Second Choir begins Ode 4. After Ode 6: **"Deliver from dangers"** (*Διάσωσον ἀπὸ κινδύνων*), and **"O Undefiled One, who by a word"** (*Ἄχραντε ἡ διὰ λόγου*); and again the Priest says the Insistent Litany: **"Have mercy on us, O God"**; then the Kontakion: **"Protection of Christians"** (*Προστασία τῶν χριστιανῶν*), and immediately the Choirs chant the Prokeimenon: **"I will remember Thy name in every generation and generation"** (*Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*, Ps. 44:18 LXX); **"Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel: **"Mary arose in those days"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56); "Glory...": **"Father, Word, and Spirit"** (*Πάτερ, Λόγε, Πνεῦμα*); "Both now and ever...": **"By the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Entrust me not to human protection"** (*Μὴ καταπιστεύσῃς με ἀνθρωπίνῃ προστασίᾳ*); **"No one who runneth to thee"** (*Οὐδεὶς προστρέχων ἐπὶ σοί*); **"A relief to those in affliction"** (*Μεταβολὴ τῶν θλιβομένων*). The Priest proclaims: **"Save, O God, Thy people"** (*Σῶσον ὁ Θεὸς τὸν λαόν σου*); the Choirs chant **"Lord, have mercy"** 12 times; the Priest says the Prayer: **"Through the mercy and compassions"** (*Ἐλέει καὶ οἰκτιρμοῖς*); and Odes 7, 8, and 9 of the Canon are chanted. After Ode 9, the Megalynaria are joined: **"It is truly right to bless thee"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὡς ἀληθῶς*)... **"Higher than the heavens"** (*Τὴν Ὑψηλοτέραν τῶν οὐρανῶν*), etc. When **"Speechless be the lips of the impious"** (*Ἄλαλα τὰ χείλη τῶν ἀσεβῶν*) is chanted, the Patriarch venerates the icon of the Theotokos and, returning to the Throne, blesses the people, while the Choirs chant: **"Many years, O Master"** (*Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*); then the remaining Megalynaria are chanted: **"Eagerly we offer thee this hymn"** (*Ψάλλομεν προθύμως σοι τὴν Ὠδήν*), that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and **"All the armies of the Angels"** (*Πᾶσαι τῶν Ἀγγέλων αἱ στρατιαί*); the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion of the Saint: **"A royal diadem"** (*Βασίλειον διάδημα*), and the Theotokion: **"The mystery hidden from all ages"** (*Τὸ ἀπ᾿ αἰῶνος ἀπόκρυφον*). The Priest says again: **"Have mercy on us, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεός*), etc., **"Again we pray that this holy church may be preserved..."** (*Ἔτι δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ τοῦ διαφυλαχθῆναι...*), and the Choirs respond: **"Lord, have mercy"**; the Patriarch says: **"Hear us, O God our Savior"** (*Ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν ὁ Θεός*); the Priest: **"Wisdom"** (*Σοφία*); the Patriarch:...[^377]

units.slavonic_incipit: ὁ ὢν Εὐλογητός, ὁ Πατριάρχης Στερεώσαι
units.slavonic_text: ὁ ὢν Εὐλογητός, ὁ Πατριάρχης Στερεώσαι Κύριος ὁ θεός, ὁ Ἱερεὺς τὴν Ἀπόλυσιν Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, οἱ Χοροὶ Τὸν Δεσπότην καὶ Ἀρχιερέα, τὸ Δι᾿ εὐχῶν καὶ Ἀπόλυσις. Σημειωτέον ὅτι οἱ δύο Παρακλητικοὶ τῆς Παναγίας Κανόνες, ψάλλονται ἐναλλὰξ μέχρι τῆς ΙΔ΄ τοῦ μηνὸς τῇ μὲν α΄ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ μικρός, τῇ δὲ β΄ ὁ Μέγας, καὶ οὕτω καθεξῆς. Τὸ πρωΐ ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ὄρθρου τοῦ Ἁγίου, ὡς καὶ ἡ τῆς Λειτουργίας, ψάλλονται κατὰ τὴν διάταξιν τοῦ Μηναίου. 2.    Εἰ τύχοι ἡ μνήμη τοῦ ἁγίου Στεφάνου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Κυριακῇ, ἡ Ἀκολουθία τοῦ Ἁγίου μετὰ τῆς Ἀναστασίμου ψάλλεται κατὰ τὴν ἐν τῇ μνήμῃ τοῦ ἁγίου Παντελεήμονος διάταξιν ἐν §2, 3, 4, Ἀπόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Τῇ αὐτῇ Κυριακῇ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια τῆς Ὀκτωήχου τῆς σειρᾶς β΄, ἓν τῶν Ἀρχαγγέλων καὶ τρία τῶν Ὁσίων, Ἰσαακίου, Δαλμάτου καὶ Φαύστου, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν Θεοτοκίον Προσόμοιον, τὸ Φῶς ἱλαρὸν καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Στιχηρὰ τῆς Ὀκτωήχου, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν Θεοτοκίον, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, καὶ εὐθὺς ὁ ψαλμὸς Κύριε εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου, κτλ. κατὰ τὴν χθὲς διάταξιν, καὶ ψάλλεται ὁ Κανὼν τῆς Μεγάλης Παρακλήσεως· Εὐαγγέλιον Τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ εἰσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς κώμην τινά. Μετὰ τὴν θ΄ Ὠδὴν τοῦ Κανόνος τὰ δ΄ Ἐξαποστειλάρια1 Ἀπόστολοι ἐκ περάτων· εἰς τὸ γ΄ ὁ Πατριάρχης προσκυνεῖ τὴν εἰκόνα τῆς Θεοτόκου καὶ ἐπιστρέφων (εἰς τὸν θρόνον) εὐλογεῖ τὸν λαόν, τῶν Χορῶν ψαλλόντων τὸ Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη, εἶτα Χρυσοπλοκώτατε πύργε, τὸ Τρισάγιον καὶ ἀντὶ τοῦ Ἀπολυτικίου τῶν Ἁγίων ὡς μὴ ἐχόντων Δοξαστικόν, ψάλλονται τὰ τρία κατανυκτικὰ Τροπάρια Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς Κύριε . . . Δόξα, Κύριε ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, Καὶ νῦν, Τῆς εὐσπλαγχνίας τὴν πύλην . . . Ἐὰν ὅμως ψάλληται ἡ Παράκλησις ἐν ἡμέρᾳ Παρασκευῆς, ἀντὶ τῶν Κατανυκτικῶν τούτων, λέγονται τὰ Τροπάρια Ἀπόστολοι, Μάρτυρες, Δόξα, Μνήσθητι Κύριε . . . Καὶ νῦν, Μήτηρ Ἁγία . . . ἐννοεῖται δὲ οἴκοθεν ὅτι μετὰ τὴν ἑορτὴν τῆς Μεταμορφώσεως λέγεται τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον ταύτης.

Note: the two Intercessory Canons of the Theotokos are chanted alternately until the 14th of the month: on the first day the Small, on the 2nd the Great, and so on. In the morning the Service of the Matins of the Saint and of the Liturgy are sung according to the order of the Mineon. 2.    If the Feast of Saint Stephen occurs on Sunday, the Service of the Saint together with that of the Resurrection is sung according to the order of Saint Panteleimon, Paragraphs 2, 3 and 4. Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. On this Sunday evening, following the Introductory Psalm, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing 2 Prosomia Stichira of the Octoichos of the sequence, 1 of the Archangels and 3 of the Righteous Isaakios, Dalmatos and Faustos, Glory, Now and ever the Prosomion Theotokion. “O Glad- some Light,” and the Prokimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the Stichira of the Octoichos, Glory, Now and ever the Theotokion. Then “Lord, now let” and immediately the Psalm “O Lord, hear my prayer” etc. according to yesterday's order, and the Canon of the Great Paraklisis is sung, and then the Gospel “At that time Jesus entered a certain village.” After the 9th Ode of the Canon, the 4 Exapostilaria1 “Apostles from distant places”; at the 3rd the Patriarch venerates the icon of the Theotokos, and returning {to the Throne} he blesses the people, the Choirs singing “Many years, O Master,” then “Tower with gold interwoven,” the Trisagion and instead of the Apolytikion of the Saints, since they do not have a Glory Hymn [Doxastikon], we sing the 3 Penitential Troparia: “Have mercy on us, Lord,” Glory, “Lord, have mercy on us,” Now and ever, “The gateway to your compas- sion.” If, however, the Paraklisis is chanted on Friday, instead of the above penitential hymns, we say the Hymns: “Apostles, Martyrs,” Glory, “Re- member, Lord,” Now and ever, “Holy Mother.” It is understood that following the Feast of the Transfiguration we sing its Apolytikion.

units.english_text: On that same Sunday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 2 Prosomoia Stichira of the Octoechos in series, 1 of the Archangels, and 3 of the Venerable Fathers Isaac, Dalmatus, and Faustus; "Glory... Both now and ever...": Prosomoion Theotokion. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the Stichira of the Octoechos; "Glory... Both now and ever...": Theotokion; **"Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*); and immediately Psalm 142 [LXX] **"O Lord, hear my prayer"** (*Κύριε εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου*), etc., according to yesterday's order, and the Canon of the Great Paraklesis is chanted; Gospel: **"At that time, Jesus entered into a certain village"** (*Τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ εἰσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς κώμην τινά*, Luke 10:38–42; 11:27–28). After the Ninth Ode of the Canon, the 4 Exaposteilaria [1] **"Ye Apostles from distant lands"** (*Ἀπόστολοι ἐκ περάτων*); at the third Exaposteilarion, the Patriarch venerates the icon of the Theotokos and, returning to the Throne, blesses the people, while the Choirs chant: **"Many years, O Master"** (*Εἰς πολλὰ ἔτη*); then: **"O tower interwoven with gold"** (*Χρυσοπλοκώτατε πύργε*); the Trisagion Prayers, and instead of the Dismissal Troparion of the Saints (since they have no Doxastikon), we chant the three Penitential Troparia: **"Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us"** (*Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς Κύριε*); "Glory...": **"Lord, have mercy on us, for we have trusted in Thee"** (*Κύριε ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς*); "Both now and ever...": **"Open unto us the gate of thy compassion, O blessed Theotokos"** (*Τῆς εὐσπλαγχνίας τὴν πύλην*). If, however, the Paraklesis is chanted on a Friday, instead of these Penitential Troparia we chant the Troparia: **"Apostles, Martyrs, and Prophets"** (*Ἀπόστολοι, Μάρτυρες*); "Glory...": **"Remember, O Lord, Thy servants"** (*Μνήσθητι Κύριε*); "Both now and ever...": **"Holy Mother of the Ineffable Light"** (*Μήτηρ Ἁγία*). It is self-evident that after the Feast of the Transfiguration, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast is chanted.

units.slavonic_incipit: Τῇ Ε΄. Προεόρτια τῆς Μεταμορφώσεως τοῦ
units.slavonic_text: Τῇ Ε΄.    Προεόρτια τῆς Μεταμορφώσεως τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Μάρτυρος Εὐσιγνίου.
units.english_text: 2.    Τὸ πρωῒ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικὸν κλπ. τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ Ἀπολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, τὰ προεόρτια Καθίσματα καὶ ὁ Ν΄ χῦμα, εἶτα οἱ Κανόνες μετὰ Στίχου Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός· ἀπὸ γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς οἱ Εἱρμοὶ καὶ αἱ Αἰτήσεις· ἀπ᾿ θ΄ ψάλλεται ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς η΄ Ὠδῆς Τὸν βασιλέα Χριστόν, καὶ στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, ὁ Εἱρμὸς τῆς θ΄ Σὲ τὴν ἀπειρόγαμον Θεοτόκον· εἶτα τὸ προεόρτιον Ἐξαποστειλάριον δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ Προσόμοια Τῆς παναγίας ἐνδόξου Μεταμορφώσεως εἰς δ΄ (ζήτει εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα)(μᾶλλον εἰς τὸ Μηναῖον εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον ἀμέσως μετὰ τῶν Ἐξαποστειλαρίων). Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Νόμου καὶ Προφητῶν σε Χριστὲ (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτὴν τῆς ἑορτῆς), Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει χῦμα. Εἰς τὰ Ἀπόστιχα, τὰ Προσόμοια Φέγγει τῶν ἀρετῶν, ἅπερ ἐψάλησαν χθὲς ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ.

units.english_text: 1.    If the Forefeast of the Transfiguration falls on any other day except Sunday, the service is chanted according to the order in the Menaion, and Little Entrance is made. After **"Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*), the Paraklesis is chanted as is customary; and at the conclusion, after the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion: **"Let us go forth to meet the Transfiguration of Christ"** (*Χριστοῦ τὴν Μεταμόρφωσιν προϋπαντήσωμεν*) is chanted once, then the Insistent Litany, and Dismissal.

provenance.verbatim_source: 1.    If the Forefeast of the Transfiguration falls on any other day except Sunday, the service is chanted according to the order in the Menaion, and Little Entrance is made. After **"Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*), the Paraklesis is chanted as is customary; and at the conclusion, after the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion: **"Let us go forth to meet the Transfiguration of Christ"** (*Χριστοῦ τὴν Μεταμόρφωσιν προϋπαντήσωμεν*) is chanted once, then the Insistent Litany, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 2.    In the morning at Matins, after the Midnight Office, the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion twice, and the Psalter reading; the Forefeast Sessional Hymns, and Psalm 50 [LXX] in a low voice; then the Canons, with the verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεός*); after Odes 3 and 6, the Heirmoi and the Litanies; at Ode 9, the Heirmos of the Eighth Ode is chanted: **"Christ the King"** (*Τὸν βασιλέα Χριστόν*), and we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*); then the Heirmos of the Ninth Ode: **"Thee, the unwedded Theotokos"** (*Σὲ τὴν ἀπειρόγαμον Θεοτόκον*); then the Forefeast Exaposteilarion twice. At the Praises: the Prosomoia: **"Of the all-holy and glorious Transfiguration"** (*Τῆς παναγίας ἐνδόξου Μεταμορφώσεως*) to 4 (seek in the Aposticha, or rather in the Menaion at Matins immediately after the Exaposteilaria); "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"The fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets, O Christ"** (*Νόμου καὶ Προφητῶν σε Χριστέ*, seek in the Litiya of the Feast); **"To Thee belongeth glory"** (*Σοὶ δόξα πρέπει*) in a low voice. At the Aposticha: the Prosomoia: **"With the radiance of virtues"** (*Φέγγει τῶν ἀρετῶν*), which were chanted yesterday at Vespers.

units.slavonic_text: The 5th    The Pre-feast of the Transfiguration of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and the Holy Martyr Efsignios.
units.english_text: 3.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons: **"It is good to give praise unto the Lord"** (*Ἀγαθὸν τὸ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ Κυρίῳ*, Ps. 91:2 LXX); **"The Lord is King"** (*Ὁ Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν*, Ps. 92:1 LXX); **"O come, let us sing unto the Lord... Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints..."** (*Δεῦτε ἀγαλλιασώμεθα τῷ Κυρίῳ... Σῶσον ἡμᾶς... ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*, Ps. 94:1 LXX). After the Little Entrance: **"O come, let us worship... Who art wonderful in the saints"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν... ὁ ἐν ἁγίοις θαυμαστός*); the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion; that of the Patron Saint of the Church; and the Forefeast Kontakion: **"In the divine Transfiguration today"** (*Ἐν τῇ θείᾳ σήμερον Μεταμορφώσει*). Epistle: **"Brethren, blessed be God"** (*Ἀδελφοί, εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεός*, see Friday of the 32nd Week, 2 Cor. 1:3–7 LXX), and the Gospel of the day. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn of the day; **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    If the Pre-feast of the Transfiguration occurs on any day except Sunday, the Service is sung according to the order of the Mineon. The Entrance is performed. After “Lord, now let,” the Paraklisis is sung as is customary; and at the end, after the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Pre- feast “Let us celebrate in advance the Transfiguration of Christ” is sung once, then the Ektenis [Litany of Petitions], and Dismissal. 2.    In the morning at Matins after the Midnight Service etc., the Trisagion, the Apolytikion and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the [Litany of Petitions] the Apolytikion twice, and the Psalter. The Kathismata of the Pre-feast and Psalm 50 read, then the Canons with the Verse “Glory to You, our God.” After the 3rd and the 6th Ode, the Irmi and the Petitions; after the 9th Ode, we sing the Irmos of the 8th Ode “Christ the King”; then we sing “More honorable,” then the Irmos of the 9th Ode “You, the unmarried Theotokos”; then the Exapostilarion of the Pre-feast twice. At the Praises: the Prosomia “Of the all-holy and glorious Transfiguration” in 4 (seek in the Aposticha) {rather in the Mineon in Matins right after the Exapostilaria}. Glory, Now and ever, “The fulfillment of the Law and the Prophets” (see the Liti of the Feast), “To You belongs glory” read. At the Aposticha: the Prosomia “The virtues shining,” which were sung yester- day in Vespers. 3.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons “It is good to give thanks to the Lord.” “The Lord reigns,” “Let us be joyfull unto the Lord . . . Save us ...wondrous in Your saints.” After the Entrance, “Come, let us worship . . . wondrous in the saints.” the Apolytikion of the Pre-feast, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion of the Pre-feast “Today at the sacred Transfiguration.” Apostolos “Brethren, blessed is God” (see Friday of the 32nd Week), and the Gospel of the day. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn of the day, “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal. 4.    If the Pre-feast occurs on a Sunday, Saturday at Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Pre-feast. Glory, “Come, let us ascend onto the mountain of the Lord” (see the Liti of the Feast), Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. units.english_text: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ προεόρτιον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὸ προεόρτιον ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ προεόρτιος, οὗ ὁ Στίχος Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν δόξα σοι· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα προεόρτιον Ἐπεφάνη, ἤγγικεν ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χοροὶ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, ἡ Καταβασία Ὁ τόκος σου ἄφθορος, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τὸ προεόρτιον ἅπαξ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ προεόρτια Τῆς παναγίας ἐνδόξου Μεταμορφώσεως εἰς δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.slavonic_text: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανών, καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ προεόρτιον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον δίς, καὶ τὸ προεόρτιον ἅπαξ, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα κατὰ σειράν, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον, Κανόνες ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος καὶ ὁ προεόρτιος, οὗ ὁ Στίχος Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν δόξα σοι· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα προεόρτιον Ἐπεφάνη, ἤγγικεν ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῶν Ἁγίων τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Χοροὶ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, ἡ Καταβασία Ὁ τόκος σου ἄφθορος, Ἐξαποστειλάρια τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον, καὶ τὸ προεόρτιον ἅπαξ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, Ἀναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ προεόρτια Τῆς παναγίας ἐνδόξου Μεταμορφώσεως εἰς δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 6.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου εἰς δ΄ καὶ ἐκ τῆς ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ προεορτίου Κανόνος δ΄. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, τὸ προεόρτιον, τὸ τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Ἐν τῇ θείᾳ σήμερον Μεταμορφώσει, ᾿Απόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς, καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: Resurrection, of the Pre-feast, and Dismissal.
units.slavonic_text: Resurrection, of the Pre-feast, and Dismissal. The Service of the Martyr Efsignios is chanted at Compline.
units.english_text: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection twice, and that of the Forefeast once; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. The Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Forefeast, with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν δόξα σοι*). After the Third Ode, the Forefeast Sessional Hymn: **"He appeared, He drew near"** (*Ἐπεφάνη, ἤγγικεν*) once; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion of the Saints of the day. Katavasiai: **"Choirs of Israel"** (*Χοροὶ Ἰσραήλ*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). The Katavasia: **"Thy childbearing was shown to be incorrupt"** (*Ὁ τόκος σου ἄφθορος*). Exaposteilaria: of the Resurrection, and of the Forefeast once. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast: **"Of the all-holy and glorious Transfiguration"** (*Τῆς παναγίας ἐνδόξου Μεταμορφώσεως*) to 4; "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Pre-feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Resurrection Apolytikion twice and that of the Pre-feast once, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order; the Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and of the Pre-feast with the Verse “Glory to You, our God, glory to You.” After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Pre-feast “He appeared, He came near” (once); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion of the Saints of the day. The Katavasie “Choirs of Israel,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honor- able.” The Katavasia “Your birth-giving was shown to be undefiled.” Exapostilaria of the Resurrection, and of the Pre-feast (once). At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Pre-feast “Of the all-holy and glorious Transfiguration” (in 4), Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 6.    In the Liturgy are sung the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Pre-feast. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Pre-feast, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Today, in the Divine Transfiguration,” Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Forefeast. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection, that of the Forefeast, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"In the divine Transfiguration today"** (*Ἐν τῇ θείᾳ σήμερον Μεταμορφώσει*); Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: The 6th        The Transfiguration of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
units.english_text: 1.    If the Feast of the Transfiguration falls on a Sunday, none of the Resurrection hymns are chanted, but all those of the Feast, as follows: On Saturday evening at Vespers, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant the Idiomela: **"Before Thy Cross, O Lord"** (*Πρὸ τοῦ Σταυροῦ σου Κύριε*) to 6; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Prefiguring Thy Resurrection"** (*Προτυπῶν τὴν Ἀνάστασιν τὴν σήν*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the 3 Idiomela; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"To Peter, and John, and James"** (*Πέτρῳ καὶ Ἰωάννῃ καὶ Ἰακώβῳ*). The Dismissal Troparion: **"Thou wast transfigured upon the mountain"** (*Μετεμορφώθης ἐν τῷ Ὄρει*)...[^380]

units.english_text: 2.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτὴ τῆς ἑορτῆς, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος Αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, τὰ Καθίσματα κατὰ σειρὰν ἐκ δευτέρου, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ ᾿Αντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Θαβὼρ καὶ Ἑρμὼν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀγαλλιάσονται, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον (᾿Ανάστασιν Χριστοῦ οὐ λέγομεν, ἀλλ᾿ εὐθὺς ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα), Δόξα, Ταῖς τῶν ᾿Αποστόλων, Καὶ νῦν, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ὁ φωτί σου ἅπασαν (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν). Εἶτα οἱ Κανόνες ἄνευ στίχων· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς τὸ Κάθισμα ἅπαξ· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ καὶ τῶν δύο κανόνων, ἡ Καταβασία Μυστικὸς εἶ, Θεοτόκε, παράδεισος, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον ἐκ γ΄. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ γ΄ Προσόμοια εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Παρέλαβεν ὁ Χριστός, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον.

units.english_text: 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya of the Feast; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos: **"Praise the name of the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου*, Ps. 134:1 LXX); the Sessional Hymns in order twice each; the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; the Prokeimenon: **"Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Thy name"** (*Θαβὼρ καὶ Ἑρμὼν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀγαλλιάσονται*, Ps. 88:13 LXX); then **"Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Matins Gospel (we do not recite **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"**, but immediately Psalm 50 [LXX] in a low voice); "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Apostles"** (*Ταῖς τῶν Ἀποστόλων*); [2] "Both now and ever...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); the Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"Sanctifying the whole universe with Thy light"** (*Ὁ φωτί σου ἅπασαν*, see the Litiya). Then the Canons without verses; after the Third Ode, the Sessional Hymn once; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and the Menologion. Katavasiai: **"Inscribing the Cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*); then the Ninth Ode of both Canons is chanted; the Katavasia: **"Thou art a mystical paradise, O Theotokos"** (*Μυστικὸς εἶ, Θεοτόκε, παράδεισος*); the Exaposteilarion thrice. At the Praises: the 3 Prosomoia to 4; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Christ took with Him Peter, James, and John"** (*Παρέλαβεν ὁ Χριστός*); Great Doxology, and the Dismissal Troparion.

units.slavonic_text: (thrice), and Dismissal “May Christ our true God, who was transfigured on Mount Tabor, in glory, before His holy Disciples and Apostles.” 2.    At Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti of the Feast, then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikion as in Vespers, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos “Praise the name of the Lord.” The Kathismata in order (twice each), the Anavathmi of the First Antiphon of Mode IV, the Prokimenon “Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Your name.” Then “Let everything that breathes” and the Morning [Matins] Gospel (we do not recite “Having beheld the Resurrection,” but we read immediately Psalm 50). Glory,² “Through the intercessions of the Apostles,” Now and ever, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” the Verse “Have mercy on me, O God” and the Idiomelon “By Your light, the entire [universe]” (see the Liti). Then the Canons without verses. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma (once); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast and the Minologion. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” then the 9th Ode of both Canons and the Katavasia “O Theotokos, you are a mystical paradise.” The Exapostilarion (thrice). At the Praises: the three Prosomia in 4, Glory, Now and ever, “Christ took with Him,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion. 3.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons:

units.slavonic_text: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our God. By your strength you established the mountains. You are clothed with light as with a garment. units.slavonic_incipit: Εἰσοδικὸν Ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ πηγὴ ζωῆς,
units.slavonic_text: Εἰσοδικὸν Ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ πηγὴ ζωῆς, Κύριε, ἐν τῷ φωτί σου ὀψόμεθα φῶς . . . Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Θαβὼρ μεταμορφωθείς . . . τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς, τὸ Τρισάγιον, ὁ ᾿Απόστολος καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον· Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως τὸ Νῦν τὰ ἀνήκουστα ἠκούσθη³ (ζήτει ἐν τῇ ζ΄ Ὠδῇ), Κοινωνικὸν Ἐν τῷ φωτὶ τῆς δόξης τοῦ προσώπου σου, Μετεμορφώθης ἐν τῷ Ὄρει, καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις. Τὸ ἑσπέρας τῆς ἑορτῆς, οἱαδήποτε ἡμέρα καὶ ἂν ᾖ, ἀντὶ τοῦ Προκειμένου τῆς ἡμέρας ψάλλεται τὸ Μ. Προκείμενον Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ μετὰ τῶν Στίχων αὐτοῦ.

units.slavonic_text: ANTIPHON THREE
units.english_text: Entrance Hymn (Isodikon): **"For with Thee is the fountain of life; in Thy light shall we see light"** (*Ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ πηγὴ ζωῆς, Κύριε, ἐν τῷ φωτί σου ὀψόμεθα φῶς*, Ps. 35:10 LXX)... **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast transfigured upon Mount Tabor, who sing to Thee: Alleluia!"** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Θαβὼρ μεταμορφωθείς...*). The Dismissal Troparion and Kontakion of the Feast, the Trisagion, the Epistle and the Gospel. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"Now things unheard of have been heard"** [3] (*Τὸ Νῦν τὰ ἀνήκουστα ἠκούσθη*, see the Seventh Ode). Communion Hymn: **"In the light of the glory of Thy countenance, O Lord, we will walk forever"** (*Ἐν τῷ φωτὶ τῆς δόξης τοῦ προσώπου σου*, Ps. 4:7; 88:16 LXX); [the Dismissal Troparion:] **"Thou wast transfigured upon the mountain"**, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: I will sing of Your mercies
units.slavonic_text: I will sing of Your mercies for ever, O Lord. Let the heavens praise your wonders, O Lord. Blessed is the people that know the sound of joy. They shall walk, O Lord, in the light of your countenance; in Your Name they shall rejoice all the day. [You were transfigured upon the mountain.]
units.english_text: On the evening of the Feast, whatever day it may be, instead of the Prokeimenon of the day, we chant the Great Prokeimenon: **"Our God is in heaven and on earth; all things whatsoever He hath pleased, He hath done"** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ*, Ps. 113:11 LXX), with its verses.

units.slavonic_incipit: Entrance Hymn: For with You is
units.slavonic_text: Entrance Hymn: For with You is the fountain of life, O Lord, and in Your light shall we see light. O Son of God, transfigured upon Mount Tabor, [save us who sing to You, Alleluia!]. The Apolytikion and Kontakion of the Feast, the Trisagios Hymn, the Apostolos and the Gospel. At “Especially,” the “Now the unheard of has been heard”³ (see the 7th Ode), Communion Hymn “In the light of the glory of Your face,” [the Apolytikion] “You were transfigured upon the mountain,” and Dismissal. On the evening of the Feast, regardless of what day it is, instead of the Prokimenon of the day, the Great Prokimenon “Our God in heaven and on earth” with its verses is sung.
units.english_text: 4.    On Friday evening, Vespers is chanted according to the order of the Menaion, and at the conclusion the Paraklesis. Dismissal Troparion: **"Thou wast transfigured upon the mountain"** (*Μετεμορφώθης ἐν τῷ ὄρει*); the Priest: **"Have mercy on us, O God"** (*Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεός*), etc., and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 7.    Τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ ς΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, Δόξα, Δεῦτε ἀναβῶμεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος Κυρίου (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), Καὶ νῦν, τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ ᾿Απόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Νῦν ἀπολύεις, τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: Κυριακῇ μετὰ τὴν ἑορτήν.
units.english_text: 8.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον δὶς καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ἅπαξ· εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα καὶ τὰ μεθέορτα ἀντὶ τῶν Θεοτοκίων, τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ Ἀναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ ὁ εἷς τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα μεθέορτον ἅπαξ, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ μεθέορτον ἅπαξ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

Κανόνες, ὁ Ἀναστάσιμος, καὶ ὁ εἷς τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα μεθέορτον ἅπαξ, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ Ἀναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Σταυρὸν χαράξας καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, Ἐξαποστειλάρια, τὸ Ἀναστάσιμον καὶ μεθέορτον ἅπαξ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄, Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία. 9. On Saturday, after the Midnight Office and the regular order of Matins, at the Praises: the Vespers Stichira of August 9: **"Of the all-holy and glorious Transfiguration"** (*Τῆς παναγίας ἐνδόξου Μεταμορφώσεως*) to 4; "Glory... units.english_text: 6.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast: **"Save us, O Son of God, Who wast transfigured upon Mount Tabor..."** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Θαβὼρ μεταμορφωθείς*). After the Little Entrance: **"O come, let us worship... Who wast transfigured upon Mount Tabor"** (*Δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν... ὁ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Θαβὼρ μεταμορφωθείς*). At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken unto Thyself, O Lord"** (*Μακάριοι οὓς ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου, Κύριε*, Ps. 64:5 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 5.    On Saturday, after the Midnight Service and the Order of the Matins, at the Praises: the hymns from Vespers of 9 August “Of the all- holy and glorious Transfiguration” (in 4), Glory, Now and ever, “You sanctified the whole world with Your light.” “To You belongs all glory”; after the Ektenis [Litany of Petitions], the Aposticha “On Mount Tabor” (see the 9th of the month) and the Apolytikion. 6.    At the Liturgy, the Antiphons of the Feast “O Son of God, who was transfigured upon Mount Tabor . . .” After the Entrance, “O come let us worship . . . on Mount Tabor.” At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Blessed are those whom You have chosen,” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 7.    On Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 6 Stichira of the Resurrection and 4 of the Afterfeast; "Glory...": **"Come, let us ascend into the mountain of the Lord"** (*Δεῦτε ἀναβῶμεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος Κυρίου*, see the Litiya); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast; **"Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*); the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection, that of the Feast once, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 8.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection twice, and that of the Feast once; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order, and the Sessional Hymns of the Afterfeast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: of the Resurrection, and one of the Feast; after the Third Ode, the Afterfeast Sessional Hymn once; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion. Katavasiai: **"Inscribing the Cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exaposteilaria: of the Resurrection, and of the Afterfeast once. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Afterfeast; "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: 7.    On Saturday evening, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Post-feast. Glory, “Come, let us ascend onto the mountain of the Lord,” (see the Liti), Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Feast “Lord, now let,” then the Trisagion. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Feast (once), and Dismissal. 8.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Resurrection Apolytikion (twice) and the Feast’s (once), then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and those of the Post-feast in place of the Theotokia. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and the first of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Post-feast (once); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable.” Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and that of the Post-feast (once). At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Post-feast, Glory the Eothinon, Now and ever, “Most blessed,” Great Doxology and “Today salvation.” 9.    In the Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Feast. units.slavonic_text: ᾿Απόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις. units.english_text: 10.   Τῇ ΙΓ΄ τοῦ αὐτοῦ μηνός, ἡ ᾿Ακολουθία ψάλλεται ἀπαραλλάκτως ὡς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς, ἐξαιρουμένων ἐν τῷ Ἑσπερινῷ τῶν ᾿Αναγνωσμάτων, καὶ ἐν τῷ Ὄρθρῳ τῆς Λιτῆς, τοῦ Πολυελέου καὶ τοῦ Εὐαγγελίου· ἐν δὲ τῇ Λειτουργίᾳ, ᾿Απόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τὰ τῆς ἡμέρας.

units.english_text: 11.   Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ᾿Απόδοσις ἐν Κυριακῇ τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ᾿Αναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰδιόμελα ς΄, Δόξα τῆς ἑορτῆς, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Entrance is made, and after “Lord, now let” the Great Paraklisis is chanted as is the custom.
units.english_text: 10.   On the 13th of this month, the service [of the Apodosis] is chanted without variation exactly as on the day of the Feast, with the following exceptions: in Vespers, the Readings are omitted; in Matins, the Litiya, the Polyeleos, and the Gospel are omitted; and in the Divine Liturgy, the Epistle and Gospel are of the day.

units.slavonic_text: The Leave-taking of the Feast.
units.english_text: 11.   If the Apodosis falls on a Sunday, on Saturday evening, after the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant 4 Stichira of the Resurrection and 6 Idiomela of the Feast; "Glory...": of the Feast; "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": of the Feast; **"Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart"** (*Νῦν ἀπολύεις*); the Trisagion Prayers; the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection, that of the Feast twice, and Dismissal.

In the Liturgy, we recite the Apostolos and Gospel of the day. 11.   If the Leave-taking occurs on Sunday, on Saturday evening, follow- ing the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 4 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 6 of the Feast. Glory of the Feast, Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever of the Feast. Then “Lord, now let” and the Trisagion. The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Feast (twice), and Dismissal. 12.   On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Triadic Canon, and the Triadic “It is meet”; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion of the Feast and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikia as in Vespers, then the Psalter and the Amomos. The Resurrection Kathismata in order, and those of the Feast in place of the Theotokia. The Evlogitaria, the Ypakoi, the Anavathmi of the Mode and the Prokimenon. The Canons of the Resurrection and the two of the Feast. After the 3rd Ode, the Kathisma of the Feast (once); after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Minologion. The Katavasie “Moses, having etched the sign of the Cross,” and the entire order of the Morning Gospel; then we sing “More honorable,” and the 9th [Ode] of the Feast. Exapostilaria: of the Resurrection and of the Feast (twice). units.english_text: 12.   On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion of the Feast, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order, and the Sessional Hymns of the Feast in place of the Theotokia; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: of the Resurrection, and the two of the Feast; after the Third Ode, the Sessional Hymn of the Feast once; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion. Katavasiai: **"Inscribing the Cross"** (*Σταυρὸν χαράξας*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*), and the Ninth Ode of the Feast is chanted; Exaposteilaria: of the Resurrection, and that of the Feast twice. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Feast; "Glory...": **"Christ took with Him Peter, James, and John"** (*Παρέλαβεν ὁ Χριστός*); "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.slavonic_text: ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ᾿Απόστολος καὶ Εὐαγγέλιον τῆς Κυριακῆς. Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Ὁ τόκος σου, ἄφθορος, Κοινωνικὸν τῆς ἑορτῆς, Μετεμορφώθης ἐν τῷ ὄρει, ᾿Απόλυσις καὶ ᾿Απόδοσις.
units.english_text: 1.    Ἐὰν τύχωσι τὰ Προεόρτια ἐν ἄλλῃ ἡμέρᾳ πλὴν Κυριακῆς, ὁ προεόρτιος Ἑσπερινὸς (καὶ μετ᾿ αὐτόν, ἐννοεῖται, ἡ τελευταία Παράκλησις), καὶ τὸ πρωῒ ὁ Ὄρθρος μετὰ τῆς Λειτουργίας ψάλλονται κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν.

units.slavonic_text: Τῇ ΙΔ΄.    Τὰ Προεόρτια τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Θεοτόκου, καὶ τοῦ Προφήτου Μιχαίου.
units.english_text: 2.    Ἐὰν τύχωσιν ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ᾿Αναστάσιμα ς΄ καὶ Προεόρτια δ΄, Δόξα, Τὴν πάνσεπτόν σου Κοίμησιν, Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ ᾿Απόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἡ τῶν οὐρανῶν ὑψηλοτέρα, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, τὸ Προεόρτιον ἅπαξ, καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 1.    If the Pre-feast of the Dormition occurs on any day except Sunday, the Vespers of the Pre-feast (and with it, it is understood, the last Paraklisis), and in the morning Matins with the Liturgy are sung according to the order of the Mineon. 2.    If the Pre-feast occurs on a Sunday, Saturday at Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing 6 Stichira of the Resurrection, and 4 of the Pre-feast. Glory, “Your all- venerable Dormition,” Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever, “She who is higher than the heavens.” The Apolytikia: of the Resurrection, of the Pre-feast (once), and Dismissal. The Service of the Prophet Micah is chanted at Compline.
units.english_text: 3.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Forefeast Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection twice, and that of the Forefeast once; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. The Resurrection Sessional Hymns in order, and in place of the Theotokia of the Octoechos, we chant those of the Forefeast; the Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Canons: of the Resurrection and of the Forefeast with the Verse: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"** (*Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε*); after the Third Ode, the Forefeast Sessional Hymn once; after the Sixth Ode, the Resurrection Kontakion and Ikos, and the Menologion. Katavasiai: **"I shall open my mouth"** (*Ἀνοίξω τὸ στόμα μου*), with the ending of this: **"her Dormition"** (*τὴν Κοίμησιν*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*). Exaposteilaria: of the Resurrection, and that of the Forefeast: **"Celebrating the radiant memorial of thy holy Dormition"** (*Σοῦ τῆς σεπτῆς Κοιμήσεως*) once. At the Praises: 4 Resurrection Stichira and 4 of the Forefeast: **"The community of the disciples"** (*Δῆμος τῶν μαθητῶν*); "Glory...": the Eothinon Doxastikon; "Both now and ever...": **"Most blessed art Thou"** (*Ὑπερευλογημένη*); Great Doxology, and...[^385]

Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς, καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.
units.english_text: 1.    Ἐν τῷ Μ. Ἑσπερινῷ, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὴν α΄ Στάσιν τοῦ Ψαλτηρίου, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα τὰ Προσόμοια Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος εἰς ς΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Θεαρχίῳ νεύματι, Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὰ ᾿Αναγνώσματα. Εἰς τὰ ᾿Απόστιχα, τὰ γ΄ Ἰδιόμελα, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ὅτε ἐξεδήμησας, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον [Ἐν τῇ γεννήσει] ἐκ γ΄ καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.slavonic_incipit: Τῇ ΙΕ΄. Ἡ Κοίμησις τῆς Ὑπεραγίας
units.slavonic_text: Τῇ ΙΕ΄.    Ἡ Κοίμησις τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Δεσποίνης ἡμῶν Θεοτόκου.
units.english_text: 2.    Τὸ πρωῒ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τοῦ Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ἡ Λιτή, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον ἐκ γ΄, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου, τὰ Καθίσματα ἐκ β΄, οἱ ᾿Αναβαθμοί, τὸ α΄ ᾿Αντίφωνον τοῦ δ΄ ἤχου, τὸ Προκείμενον Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοὴ καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον ᾿Αναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, εἶτα ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεὸς καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ὅτε ἡ μετάστασις, οἱ Κανόνες ἀμφότεροι μετὰ τοῦ Στίχου Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς ἡ Ὑπακοή, ἀφ᾿ ς΄ τὸ Κοντάκιον, ὁ Οἶκος καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Πεποικιλμένη τῇ θείᾳ δόξῃ, εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ Ὠδὴ μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων· εἰς μὲν τὸν α΄ Κανόνα τὸ Αἱ γενεαὶ πᾶσαι μακαρίζομέν σε, τὴν μόνην Θεοτόκον, εἰς δὲ τὸν β΄ τὸ Ἄγγελοι τὴν Κοίμησιν τῆς Παρθένου, ὁρῶντες ἐξεπλήττοντο, πῶς ἡ Παρθένος ἀπαίρει ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς εἰς τὰ ἄνω, καὶ ἡ Καταβασία Αἱ γενεαὶ πᾶσαι

units.english_text: 4.    In the Divine Liturgy, the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Tone, and 4 hymns from the Sixth Ode of the Canon of the Forefeast. After the Little Entrance, the Dismissal Troparion of the Resurrection, that of the Forefeast, that of the Patron Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion: **"At thy glorious memorial"** (*Τῇ ἐνδόξῳ μνήμῃ σου*); Epistle and Gospel of the Sunday. At "Especially" [Megalynarion], **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); Communion Hymn: **"Praise the Lord"** (*Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον*, Ps. 148:1 LXX); **"We have seen the true light"** (*Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς*), and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_text: 4.    In the Liturgy are sung the Typika and 4 Beatitudes of the Mode and 4 hymns from the 6th Ode of the Canon of the Pre-feast. After the Entrance, the Resurrection Apolytikion, that of the Pre-feast, that of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “At your glorious memorial,” Apostolos and Gospel of the Sunday. At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light,” and Dismissal.
units.english_text: 1.    In Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX], at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we chant the Prosomoia: **"O, the marvelous wonder!"** (*Ὢ τοῦ παραδόξου θαύματος*) to 6; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"By the royal command of God"** (*Θεαρχίῳ νεύματι*). Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), the Prokeimenon of the day, and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the three Idiomela; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"When thou departedst from this life"** (*Ὅτε ἐξεδήμησας*). The Dismissal Troparion: [**"In giving birth"** (*Ἐν τῇ γεννήσει*)] three times, and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 2.    In the morning at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Litiya; then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion, and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparion three times; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos: **"My heart hath poured forth a good word"** (*Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*, Ps. 44 LXX). The Sessional Hymns (twice each); the Anavathmoi: the First Antiphon of Tone 4; and the Prokeimenon: **"I will remember thy name"** (*Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*, Ps. 44:18 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel: **"Mary having arisen"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*, Luke 1:39–49, 56); Psalm 50 [LXX] is read in a low voice; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); "Both now and ever...": repeat the same. The Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"When the translation to heaven"** (*Ὅτε ἡ μετάστασις*). Then the Canons with the Verse: **"Most Holy Theotokos, save us"** (*Ὑπεραγία Θεοτόκε*). After the Third Ode, the Hypakoe; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion, the Ikos, and the Menologion. The Katavasia: **"Adorned with divine glory"** (*Πεποικιλμένη τῇ θείᾳ δόξῃ*). Then the Ninth Ode with the Megalynaria: for the First Canon we chant: **"All generations call thee blessed, the only Theotokos"** (*Αἱ γενεαὶ πᾶσαι μακαρίζομέν σε, τὴν μόνην Θεοτόκον*); for the Second Canon we chant: **"The angels, as they looked upon the Dormition of the Virgin, were struck with wonder at how the Virgin went up from earth to heaven"** (*Ἄγγελοι τὴν Κοίμησιν τῆς Παρθένου, ὁρῶντες ἐξεπλήττοντο, πῶς ἡ Παρθένος ἀπαίρει ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς εἰς τὰ ἄνω*); and the Katavasia: **"All generations . . . The laws of nature are overcome"** [4] (*Αἱ γενεαὶ πᾶσαι . . . Νενίκηνται τῆς φύσεως οἱ ὅροι*). The Exaposteilarion...[^386]

units.slavonic_text: 1.    In Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm, at “Lord, I have cried” we sing the Prosomia “O, of the marvellous wonder!” (in 6). Glory, Now and ever, “By the royal command of God.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” the Prokimenon of the day and the Readings. At the Aposticha: the three Idiomela, Glory, Now and ever, “When you departed from this life.” The Apolytikion [“In giving birth”] three times and Dismissal 2.    In the morning at Matins, after Psalm 50, the Liti; then the Trisagion, the Apolytikion and the Exapsalmos. At “God is the Lord”: the Apolytikion three times, then the Psalter and the Polyeleos “My heart has uttered a good word.” The Kathismata (twice each), the Anavathmi of the First Antiphon of Mode IV, and the Prokimenon “I shall remember your name.” Then “Let everything that breathes” and the Gospel “Mary having arisen,” Psalm 50 read, Glory, “Through the intercessions of the Theotokos,” Now and ever; repeat the same. The Verse “Have mercy on me, O God” and the Idiomelon “When the translation to heaven.” Then the Canons with the Verse “Most Holy Theotokos.” After the 3rd Ode, the Ypakoi; after the 6th Ode, the Kontakion, the Ikos and the Minologion. The Katavasie “Adorned with divine glory.” Then the 9th Ode with the Megolynaria: for the First Canon we chant “All the generations bless you, the only Theotokos”; for the Second Canon we chant “The angels, as they looked upon the Dormition of the Virgin, were struck with wonder at how the Virgin went up from earth to heaven,” and the Katavasia “All generations . . . units.slavonic_text: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ 4. In some churches, especially where the Feast of the Dormition is celebrated with added magnificence, it has become customary, supposedly for the greater glory and honor of the Theotokos, to sing immediately after the Katavasia of the 9th Ode the so-called Engomia [Verses of Praise] of the All-holy One. This is done in emulation of the Engomia of our Lord, which are sung at the Matins of Great [Holy] Saturday. Censuring any work that strains to appear innovative and that mimics with bad taste a preexisting work — even though this is done in honor of the Theotokos, as in this instance — the Great Church officially disapproves of all such imitations and, in fact, sternly forbids their use.

Censuring any work that strains to appear innovative and that mimics with bad taste a preexisting work—even though this is done in honor of the Theotokos, as in this instance—the Great Church officially disapproves of all such imitations and, in fact, sternly forbids their use.

units.slavonic_text: (thrice). At the Praises: the three Prosomia in 4, Glory, Now and ever, “At your deathless Dormition,” Great Doxology and the Apolytikion “In giving birth”. 3.    In the Liturgy, the Antiphons:
units.english_text:
| Verses of the Antiphon | Refrain |
| :--- | :--- |
| **"Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth."** (*Ἀλαλάξατε τῷ Κυρίῳ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ*, Ps. 65:1 LXX) | **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us."** (*Ταῖς πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, Σῶτερ, σῶσον ἡμᾶς.*) |
| **"Confess Him, praise His name."** (*Ἐξομολογεῖσθε αὐτῷ, αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ*, Ps. 99:4 LXX) | **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us."** |
| **"In the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God."** (*Ἐν πόλει Κυρίου τῶν δυνάμεων ἐν πόλει τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν*, Ps. 47:9 LXX) | **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us."** |
| **"His sanctuary hath been made in peace, and His dwelling in Zion."** (*Ἐγενήθη ἐν εἰρήνῃ ὁ τόπος αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ κατοικητήριον αὐτοῦ ἐν Σιών*, Ps. 75:3 LXX) | **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos, Savior, save us."** |

units.slavonic_text: ANTIPHON ONE
units.english_text:
| Verses of the Antiphon | Refrain |
| :--- | :--- |
| **"The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob."** (*Ἀγαπᾷ Κύριος τὰς πύλας Σιών, ὑπὲρ πάντα τὰ σκηνώματα Ἰακώβ*, Ps. 86:2 LXX) | **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints, who sing to Thee: Alleluia."** (*Σῶσον ἡμᾶς Υἱὲ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐν Ἁγίοις θαυμαστός, ψάλλοντάς σοι· ᾿Αλληλούϊα.*) |
| **"Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God."** (*Δεδοξασμένα ἐλαλήθη περὶ σοῦ, ἡ πόλις τοῦ Θεοῦ*, Ps. 86:3 LXX) | **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints, who sing to Thee: Alleluia."** |
| **"God hath established her forever."** (*Ὁ Θεὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα*, Ps. 47:9 LXX) | **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints, who sing to Thee: Alleluia."** |
| **"The Most High hath sanctified His tabernacle."** (*Ἡγίασε τὸ σκήνωμα αὑτοῦ ὁ Ὕψιστος*, Ps. 45:5 LXX) | **"Save us, O Son of God, Who art wonderful in the saints, who sing to Thee: Alleluia."** |

Εἰ τύχοι ἡ ἑορτὴ ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακὸν καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς τὰ Προσόμοια εἰς ς΄, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Θεαρχίῳ νεύματι. Τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς, καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: ᾿Απόστολος, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Εἰσῆλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς κώμην τινά.    Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως Αἱ γενεαὶ πᾶσαι . . . Νενίκηνται τῆς φύσεως οἱ ὅροι.    Κοινωνικὸν Ποτήριον. Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς, καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.
units.english_text: 5.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ ἡ Λιτὴ καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ ᾿Απολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Πολυέλεος Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου. Εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν Καθίσματα ᾿Αναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς ᾿Αναβόησον Δαβίδ· εἰς τὴν β΄ αὖθις ᾿Αναστάσιμα β΄ καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ὁ πάντιμος χορός, τὸ δὲ γ΄ Κάθισμα τῆς ἑορτῆς ἐκ δευτέρου, ἡ Αἴτησις, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ ᾿Αναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἑορτῆς, Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου, τὸ Πᾶσα πνοή, καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον ᾿Αναστᾶσα Μαριάμ, τὸ ᾿Ανάστασιν Χριστοῦ καὶ ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμὸς χῦμα, Δόξα, Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου, Καὶ νῦν τὸ αὐτό, ὁ Στίχος Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός, καὶ τὸ Ἰδιόμελον Ὅτε ἡ μετάστασις. Κανόνες ὁ ᾿Αναστάσιμος καὶ οἱ δύο τῆς ἑορτῆς· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Κοντάκιον μετὰ τοῦ Οἴκου καὶ ἡ Ὑπακοὴ Μακαρίζομέν σε πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαὶ χῦμα· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον, αἱ Καταβασίαι Πεποικιλμένη τῇ θείᾳ δόξῃ· εἶτα ψάλλεται ἡ θ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς μετὰ τῶν Μεγαλυναρίων, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ᾿Αναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς δ΄. Δόξα, Τῇ ἀθανάτῳ σου κοιμήσει, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: 5.    On Sunday at Matins, after Psalm 50 [LXX], the Trinity Canon, the Litiya, and the Trinity Hymns **"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"In giving birth"** (*Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει*), and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as in Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the Polyeleos: **"My heart hath poured forth a good word"** (*Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου*, Ps. 44 LXX). At the Sessional Hymns of the First Stichologia: two of the Resurrection and that of the Feast: **"Cry out, O David"** (*Ἀναβόησον Δαβίδ*); at the Second Stichologia: two of the Resurrection and that of the Feast: **"The all-honorable chorus"** (*Ὁ πάντιμος χορός*); then the Third Sessional Hymn of the Feast twice; the Petition, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon of the Feast: **"I will remember thy name"** (*Μνησθήσομαι τοῦ ὀνόματός σου*, Ps. 44:18 LXX). Then **"Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord"** (*Πᾶσα πνοή*), and the Gospel: **"Mary having arisen"** (*Ἀναστᾶσα Μαριάμ*). Then **"Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"** (*Ἀνάστασιν Χριστοῦ θεασάμενοι*); Psalm 50 [LXX] is read in a low voice; "Glory...": **"Through the intercessions of the Theotokos"** (*Ταῖς τῆς Θεοτόκου*); "Both now and ever...": repeat the same. The Verse: **"Have mercy on me, O God"** (*Ἐλέησόν με ὁ Θεός*, Ps. 50:1 LXX), and the Idiomelon: **"When the translation to heaven"** (*Ὅτε ἡ μετάστασις*). Then the Canons of the Resurrection and the two of the Feast. After the Third Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection, and the Hypakoe: **"All generations call thee blessed"** (*Μακαρίζομέν σε πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαί*) read in a low voice; after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, and the Menologion. The Katavasia: **"Adorned with divine glory"** (*Πεποικιλμένη τῇ θείᾳ δόξῃ*); then the Ninth Ode of the Feast with the Megalynaria. The Resurrection Exaposteilarion and that of the Feast twice. At the Praises: 4 hymns of the Resurrection and 4 of the Feast; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"At thy deathless Dormition"** (*Τῇ ἀθανάτῳ σου κοιμήσει*); Great Doxology, and **"Today salvation"** (*Σήμερον σωτηρία*).

units.english_text: 7.    Τῇ ΙΕ΄ τοῦ μηνὸς ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου, καὶ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς (τὰ τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ), Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Δεῦτε τὴν παγκόσμιον κοίμησιν. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ ᾿Απόστιχα, τὰ τῆς σειρᾶς Δῆμος τῶν μαθητῶν, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν μεθέορτον, ᾿Απολυτίκια Τὴν ἄχραντον Εἰκόνα σου, Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.english_text: 8.    Εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸ Μεσονυκτικόν, ὁ Ν΄ ψαλμός, ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ κατὰ τὴν τοῦ Μηναίου διάταξιν, ὁ Κανὼν τῆς ἑορτῆς καὶ ὁ τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου, αἱ Καταβασίαι Πεποικιλμένη τῇ θείᾳ δόξῃ, Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ Ἐξαποστειλάριον τῆς σειρᾶς δίς. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, τὰ τοῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ γ΄ Προσόμοια τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου Ποίοις οἱ γηγενεῖς ὄμμασιν εἰς δ΄. Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἡ τῶν οὐρανῶν ὑψηλοτέρα (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν). Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον Τὴν ἄχραντον Εἰκόνα σου.

units.slavonic_text: Τῇ ΙϚ΄.    Ἡ ἐξ Ἐδέσσης ἀνακομιδὴ τῆς ἀχειροποιήτου Εἰκόνος, ἤτοι τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου, καὶ τοῦ ἁγίου Διομήδους.
units.english_text: 9.    Εἰς τὴν Λειτουργίαν, τὰ Τυπικὰ καὶ οἱ Μακαρισμοί, Τροπάρια ἐκ τῆς γ΄ καὶ ς΄ Ὠδῆς τοῦ Κανόνος τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου. Μετὰ τὴν Εἴσοδον, Τὴν ἄχραντον εἰκόνα σου, Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει, τοῦ Ἁγίου τοῦ Ναοῦ, καὶ Κοντάκιον Τὴν ἐν πρεσβείαις, ὁ ᾿Απόστολος (ζήτει Σαββάτῳ πρὸ τῶν Φώτων), καὶ τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον Τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ, ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ συμπληροῦσθαι, Εἰς τὸ Ἐξαιρέτως, Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, Κοινωνικὸν Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον, Εἴδομεν τὸ φῶς καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 7.    Τῇ ΙΕ΄ τοῦ μηνὸς ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ψάλλομεν τὰ γ΄ Στιχηρὰ Προσόμοια τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου, καὶ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς (τὰ τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ), Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Δεῦτε τὴν παγκόσμιον κοίμησιν. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον τῆς ἡμέρας. Εἰς τὰ ᾿Απόστιχα, τὰ τῆς σειρᾶς Δῆμος τῶν μαθητῶν, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν μεθέορτον, ᾿Απολυτίκια Τὴν ἄχραντον Εἰκόνα σου, Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.
units.english_text: 10.   Εἰ τύχοι ἐν Κυριακῇ, τῷ Σαββάτῳ ἑσπέρας, μετὰ τὸν Προοιμιακόν, καὶ τὸ Ψαλτήριον, εἰς τὸ Κύριε ἐκέκραξα ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρὰ δ΄, τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου γ΄ καὶ γ΄ τῆς ἑορτῆς (τὰ τοῦ μικροῦ Ἑσπερινοῦ), Δόξα, Δεῦτε φιλεόρτων τὸ σύστημα (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτὴν τῆς ἑορτῆς), Καὶ νῦν τὸ α΄ Θεοτοκίον τοῦ ἤχου. Εἴσοδος, Φῶς ἱλαρόν, καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Εἰς τὰ ᾿Απόστιχα, τὰ ἀναστάσιμα Στιχηρά, Δόξα, Καὶ νῦν, Ἄσατε λαοί (ζήτει εἰς τὴν Λιτήν), τὸ ἀναστάσιμον ᾿Απολυτίκιον, Τὴν ἄχραντον Εἰκόνα σου, Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει καὶ ᾿Απόλυσις.

units.slavonic_text: 7.    On August 15, at Great Vespers following the Introductory Psalm at “Lord, I have cried” we sing the three Stichira Prosomia of the Mandylion (Holy Veil), and three of the Feast (from Small Vespers), Glory, Now and ever, “Come, let us celebrate.” Entrance, “O Gladsome Light” and the Prokimenon of the day. At the Aposticha: the three hymns of the sequence “The community of the disciples,” Glory, Now and ever of the Post-feast. Apolytikia: “Your most pure image,” “In giving birth,” and Dismissal 8.    In Matins, after the Midnight Service, Psalm 50, the Exapsalmos and the rest of the service according to the order of the Mineon, the Canon of the Feast and that of the Holy Veil. The Katavasie “Adorned in divine glory,” and then “More honorable”; the Exapostilarion of the sequence twice. At the Praises: the three Prosomia of the Holy Veil “With what eyes” in 4, Glory, Now and ever, “She who is higher than the heavens” (see the Liti), Great Doxology and the Apolytikion “Your most pure image.” 9.    In the Liturgy are sung the Typika and Beatitudes and 4 hymns from the 3rd and 6th Ode of the Canon of the Holy Mandylion. After the Entrance the Apolytikia: “Your most pure image,” “In giving birth,” of the Saint of the Church, and the Kontakion “Neither the tomb nor death.” Apostolos (see Saturday before Epiphany), and the Gospel “Not long before it was time.” At “Especially,” “It is meet,” Communion Hymn “Praise [the Lord],” “We have seen the [true] light” and Dismissal. 10.   If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm and the Psalter, at “Lord, I have cried,” we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira and three of the Holy Veil and three of the Feast (of the Small Vespers), Glory, “Come, you feast lovers” (see the Liti of the Feast), Now and ever the first Theotokion of the Mode. Entrance, “O Gladsome Light,” and the Prokimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira, Glory, Now and ever, “Sing, O people!” (see the Liti). units.english_text: 10.   If the Feast occurs on a Sunday, on Saturday evening at Great Vespers, following the Introductory Psalm [Ps. 103 LXX] and the Psalter reading, at **"Lord, I have cried"** (*Κύριε ἐκέκραξα*, Ps. 140 LXX), we sing 4 Resurrection Stichira, three of the Holy Mandylion, and three of the Feast (from Small Vespers); "Glory...": **"Come, assembly of feast lovers"** (*Δεῦτε φιλεόρτων τὸ σύστημα*, see the Litiya of the Feast); "Both now and ever...": the first Theotokion of the Tone. Little Entrance, **"Gladsome Light"** (*Φῶς ἱλαρόν*), and the Prokeimenon. At the Aposticha: the Resurrection Stichira; "Glory... Both now and ever...": **"Sing, O people!"** (*Ἄσατε λαοί*, see the Litiya). The Dismissal Troparia: of the Resurrection, **"Thy most pure icon"** (*Τὴν ἄχραντον Εἰκόνα σου*), **"In giving birth"** (*Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει*), and Dismissal.

units.english_text: 11.    Τῇ Κυριακῇ εἰς τὸν Ὄρθρον, μετὰ τὸν Ν΄ ψαλμόν, ὁ Τριαδικὸς κανὼν καὶ τὰ Τριαδικὰ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν, εἶτα τὸ Τρισάγιον, τὸ ᾿Απολυτίκιον Τὴν ἄχραντον Εἰκόνα σου, καὶ ὁ Ἑξάψαλμος. Εἰς τὸ Θεὸς Κύριος, τὰ ᾿Απολυτίκια ὡς εἰς τὸν Ἑσπερινόν, εἶτα τὸ Ψαλτήριον καὶ ὁ Ἄμωμος. Εἰς τὴν α΄ Στιχολογίαν δύο ἀναστάσιμα Καθίσματα, καὶ μεθέορτον Καθορῶσαι ἀληθῶς (ζήτει εἰς τὴν ΙΣΤ΄)· εἰς τὴν β΄ Στιχολογίαν αὖθις δύο ᾿Αναστάσιμα, καὶ τὸ ἕτερον μεθέορτον Ἐν χερσὶ τοῦ δι᾿ ἡμᾶς· εἶτα τὰ Εὐλογητάρια, ἡ Ὑπακοή, οἱ ᾿Αναβαθμοὶ τοῦ ἤχου καὶ τὸ Προκείμενον. Κανόνες ὁ ᾿Αναστάσιμος, καὶ ὁ τοῦ ἁγίου Μανδηλίου μετὰ Στίχου Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν· ἀπὸ γ΄ Ὠδῆς Κάθισμα Ἐδέσσης βασιλεὺς καὶ τῆς ἑορτῆς Ὁ πάντιμος χορός· ἀφ᾿ ς΄ Κοντάκιον καὶ Οἶκος τὰ ᾿Αναστάσιμα καὶ τὸ Μηνολόγιον τῆς ἡμέρας, αἱ Καταβασίαι Πεποικιλμένη τῇ θείᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἅπασα ἡ τάξις τοῦ Ἑωθινοῦ Εὐαγγελίου, εἶτα στιχολογοῦμεν Τὴν τιμιωτέραν, τὸ ἀναστάσιμον Ἐξαποστειλάριον, καὶ τὸ τῆς ἑορτῆς Τῶν ᾿Αποστόλων ὁ δῆμος ἅπαξ. Εἰς τοὺς Αἴνους, ᾿Αναστάσιμα δ΄ καὶ μεθέορτα δ΄ Ὕμνοις σου τὸ σεπτὸν (ζήτει τῷ ΙΣΤ΄), Δόξα τὸ Ἑωθινόν, Καὶ νῦν, Ὑπερευλογημένη, Δοξολογία Μεγάλη καὶ τὸ Σήμερον σωτηρία.

units.english_text: ...**"It is truly right"** (*Ἄξιόν ἐστιν*); then the Trisagion Prayers, the Dismissal Troparion: **"Thy most pure icon"** (*Τὴν ἄχραντον Εἰκόνα σου*), and the Six Psalms. At "God is the Lord": the Dismissal Troparia as at Vespers; then the Psalter reading and the 17th Kathisma [Amomos, Ps. 118 LXX]. At the Sessional Hymns of the First Stichologia: two of the Resurrection and that of the Afterfeast: **"Beholding truly"** (*Καθορῶσαι ἀληθῶς*, see August 16); at the Second Stichologia: two of the Resurrection and the other one of the Afterfeast: **"In the hands of Him Who for our sake"** (*Ἐν χερσὶ τοῦ δι᾿ ἡμᾶς*). The Evlogitaria, the Hypakoe, the Anavathmoi of the Tone, and the Prokeimenon. Then the Canons of the Resurrection and of the Holy Mandylion with the Verse: **"Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"** (*Δόξα σοι ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν*). After the Third Ode, the Sessional Hymn: **"The King of Edessa"** (*Ἐδέσσης βασιλεύς*) and that of the Feast: **"The all-honorable chorus"** (*Ὁ πάντιμος χορός*); after the Sixth Ode, the Kontakion and Ikos of the Resurrection and the Menologion of the day. Katavasiai: **"Adorned with divine glory"** (*Πεποικιλμένη τῇ θείᾳ δόξῃ*), and the entire order of the Sunday Matins Gospel; then we chant the Magnifications: **"More honorable than the Cherubim"** (*Τὴν τιμιωτέραν*).
